sanskrit_iast: atha vitānasya | brahmā karmāṇi brahmavedavid dakṣiṇato vidhivad upaviśati vāgyataḥ |
meaning: अथ वितानस्य । ब्रह्मा कर्माणि ब्रह्मवेदविद् दक्षिणतो विधिवद् उपविशति वाग्यतः ।
text_mt: Now of the expansion of fires: The brahman priest, who knows the Brahmaveda, sits down to the south according to rule, restraining speech, for the rites.

sanskrit_iast: homān ādiṣṭān anumantrayate |
meaning: होमान् आदिष्टान् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the specified oblations.

sanskrit_iast: mantrānādeśe liṅgavateti bhāgaliḥ | prajāpate na tvad etāny anyaḥ iti yuvā kauśikaḥ | yathādevatam iti māṭharaḥ | oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om ity ācāryāḥ |
meaning: मन्त्रानादेशे लिङ्गवतेति भागलिः । प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्यः इति युवा कौशिकः । यथादेवतम् इति माठरः । ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् जनद् ओम् इत्य् आचार्याः ।
text_mt: When no mantra is specified, [he acts] with one that has the appropriate characteristic, so says Bhāgali; with "O Prajāpati, none other than you..." [AV 7.85(80).3], says the young Kauśika; according to the deity, says Māṭhara; with "Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om", say the teachers.

sanskrit_iast: pradhānahomamantrān purastāddhomasaṃsthitahomeṣv āvapanty eke |
meaning: प्रधानहोममन्त्रान् पुरस्ताद्धोमसंस्थितहोमेष्व् आवपन्त्य् एके ।
text_mt: Some insert the mantras of the principal oblations into the preliminary offerings and the concluding offerings.

sanskrit_iast: vācayati yajamānaṃ bhṛgvaṅgirovidā saṃskṛtam |
meaning: वाचयति यजमानं भृग्वङ्गिरोविदा संस्कृतम् ।
text_mt: He causes the sacrificer, consecrated by one who knows the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases, to recite.

sanskrit_iast: agnir āhavanīyaḥ |
meaning: अग्निर् आहवनीयः ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃcaravāgyamau brahmavad yajamānasya |
meaning: संचरवाग्यमौ ब्रह्मवद् यजमानस्य ।
text_mt: The movement and restraining of speech of the sacrificer are like those of the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: devatāhavirdakṣiṇā yajurvedāt |
meaning: देवताहविर्दक्षिणा यजुर्वेदात् ।
text_mt: The deities, sacrificial offerings, and sacrificial fees are from the Yajurveda.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrasyottarata upācāraḥ | sphyasaṃmārgapāṇes tiṣṭhato dakṣiṇāmukhasya |
meaning: आग्नीध्रस्योत्तरत उपाचारः । स्फ्यसंमार्गपाणेस् तिष्ठतो दक्षिणामुखस्य ।
text_mt: The approach of the āgnīdhra priest is from the north, standing facing south with the wooden sword and cleansing brush in hand.

sanskrit_iast: yathāsvaram astu śrauṣaṭ iti pratyāśrāvaṇam |
meaning: यथास्वरम् अस्तु श्रौषट् इति प्रत्याश्रावणम् ।
text_mt: The call of response is "astu śrau3ṣaṭ", according to the proper pitch.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāno 'māvāsyāyāṃ pūrvedyur upavatsyadbhaktam aśnāty aparāhṇe |
meaning: यजमानो ऽमावास्यायां पूर्वेद्युर् उपवत्स्यद्भक्तम् अश्नात्य् अपराह्णे ।
text_mt: On the day before the new moon day, the sacrificer eats in the afternoon the food for one about to fast.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyagārhapatyadakṣiṇāgniṣu mamāgne varcaḥ iti samidho 'nvādadhāti vibhāgam |
meaning: आहवनीयगार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्निषु ममाग्ने वर्चः इति समिधो ऽन्वादधाति विभागम् ।
text_mt: With "My luster, O Agni..." [AV 5.3.1], he adds fuel to the āhavanīya, gārhapatya, and dakṣiṇa fires in distribution.

sanskrit_iast: vratam upaiti vratena tvaṃ vratapate iti | anaśanam ityādi |
meaning: व्रतम् उपैति व्रतेन त्वं व्रतपते इति । अनशनम् इत्यादि ।
text_mt: He enters upon the sacrificial observance with "By sacrificial observance you, O lord of sacrificial observances..." [AV 7.78(74).4]: fasting, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: mamāgne varcaḥ iti catasṛbhir devatāḥ parigṛhṇāti | sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke iti mantroktām |
meaning: ममाग्ने वर्चः इति चतसृभिर् देवताः परिगृह्णाति । सिनीवालि पृथुष्टुके इति मन्त्रोक्ताम् ।
text_mt: With the four [verses] "My luster, O Agni..." [AV 5.3.1–4], he takes possession of the deities; [and] the one mentioned in the mantra with "O Sinīvālī, broad-tufted one..." [AV 7.48(46)].

sanskrit_iast: anv adya naḥ iti paurṇamāsyām |
meaning: अन्व् अद्य नः इति पौर्णमास्याम् ।
text_mt: On the full moon day, with "Favor us today..." [AV 7.21(20)].

sanskrit_iast: prātar hutvāgnihotram kuhūṃ devīm yat te devāḥ ity amāvāsyāyām | rākām aham pūrṇā paścāt iti paurṇamāsyām |
meaning: प्रातर् हुत्वाग्निहोत्रम् कुहूं देवीम् यत् ते देवाः इत्य् अमावास्यायाम् । राकाम् अहम् पूर्णा पश्चात् इति पौर्णमास्याम् ।
text_mt: Having offered the agnihotra in the morning: with "Kuhū, the goddess..." [AV 7.49(47)] and "What the gods to you..." [AV 7.84(79)] on the new moon day; with "Rākā I..." [AV 7.50(48)] and "Full behind..." [AV 7.85(80)] on the full moon day.

sanskrit_iast: atha brahmāṇaṃ vṛṇīte bhūpate bhuvanapate bhuvāṃ pate mahato bhūtasya pate brahmāṇaṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe iti |
meaning: अथ ब्रह्माणं वृणीते भूपते भुवनपते भुवां पते महतो भूतस्य पते ब्रह्माणं त्वा वृणीमहे इति ।
text_mt: Then he chooses the brahman priest: "O lord of the earth, lord of the world, lord of beings, lord of the great being, we choose you as brahman priest!"

sanskrit_iast: vṛto japati ahaṃ bhūpatiḥ ahaṃ bhuvanapatiḥ ahaṃ bhuvāṃ patiḥ ahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patiḥ tad ahaṃ manase prabravīmi mano vāca vāg gāyatryai gāyatry uṣṇiha uṣṇig anuṣṭubhe 'nuṣṭub bṛhatyai bṛhatī paṅktaye paṅktis triṣṭubhe triṣṭub jagatyai jagatī prajāpataye prajāpatir viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om iti apratirathañ ca |
meaning: वृतो जपति अहं भूपतिः अहं भुवनपतिः अहं भुवां पतिः अहं महतो भूतस्य पतिः तद् अहं मनसे प्रब्रवीमि मनो वाच वाग् गायत्र्यै गायत्र्य् उष्णिह उष्णिग् अनुष्टुभे ऽनुष्टुब् बृहत्यै बृहती पङ्क्तये पङ्क्तिस् त्रिष्टुभे त्रिष्टुब् जगत्यै जगती प्रजापतये प्रजापतिर् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् जनद् ओम् इति अप्रतिरथञ् च ।
text_mt: Being chosen, [the brahman priest] mutters: "I am the lord of the earth, I am the lord of the world, I am the lord of beings, I am the lord of the great being; that I announce to the mind, the mind to speech, speech to the gāyatrī, the gāyatrī to the uṣṇih, the uṣṇih to the anuṣṭubh, the anuṣṭubh to the bṛhatī, the bṛhatī to the paṅkti, the paṅkti to the triṣṭubh, the triṣṭubh to the jagatī, the jagatī to Prajāpati, Prajāpati to all the gods; oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om", and the Apratiratha hymn.

sanskrit_iast: jīvābhir ācamyetyādi prapadanāntam |
meaning: जीवाभिर् आचम्येत्यादि प्रपदनान्तम् ।
text_mt: Having sipped water with the Jīvā mantras, and so on, up to stepping forward.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato 'gner dakṣiṇato 'parāgnibhyāṃ prapadyāsādaṃ vīks.ya ahe daidhiṣavya ityādy ā dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ samīkṣaṇāt |
meaning: उत्तरतो ऽग्नेर् दक्षिणतो ऽपराग्निभ्यां प्रपद्यासादं वीक्स्.य अहे दैधिषव्य इत्याद्य् आ द्यावापृथिव्योः समीक्षणात् ।
text_mt: Stepping forward to the north of the [āhavanīya] fire and to the south of the western fires, looking at the seat, [he recites] "O Daidhiṣavya...", and so forth, up to looking at heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast: yatra vijānāti brahmann apaḥ praṇeṣyāmīti tatra praṇaya yajñaṃ devatā vardhaya tvam | nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamāno astu sapta ṛṣīṇāṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokas tatremaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca dhehi oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad oṃ praṇaya iti yathāsvaram anujānāti | evaṃ sarvatrānujñāpadam ādyantayoḥ |
meaning: यत्र विजानाति ब्रह्मन्न् अपः प्रणेष्यामीति तत्र प्रणय यज्ञं देवता वर्धय त्वम् । नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानो अस्तु सप्त ऋषीणां सुकृतां यत्र लोकस् तत्रेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च धेहि ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् जनद् ओं प्रणय इति यथास्वरम् अनुजानाति । एवं सर्वत्रानुज्ञापदम् आद्यन्तयोः ।
text_mt: When he perceives [the call]: "O brahman priest, I shall lead forth the waters", he gives permission at the proper pitch with: "Lead them forth! Increase the sacrifice, the deities, you! May the sacrificer be on the back of the firmament, in the heavenly world; where the world of the seven pious seers is, there place this sacrifice and the sacrificer; oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad oṃ, lead them forth!" In this way, the word of permission is at the beginning and the end everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: praṇītāsu praṇīyamānāsu vācaṃ yacchaty ā haviṣkṛta udvādanāt |
meaning: प्रणीतासु प्रणीयमानासु वाचं यच्छत्य् आ हविष्कृत उद्वादनात् ।
text_mt: While the holy water is being led forth, he restrains speech until the calling out of the maker of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vaded vaiṣṇavīṃ japet |
meaning: यदि वदेद् वैष्णवीं जपेत् ।
text_mt: If he should speak, he should mutter [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhro 'nvāhāryādhiśrayaṇād vediṃ parisamuhyotkaradeśe nidadhāti | stambayajuṣo dvitīyapurīṣe prahṛte 'vastabhnāti ca araro divaṃ mā paptaḥ iti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रो ऽन्वाहार्याधिश्रयणाद् वेदिं परिसमुह्योत्करदेशे निदधाति । स्तम्बयजुषो द्वितीयपुरीषे प्रहृते ऽवस्तभ्नाति च अररो दिवं मा पप्तः इति ।
text_mt: From the placing of the anvāhārya [cooked rice] on the fire, the āgnīdhra priest sweeps up the altar and places [the dust] in the place of the rubbish heap; and when the second loose earth of the grass-clump offering is thrown, he presses it down with "O Araru, do not fly to heaven!"

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate parigṛhāṇa iti vediṃ parigṛhyamāṇām anumantrayate |
meaning: बृहस्पते परिगृहाण इति वेदिं परिगृह्यमाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the altar as it is being marked out, with "O Bṛhaspati, encompass..."

sanskrit_iast: āśāsānā saumanasam iti patnīṃ saṃnahyamānām |
meaning: आशासाना सौमनसम् इति पत्नीं संनह्यमानाम् ।
text_mt: The sacrificer's wife as she is being girded, with "Wishing for goodwill..." [AV 14.1.42].

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtaṃ te agne ity ājye nirupyamāṇe 'gnim | pari stṛṇīhi iti vediṃ paristṛṇantam |
meaning: घृतं ते अग्ने इत्य् आज्ये निरुप्यमाणे ऽग्निम् । परि स्तृणीहि इति वेदिं परिस्तृणन्तम् ।
text_mt: The fire while clarified butter is being scooped, with "Clarified butter for you, O Agni..." [AV 7.87(82).6]; the one strewing the altar, with "Strew around..." [AV 7.104(99)].

sanskrit_iast: yasyāṃ vṛkṣāḥ iti paridhīn nidhīyamānān |
meaning: यस्यां वृक्षाः इति परिधीन् निधीयमानान् ।
text_mt: The enclosing sticks as they are being laid down, with "In which the trees..." [AV 12.1.27].

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣīṇāṃ prastaro 'si iti prastaram |
meaning: ऋषीणां प्रस्तरो ऽसि इति प्रस्तरम् ।
text_mt: The grass bundle, with "You are the grass bundle of the seers..." [AV 16.2.6].

sanskrit_iast: āsāditeṣu haviḥṣūktān purastāddhomān juhoti | abhicāreṣv ābhicārikān saṃsthitahomāṃś ca |
meaning: आसादितेषु हविःषूक्तान् पुरस्ताद्धोमान् जुहोति । अभिचारेष्व् आभिचारिकान् संस्थितहोमांश् च ।
text_mt: When the sacrificial offerings have been placed, he offers the preliminary offerings that have been stated; in malevolent rites, the malevolent ones, and the concluding offerings.

sanskrit_iast: agner manve iti sāmidhenīr anumantrayate |
meaning: अग्नेर् मन्वे इति सामिधेनीर् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the kindling verses with "I think of Agni..." [AV 4.23].

sanskrit_iast: prajāpate na tvad etāny anyaḥ iti prājāpatyam āghāram |
meaning: प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्यः इति प्राजापत्यम् आघारम् ।
text_mt: The butter pouring to Prajāpati with "O Prajāpati, none other than you..." [AV 7.85(80).3].

sanskrit_iast: agnīt paridhīṃś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi iti preṣati āgnīdhraḥ sphyam agniṃ ca saṃmārgam antarā kṛtvā paridhīn madhyamadakṣiṇottarān tristriḥ saṃmārṣṭi agne vājajit vājaṃ tvā sariṣ.yantaṃ vājajitaṃ saṃmārjmi iti | saṃmārgeṇārvāñcam agnim upavājayati vājaṃ tvāgne jeṣyantaṃ saniṣyantaṃ saṃmārjmi vājaṃ jaya iti |
meaning: अग्नीत् परिधींश् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि इति प्रेषति आग्नीध्रः स्फ्यम् अग्निं च संमार्गम् अन्तरा कृत्वा परिधीन् मध्यमदक्षिणोत्तरान् त्रिस्त्रिः संमार्ष्टि अग्ने वाजजित् वाजं त्वा सरिष्.यन्तं वाजजितं संमार्ज्मि इति । संमार्गेणार्वाञ्चम् अग्निम् उपवाजयति वाजं त्वाग्ने जेष्यन्तं सनिष्यन्तं संमार्ज्मि वाजं जय इति ।
text_mt: With the call "O agnīdhra, cleanse the enclosing sticks and the fire thrice each!", the āgnīdhra priest, placing the wooden sword between the fire and the cleansing brush, cleanses the middle, southern, and northern enclosing sticks thrice each with "O Agni, winner of booty, I cleanse you who are about to run for booty, the winner of booty"; with the cleansing brush he fans the fire toward himself with "O Agni, I cleanse you who are about to conquer booty, about to gain [it]; conquer booty!"

sanskrit_iast: indremam ity aindram āghāram |
meaning: इन्द्रेमम् इत्य् ऐन्द्रम् आघारम् ।
text_mt: The butter pouring to Indra with "O Indra, this..." [AV 6.5.2].

sanskrit_iast: pravare pravriyamāṇe vācayed devāḥ pitaraḥ iti tisraḥ |
meaning: प्रवरे प्रव्रियमाणे वाचयेद् देवाः पितरः इति तिस्रः ।
text_mt: While the ancestral lineage is being chosen, he should cause [the sacrificer] to recite the three [verses] "O divine fathers..." [AV 6.123.3–5].

sanskrit_iast: grīṣmo hemantaḥ iti prayājān |
meaning: ग्रीष्मो हेमन्तः इति प्रयाजान् ।
text_mt: The fore-offerings with "Summer, winter..." [AV 6.55.2].

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ jajāna ity ājyabhāgau |
meaning: अहं जजान इत्य् आज्यभागौ ।
text_mt: The two butter portions with "I generated..." [AV 6.61.3].

sanskrit_iast: yenendrāya ity āgneyam |
meaning: येनेन्द्राय इत्य् आग्नेयम् ।
text_mt: The [offering] to Agni with "By which to Indra..." [AV 1.9.3].

sanskrit_iast: mā vaniṃ mā vācam ity aindrāgnam |
meaning: मा वनिं मा वाचम् इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नम् ।
text_mt: The [offering] to Indra-and-Agni with "Neither the desire nor the voice..." [AV 5.7.6].

sanskrit_iast: sāṃnāyyasyaindraṃ māhendraṃ vā indremam tvam indras tvaṃ mahendraḥ iti |
meaning: सांनाय्यस्यैन्द्रं माहेन्द्रं वा इन्द्रेमम् त्वम् इन्द्रस् त्वं महेन्द्रः इति ।
text_mt: The curd and milk offering to Indra or to Mahendra with "O Indra, this..." [AV 6.5.2] or "You are Indra, you are Mahendra" [AV 17.1.18].

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyām āgneyāgnīṣomīyāv antaropāṃśuyājam angīṣomīyam asmai kṣatram iti | nāmāvāsyāyām avidhānāt |
meaning: पौर्णमास्याम् आग्नेयाग्नीषोमीयाव् अन्तरोपांशुयाजम् अन्गीषोमीयम् अस्मै क्षत्रम् इति । नामावास्यायाम् अविधानात् ।
text_mt: On the full moon day, between the [offerings] to Agni and to Agni-Soma, [there is] the whispered offering to Agni-Soma with "To him dominion" [6.54.2]; not on the new moon day, because it is not prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: ā devānām iti sauviṣṭakṛtam |
meaning: आ देवानाम् इति सौविष्टकृतम् ।
text_mt: With "Hither of the gods" [19.59.3], [he consecrates] the sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭe sviṣṭakṛti vācaṃ yacchaty ānuyājānām prasavāt |
meaning: इष्टे स्विष्टकृति वाचं यच्छत्य् आनुयाजानाम् प्रसवात् ।
text_mt: When the sviṣṭakṛt has been offered, he restrains speech until the impelling of the after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: prāśitraṃ yavamātram adhastād upariṣṭād vābhighāritam agreṇādhvaryuḥ pariharati |
meaning: प्राशित्रं यवमात्रम् अधस्ताद् उपरिष्टाद् वाभिघारितम् अग्रेणाध्वर्युः परिहरति ।
text_mt: The adhvaryu brings forward the brahman's portion, the size of a barleycorn, smeared with clarified butter from beneath or from above.

sanskrit_iast: tat sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣe iti pratīkṣate |
meaning: तत् सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रतीक्षे इति प्रतीक्षते ।
text_mt: He looks at it with: "With the eye of Sūrya I behold you."

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūtaḥ praśiṣā pratigṛhṇāmi iti pratigṛhṇāti |
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रसूतः प्रशिषा प्रतिगृह्णामि इति प्रतिगृह्णाति ।
text_mt: He receives it with: "At the impulse of god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, impelled by the instruction, I receive you."

sanskrit_iast: tad vyuhya tṛṇāni prāgdaṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍile nidadhāti pṛthivyās tvā nābhau sādayāmi iti |
meaning: तद् व्युह्य तृणानि प्राग्दण्डं स्थण्डिले निदधाति पृथिव्यास् त्वा नाभौ सादयामि इति ।
text_mt:
Having moved the blades of grass aside, he places it on the bare ground with the handle pointing east, with: "I set you on the navel of the earth."

With: "With the mouth of Agni...", and "You are breath, do not injure my breath in my self, svāhā!", he eats it with the ring finger and thumb, not touching it with his teeth.

sanskrit_iast: agneṣ ṭvāsyena ātmāsy ātmann ātmānaṃ me mā hiṃsīḥ svāhā ity anāmikāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ dantair anupaspṛśan prāśnāti |
meaning: अग्नेष् ट्वास्येन आत्मास्य् आत्मन्न् आत्मानं मे मा हिंसीः स्वाहा इत्य् अनामिकाङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां दन्तैर् अनुपस्पृशन् प्राश्नाति ।

sanskrit_iast: prāśitam anumantrayate yo 'gnir nṛmaṇā nāma brāhmaṇeṣu praviṣṭas tasmin etat suhutam astu prāśitraṃ tan mā mā hiṃsīt parame vyoman iti |
meaning: प्राशितम् अनुमन्त्रयते यो ऽग्निर् नृमणा नाम ब्राह्मणेषु प्रविष्टस् तस्मिन् एतत् सुहुतम् अस्तु प्राशित्रं तन् मा मा हिंसीत् परमे व्योमन् इति ।
text_mt: He consecrates the portion that has been eaten with the mantra: "Whatever Agni named Nṛmaṇas has entered into the brāhmaṇas, in him let this brahman's portion be well-offered; let that not harm me in the highest heaven."

sanskrit_iast: mātalyādbhiḥ mārjayitvā prāṇān saṃspṛśate |
meaning: मातल्याद्भिः मार्जयित्वा प्राणान् संस्पृशते ।

sanskrit_iast: vāṅ ma āsan nasoḥ prāṇaś cakṣur akṣṇoḥ śrotraṃ karṇayor bāhvor balam ūrvor ojo jaṅghayor javaḥ pādayoḥ pratiṣṭhā | ariṣṭāni me sarvāṅgāni santu tanūs tanvā me saha iti nābhim |
meaning: वाङ् म आसन् नसोः प्राणश् चक्षुर् अक्ष्णोः श्रोत्रं कर्णयोर् बाह्वोर् बलम् ऊर्वोर् ओजो जङ्घयोर् जवः पादयोः प्रतिष्ठा । अरिष्टानि मे सर्वाङ्गानि सन्तु तनूस् तन्वा मे सह इति नाभिम् ।

sanskrit_iast: iḍaivāsmān itīḍām upahūyamānām anumantrayate |
meaning: इडैवास्मान् इतीडाम् उपहूयमानाम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates the iḍā while it is being invoked with: "May Iḍā indeed us..." [7.28.1].

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhraḥ ṣaḍavattaṃ prāśnāti pṛthivyāḥ tvā dātrā prāśnāmy antarikṣasya tvā divas tvā iti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रः षडवत्तं प्राश्नाति पृथिव्याः त्वा दात्रा प्राश्नाम्य् अन्तरिक्षस्य त्वा दिवस् त्वा इति ।
text_mt: The āgnīdhra consumes the sixfold cut portion with: "By the gift of the earth I consume you; by that of the atmosphere [I consume] you; by that of the sky [I consume] you."

sanskrit_iast: upa tvā devaḥ itīḍābhāgaṃ pratigṛhya indra gīrbhiḥ iti prāśnanti |
meaning: उप त्वा देवः इतीडाभागं प्रतिगृह्य इन्द्र गीर्भिः इति प्राश्नन्ति ।
text_mt: Having received the iḍā portion with: "To you the divine..." [7.115.3ab], they consume it with: "O Indra, with songs..." [7.115.3cd].

sanskrit_iast: apo divyāḥ iti tisṛbhiḥ pavitravati mārjayante |
meaning: अपो दिव्याः इति तिसृभिः पवित्रवति मार्जयन्ते ।
text_mt: With the three verses "Divine waters..." [7.94.1–3], they cleanse themselves over [the vessel] containing the strainer.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāno 'nvāhāryam antar vedyām |
meaning: यजमानो ऽन्वाहार्यम् अन्तर् वेद्याम् ।
text_mt: The sacrificer [places] the cooked rice offering inside the altar.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpater bhāgo 'sy ūrjasvān payasvān akṣito 'sy akṣityai tvā mā me kṣeṣṭhāḥ amutrāmuṣmiṃl loka iha ca prāṇāpānau me pāhi samānavyānau me pāhi udānarūpe me pāhi ūrg asi ūrjaṃ me dhehi kurvato me mā kṣeṣṭhāḥ dadato me mopadasaḥ prajāpatir ahaṃ tvayā samakṣam ṛdhyāsam ity abhimantrya ṛtvigbhyo dadāti dakṣiṇām |
meaning: प्रजापतेर् भागो ऽस्य् ऊर्जस्वान् पयस्वान् अक्षितो ऽस्य् अक्षित्यै त्वा मा मे क्षेष्ठाः अमुत्रामुष्मिंल् लोक इह च प्राणापानौ मे पाहि समानव्यानौ मे पाहि उदानरूपे मे पाहि ऊर्ग् असि ऊर्जं मे धेहि कुर्वतो मे मा क्षेष्ठाः ददतो मे मोपदसः प्रजापतिर् अहं त्वया समक्षम् ऋध्यासम् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य ऋत्विग्भ्यो ददाति दक्षिणाम् ।
text_mt: Having consecrated it with: "You are Prajāpati's portion, vigorous, full of milk; you are inexhaustible, for inexhaustibility [I address] you; do not fail me, yonder in that world and here; protect my out-breathing and in-breathing, protect my equalized and diffused breath, protect my upward breath and form; you are vigor, bestow vigor upon me; do not fail me while I act; do not run dry while I give; through you, being Prajāpati, may I visibly thrive!", he gives the sacrificial fee to the priests.

sanskrit_iast: pratigṛhya ka idam ity uktam |
meaning: प्रतिगृह्य क इदम् इत्य् उक्तम् ।
text_mt: Having received it, [the formula] beginning with "Who this..." [3.29.7] has already been stated.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpreṣita āgnīdhraḥ |
meaning: संप्रेषित आग्नीध्रः ।

sanskrit_iast: edho 'si iti samidvatyā samidham ādhāya sakṛtsakṛt paridhīn saṃmārṣṭi agne vājavid vājaṃ tvā sasṛvāṃsaṃ vājajitaṃ saṃmārjmi iti |
meaning: एधो ऽसि इति समिद्वत्या समिधम् आधाय सकृत्सकृत् परिधीन् संमार्ष्टि अग्ने वाजविद् वाजं त्वा ससृवांसं वाजजितं संमार्ज्मि इति ।
text_mt: Having placed a kindling stick with the verse containing 'fuel' [namely] "Fuel you are..." [7.94.4], he wipes the enclosing sticks one by one with: "O Agni, winner of booty, having run for booty, victorious in booty, I wipe you."

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ ca prāñcaṃ vājaṃ tvāgne jigīvāṃsaṃ saṃmārjmi vājam ajaiḥ iti |
meaning: अग्निं च प्राञ्चं वाजं त्वाग्ने जिगीवांसं संमार्ज्मि वाजम् अजैः इति ।
text_mt: And [he wipes] the fire towards the east with: "O Agni, having conquered booty, I wipe you; you have won booty."

sanskrit_iast: manojyotir juṣatām ājyam ariṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ sam imaṃ tanotu bṛhaspatiḥ pratigṛhṇātu no viśve devāsa iha mādayantām ity anuyājān |
meaning: मनोज्योतिर् जुषताम् आज्यम् अरिष्टं यज्ञं सम् इमं तनोतु बृहस्पतिः प्रतिगृह्णातु नो विश्वे देवास इह मादयन्ताम् इत्य् अनुयाजान् ।
text_mt: [He impels] the after-offerings with: "May the light of the mind enjoy the clarified butter; may he extend this unharmed sacrifice; may Bṛhaspati accept [it] for us; may the All-gods rejoice here!"

sanskrit_iast: ye devā divi ṣṭha ity anuvaṣaṭkāram |
meaning: ये देवा दिवि ष्ठ इत्य् अनुवषट्कारम् ।
text_mt: [He impels] the second vaṣaṭ-call with: "You gods who are in the sky..." [1.30.3].

sanskrit_iast: nudasva kāma iti srucau vipraṇudyamāne anumantrayate |
meaning: नुदस्व काम इति स्रुचौ विप्रणुद्यमाने अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates the two offering ladles as they are being pushed apart with: "Thrust away, O Desire..." [9.2.4].

sanskrit_iast: sam barhir aktam iti prastaraṃ prahriyamāṇam |
meaning: सम् बर्हिर् अक्तम् इति प्रस्तरं प्रह्रियमाणम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the grass bundle as it is being thrown into the fire with: "Anointed together, the barhis..." [7.103].

sanskrit_iast: saṃsrāvabhāgāḥ iti saṃsrāvam |
meaning: संस्रावभागाः इति संस्रावम् ।

sanskrit_iast: na ghraṃs tatāpa saṃ varcasā devānāṃ patnīḥ sugārhapatya iti patnīsaṃyājān |
meaning: न घ्रंस् तताप सं वर्चसा देवानां पत्नीः सुगार्हपत्य इति पत्नीसंयाजान् ।
text_mt: [He impels] the offerings to the wives of the gods with: "The heat has not burned..." [7.19.2], "Together with splendor..." [6.53.3], "The wives of the gods..." [9.7.6], and "O good master of the household..." [12.2.45cd].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgnihomān | tṛtīyam ulūkhale musale iti |
meaning: दक्षिणाग्निहोमान् । तृतीयम् उलूखले मुसले इति ।
text_mt: [He impels] the oblations in the dakṣiṇa fire; the third with: "In the mortar, in the pestle..." [10.9.26].

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhraḥ saṃmārgam agnau praharati yo agnau iti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रः संमार्गम् अग्नौ प्रहरति यो अग्नौ इति ।
text_mt: The āgnīdhra throws the cleansing brush into the fire with: "He who in the fire..." [7.92.1].

sanskrit_iast: vi te muñcāmi ahaṃ vi ṣyāmi pra tvā muñcāmi iti patnīṃ yoktreṇa vimucyamānām anumantrayate |
meaning: वि ते मुञ्चामि अहं वि ष्यामि प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि इति पत्नीं योक्त्रेण विमुच्यमानाम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: With "I untie for you..." [7.83.1], "I loosen..." [14.1.57], and "I release you..." [14.1.19], he consecrates the sacrificer's wife as she is being untied from the girdle.

sanskrit_iast: vedaḥ svastiḥ iti vedaṃ vicṛtati |
meaning: वेदः स्वस्तिः इति वेदं विचृतति ।
text_mt: With "The veda is welfare..." [7.29], he unties the grass broom.

sanskrit_iast: samiṣṭayajuṣaḥ yān āvahaḥ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃsthitahomān juhoti | manasaspate ity āsām uttamā |
meaning: समिष्टयजुषः यान् आवहः इति षड्भिः संस्थितहोमान् जुहोति । मनसस्पते इत्य् आसाम् उत्तमा ।
text_mt: From the samiṣṭayajus formulas, he offers the concluding offerings with the six verses "Whom you have brought..." [7.102.3–8]; of these, the last is "O Lord of mind..." [7.102.8].

sanskrit_iast: praṇītā vimucyamānāḥ sasruṣīḥ ity anumantrayate |
meaning: प्रणीता विमुच्यमानाः सस्रुषीः इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates the holy water being dismissed with: "Having flowed..." [6.23].

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ prayājāḥ iti yajamānam āśāste |
meaning: येषां प्रयाजाः इति यजमानम् आशास्ते ।
text_mt: He blesses the sacrificer with: "Of whom the fore-offerings..." [1.30.4].

sanskrit_iast: yad annam iti bhāgaṃ prāśya deva savitar etat te prāha tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja | bṛhaspatir brahmā sa yajñaṃ pāhi sa yajñapatiṃ pāhi sa māṃ pāhi sa māṃ karmaṇyaṃ pāhi ity āha |
meaning: यद् अन्नम् इति भागं प्राश्य देव सवितर् एतत् ते प्राह तत् प्र च सुव प्र च यज । बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मा स यज्ञं पाहि स यज्ञपतिं पाहि स मां पाहि स मां कर्मण्यं पाहि इत्य् आह ।
text_mt: Having eaten the portion with "Whatever food..." [6.71], he says: "O god Savitṛ, this has he announced to you; impel it and sacrifice it; Bṛhaspati is the brahman priest: protect the sacrifice, protect the lord of the sacrifice, protect me, protect me who am capable of the rite!"

sanskrit_iast: yajamāna udapātre 'ñjalāv āsikte saṃ varcasā iti mukhaṃ vimārṣṭi |
meaning: यजमान उदपात्रे ऽञ्जलाव् आसिक्ते सं वर्चसा इति मुखं विमार्ष्टि ।
text_mt: Water having been poured into his cupped hands from the water vessel, the sacrificer wipes his face with: "Together with splendor..." [6.53.3].

sanskrit_iast: antareṇāparāgnī dakṣiṇenāgniṃ viṣṇukramādīkṣaṇāntam |
meaning: अन्तरेणापराग्नी दक्षिणेनाग्निं विष्णुक्रमादीक्षणान्तम् ।
text_mt:
Between the two western fires, south of the fire, up to the end of the steps of Viṣṇu and the gazing.

With "O Agni, master of the household...", he attends upon the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: agne gṛhapate iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अग्ने गृहपते इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।

sanskrit_iast: yasyoruṣu ity āhavanīyam abhivrajya prāṇāpānau ojo 'si iti uktam |
meaning: यस्योरुषु इत्य् आहवनीयम् अभिव्रज्य प्राणापानौ ओजो ऽसि इति उक्तम् ।
text_mt:
Having approached the āhavanīya fire with "In whose wide..." [7.26.3], the [mantras] "Out-breath and in-breath..." [2.16] and "You are vigor..." [2.17] have [already] been mentioned.

Having attended [the fires] with the two verses 'This Agni of ours…', he consumes his portion with 'May the lord of sacrifice, with blessing…'.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ no agniḥ iti dvābhyām upasthāya saṃ yajñapatir āśiṣā iti bhāgaṃ prāśnāti |
meaning: अयं नो अग्निः इति द्वाभ्याम् उपस्थाय सं यज्ञपतिर् आशिषा इति भागं प्राश्नाति ।

sanskrit_iast: vratāni vratapataye iti vratavisarjanīm ādadhāti |
meaning: व्रतानि व्रतपतये इति व्रतविसर्जनीम् आदधाति ।
text_mt: With 'Observances to the lord of observances…', he lays on the [firestick] that releases the observances.

sanskrit_iast: etasmād yājamānād ṛte apasiddhiḥ | tad api ślokau vadataḥ pravargyo yājamānāni patnīmantrāś ca tat trayam | aṅgaṃ ca yajñe bhavaty ṛte caibhyo 'pasiddhyati || pravargyāc chauryam āpnoti yājamānena cāśiṣaḥ | patnīmantraiḥ prajām āyus tasmāt tenaiva siddhyati || iti |
meaning: एतस्माद् याजमानाद् ऋते अपसिद्धिः । तद् अपि श्लोकौ वदतः प्रवर्ग्यो याजमानानि पत्नीमन्त्राश् च तत् त्रयम् । अङ्गं च यज्ञे भवत्य् ऋते चैभ्यो ऽपसिद्ध्यति ॥ प्रवर्ग्याच् छौर्यम् आप्नोति याजमानेन चाशिषः । पत्नीमन्त्रैः प्रजाम् आयुस् तस्मात् तेनैव सिद्ध्यति ॥ इति ।
text_mt: Without this [rite] of the sacrificer, there is failure. On this matter two verses also say: 'The Pravargya, the duties of the sacrificer, and the mantras of the wife—these three / become members in the sacrifice; and without them it fails. // From the Pravargya one obtains heroism, and through the [duties] of the sacrificer, blessings; / through the mantras of the wife, offspring and life-span; therefore it succeeds only through that.'

sanskrit_iast: darśapaurṇamāsau triṃśataṃ varṇāni | pañcadaśa dākṣāyaṇayajñaḥ |
meaning: दर्शपौर्णमासौ त्रिंशतं वर्णानि । पञ्चदश दाक्षायणयज्ञः ।
text_mt: The New and Full Moon sacrifices [are performed for] thirty years; the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice [for] fifteen.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsam aparedyuś ca | evam amāvāsyāyām |
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां पौर्णमासम् अपरेद्युश् च । एवम् अमावास्यायाम् ।
text_mt: On the full moon day the Full Moon sacrifice [is performed], and on the following day; likewise on the new moon day [the New Moon sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ vā |
meaning: संवत्सरं वा ।

sanskrit_iast: sākaṃprasthāyyādīni ca | etābhyām iṣṭayo vyākhyātā vyākhyātāḥ |
meaning: साकंप्रस्थाय्यादीनि च । एताभ्याम् इष्टयो व्याख्याता व्याख्याताः ।
text_mt: And the Sākaṃprasthāyya and others [are performed similarly]. By these two the [other] offerings have been explained, have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: athāgnyādheyam |
meaning: अथाग्न्याधेयम् ।

sanskrit_iast: vasante brāhmaṇāsya | grīṣme rājanyasya | varṣāsu vaiśyasya | trīṇi parvāṇi ity uktam |
meaning: वसन्ते ब्राह्मणास्य । ग्रीष्मे राजन्यस्य । वर्षासु वैश्यस्य । त्रीणि पर्वाणि इत्य् उक्तम् ।
text_mt: In the spring for a brāhmaṇa; in the summer for a kṣatriya; in the rainy season for a vaiśya. It has been stated: 'The three seasonal junctions'.

sanskrit_iast: yadaiva kadā cid ādadhyāc chraddhā tvevainaṃ nātīyāt |
meaning: यदैव कदा चिद् आदध्याच् छ्रद्धा त्वेवैनं नातीयात् ।
text_mt: He may establish [the fires] at whatever time, provided that faith does not pass him by. The cooked rice for the brahman priest has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: ukto brahmaudanaḥ |
meaning: उक्तो ब्रह्मौदनः ।

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvija upasādayati |
meaning: ऋत्विज उपसादयति ।

sanskrit_iast: abhimantritaṃ vādadhyāt |
meaning: अभिमन्त्रितं वादध्यात् ।
text_mt: Or he should establish [them] after consecrating [the kindling sticks] with mantras.

sanskrit_iast: yo aśvatthaḥ śamīgarbha āruroha tve sacā | taṃ te harāmi brahmaṇā yajñiyaiḥ ketubhiḥ saha || jātavedo bhuvanasya yad reta iha siñca tapaso yaj janiṣyate | agnim aśvatthād adhi havyavāhaṃ śamīgarbhāj janayan yo mayobhūḥ iti mantrokte araṇī gṛhṇantam ādhāsyamānaṃ vācayati |
meaning: यो अश्वत्थः शमीगर्भ आरुरोह त्वे सचा । तं ते हरामि ब्रह्मणा यज्ञियैः केतुभिः सह ॥ जातवेदो भुवनस्य यद् रेत इह सिञ्च तपसो यज् जनिष्यते । अग्निम् अश्वत्थाद् अधि हव्यवाहं शमीगर्भाज् जनयन् यो मयोभूः इति मन्त्रोक्ते अरणी गृह्णन्तम् आधास्यमानं वाचयति ।
text_mt: He causes the one who is about to establish [the fires], as he takes the two churning-sticks mentioned in the mantra, to recite: 'The aśvattha tree that mounted into the womb of the śamī tree, together with you; / that do I fetch for you with prayer, together with sacrificial banners. // O Jātavedas, what semen of the world, what will be born from heat, sprinkle that here; / Agni, the bearer of oblations, producing from the aśvattha born from the womb of the śamī, which is beneficial…'

sanskrit_iast: vāgyatā jāgrato rātrim āsate | pararātraṃ vā |
meaning: वाग्यता जाग्रतो रात्रिम् आसते । पररात्रं वा ।
text_mt: Restraining their speech, they sit awake through the night, or through the latter part of the night.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate savitaḥ iti svapato bodhayet |
meaning: बृहस्पते सवितः इति स्वपतो बोधयेत् ।
text_mt: With 'O Bṛhaspati, O Savitṛ…', he should awaken those who sleep.

sanskrit_iast: uṣasi śāntyudakaṃ karoti cityādibhir ātharvaṇībhiḥ kapūrviparvārodākāvṛkkāvatīnāḍānirdahantībhir āṅgirasībhiś ca | cātanair mātṛnāmabhir vāstoṣpatyair anuyojitaiḥ |
meaning: उषसि शान्त्युदकं करोति चित्यादिभिर् आथर्वणीभिः कपूर्विपर्वारोदाकावृक्कावतीनाडानिर्दहन्तीभिर् आङ्गिरसीभिश् च । चातनैर् मातृनामभिर् वास्तोष्पत्यैर् अनुयोजितैः ।
text_mt: At dawn he prepares the appeasement water with the Atharvan hymns beginning with Cityā, and with the Āṅgirasa hymns Kapūrvīparvā, Rodākā, Vṛkkāvatī, and Nādānirdahantī, followed by the cleansing hymns, the hymns addressing the Mothers, and the hymns addressed to Vāstoṣpati.

sanskrit_iast: tenāgnipadam aśvaṃ snāpayann abhyukṣañ chamayati |
meaning: तेनाग्निपदम् अश्वं स्नापयन्न् अभ्युक्षञ् छमयति ।
text_mt: Bathing and sprinkling with it the horse whose footstep [marks] the fire, he appeases it.

sanskrit_iast: anudita udite vādhāsyamānaḥ ākṛtiloṣṭetyādy upasthānāntam |
meaning: अनुदित उदिते वाधास्यमानः आकृतिलोष्टेत्याद्य् उपस्थानान्तम् ।
text_mt: Before sunrise or after sunrise, the one who is about to establish [the fires performs the rites] beginning with 'the clod of earth of determination' up to the attendance [on the fire].

sanskrit_iast: yat tvā kruddhāḥ ity upoddharanty ācāryāḥ | āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnyor lakṣaṇāntam |
meaning: यत् त्वा क्रुद्धाः इत्य् उपोद्धरन्त्य् आचार्याः । आहवनीयदक्षिणाग्न्योर् लक्षणान्तम् ।
text_mt: The teachers extract [and take up the fire] with 'If angry [they laid you down]…', up to the marking of the āhavanīya and the dakṣiṇa fires.

sanskrit_iast: purīṣyo 'si viśvabharāḥ | atharvā tvā prathamo nir amanthad agne || tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ || tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ | vṛtrahaṇaṃ puraṃdaram || tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam | dhanaṃjayaṃ raṇeraṇe iti mathyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: पुरीष्यो ऽसि विश्वभराः । अथर्वा त्वा प्रथमो निर् अमन्थद् अग्ने ॥ त्वाम् अग्ने पुष्कराद् अध्य् अथर्वा निर् अमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः ॥ तम् उ त्वा दध्यङ्ङ् ऋषिः पुत्र ईधे अथर्वणः । वृत्रहणं पुरंदरम् ॥ तम् उ त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा समीधे दस्युहन्तमम् । धनंजयं रणेरणे इति मथ्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: While [the fire] is being churned, he consecrates it with the mantra: 'You are terrestrial, all-supporting; / Agni, Atharvan churned you out first. // Agni, Atharvan churned you out from the blue lotus, / from the head of the all-priest. // And you, the sage Dadhyañc, the son of Atharvan, / kindled, the slayer of Vṛtra, the breaker of strongholds. // And you, Pāthya the bull, kindled, / the greatest slayer of Dasyus, the winner of wealth in battle after battle.'

sanskrit_iast: jātaṃ sujātaṃ jātavedasam iti |
meaning: जातं सुजातं जातवेदसम् इति ।
text_mt: [When it is] produced, [he consecrates it] with 'The well-born Jātavedas…'.

sanskrit_iast: jātarūpeṇāntardhāya | nāsikyenoṣmaṇāsyena vā | mayy agra ity etayāpānati |
meaning: जातरूपेणान्तर्धाय । नासिक्येनोष्मणास्येन वा । मय्य् अग्र इत्य् एतयापानति ।
text_mt: Having screened it with gold, he breathes out over it with the heat of his nose or with his mouth, with 'In me first…'.

sanskrit_iast: aśvapādaṃ lakṣaṇe nidhāpyamānaṃ sam adhvarāya ity anumantrayate |
meaning: अश्वपादं लक्षणे निधाप्यमानं सम् अध्वराय इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: As the horse's foot is being placed on the marked spot, he consecrates it with 'Together for the sacrifice…'.

sanskrit_iast: rathenāgnau praṇīyamāne 'śve 'nvārabdhaṃ vācayati |
meaning: रथेनाग्नौ प्रणीयमाने ऽश्वे ऽन्वारब्धं वाचयति ।
text_mt: While the fire is being carried forward on a chariot, he makes the one who holds onto the horse recite:

sanskrit_iast: yad akrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyant samudrād uta vā purīṣāt | śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan || yad akrandaḥ salile jāto arvant sahasvān vājin balavān balena | taṃ tvādadhur brahmaṇe bhāgam agne atharvāṇaḥ sāmavedo yajūṃṣi || ṛgbhiḥ pūtaṃ prajāpatir atharvaṇe 'śvaṃ prathamaṃ nināya | tasya pade prathamaṃ jyotir ādadhe sa mā vahāti sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ || abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyato mahyaṃ prajām āyuś ca vājin dhehi | tvayā vadheyaṃ dviṣataḥ sapatnān svargaṃ me lokaṃ yajamānāya dhehi || abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyataḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ | yathāham abhibhūḥ sarvāṇi tāni dhūrvato janān iti |
meaning: यद् अक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमान उद्यन्त् समुद्राद् उत वा पुरीषात् । श्येनस्य पक्षा हरिणस्य बाहू उपस्तुत्यं महि जातं ते अर्वन् ॥ यद् अक्रन्दः सलिले जातो अर्वन्त् सहस्वान् वाजिन् बलवान् बलेन । तं त्वादधुर् ब्रह्मणे भागम् अग्ने अथर्वाणः सामवेदो यजूंषि ॥ ऋग्भिः पूतं प्रजापतिर् अथर्वणे ऽश्वं प्रथमं निनाय । तस्य पदे प्रथमं ज्योतिर् आदधे स मा वहाति सुकृतां यत्र लोकः ॥ अभितिष्ठ पृतन्यतो मह्यं प्रजाम् आयुश् च वाजिन् धेहि । त्वया वधेयं द्विषतः सपत्नान् स्वर्गं मे लोकं यजमानाय धेहि ॥ अभितिष्ठ पृतन्यतः सहस्व पृतनायतः । यथाहम् अभिभूः सर्वाणि तानि धूर्वतो जनान् इति ।
text_mt: 'When you neighed first as you were born, rising up from the ocean or from the water, / with the wings of an eagle and the forelegs of an antelope—great was your birth to be praised, O courser! // When you neighed, born in the water, O courser, victorious, strong, powerful with might, / you the Atharvans, the Sāmaveda, and the yajus formulas placed as a portion for the brahman priest, O Agni! // Purified by ṛc verses, Prajāpati first led the horse to Atharvan; / in its footprint he first placed the light; may it carry me to where the realm of the righteous is. // Trample upon those who fight against me; bestow offspring and life upon me, O swift one! / By you may I slay my hating rivals; bestow the heavenly realm upon me, the sacrificer! // Trample upon those who fight against me; overcome the hostile armies, / so that I may be victorious over all those malevolent people!'

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnī gārhapatyāt saha praṇīyamāṇau vyākaromi ity anumantrayate |
meaning: आहवनीयदक्षिणाग्नी गार्हपत्यात् सह प्रणीयमाणौ व्याकरोमि इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: While the āhavanīya and dakṣiṇa fires are being carried forward together from the gārhapatya, he consecrates them with 'I separate…'.

sanskrit_iast: āhitam āhavanīyam āyaṃ gauḥ ity upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: आहितम् आहवनीयम् आयं गौः इत्य् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: He attends upon the established āhavanīya with 'This cow…'.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgnir nirmathya āhāryo vā |
meaning: दक्षिणाग्निर् निर्मथ्य आहार्यो वा ।
text_mt: The dakṣiṇa fire is to be churned out or fetched.

sanskrit_iast: sabhyāvasathyayor āhavanīyād vihāraḥ | sabhyād vāvasathyasya | sabhyaḥ sabhāyai | āvasathya āvasathāya |
meaning: सभ्यावसथ्ययोर् आहवनीयाद् विहारः । सभ्याद् वावसथ्यस्य । सभ्यः सभायै । आवसथ्य आवसथाय ।
text_mt: The dispersal of the sabhya and āvasathya fires is from the āhavanīya, or the āvasathya from the sabhya. The sabhya fire is for the hall; the āvasathya fire is for the dwelling.

sanskrit_iast: agnipadam aśvaṃ rathaṃ cātuṣprāśyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadāti |
meaning: अग्निपदम् अश्वं रथं चातुष्प्राश्यां हिरण्यं च ब्रह्मणे ददाति ।
text_mt: He gives to the brahman priest the horse whose foot [marked] the fire, a chariot, the cow suitable for four to eat, and gold.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ tvāhur vaiśvānaraṃ sadanān pradahan nv agāḥ | sa no devatrādhi brūhi mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ity aśvaṃ śamayitvā yad akrandaḥ ity upākurute |
meaning: अग्निं त्वाहुर् वैश्वानरं सदनान् प्रदहन् न्व् अगाः । स नो देवत्राधि ब्रूहि मा रिषामा वयं तव इत्य् अश्वं शमयित्वा यद् अक्रन्दः इत्य् उपाकुरुते ।
text_mt: Having appeased the horse with 'They call you Agni Vaiśvānara; burning [the demons] from their seats, you have gone; / do speak for us among the gods; may we not come to harm, being yours', he presents it with 'When you neighed…'. Having offered over the chariot with 'Indra's strength, the front line of the Maruts…', he mounts it with 'O lord of the forest, firm of limb…'.

sanskrit_iast: indrasyaujo marutām anīkam iti ratham abhi hutvā vanaspate vīḍvaṅgaḥ ity ātiṣṭhati |
meaning: इन्द्रस्यौजो मरुताम् अनीकम् इति रथम् अभि हुत्वा वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गः इत्य् आतिष्ठति ।

sanskrit_iast: upaviśya pūrṇahomam upa tvā namasā iti |
meaning: उपविश्य पूर्णहोमम् उप त्वा नमसा इति ।
text_mt: Having sat down, [he offers] the full oblation with 'Unto you with reverence…'.

sanskrit_iast: idam ugrāya ity anvaktān akṣān videvanāyādhvaryave prayacchati |
meaning: इदम् उग्राय इत्य् अन्वक्तान् अक्षान् विदेवनायाध्वर्यवे प्रयच्छति ।
text_mt: With 'This to the fierce one…', he hands over the anointed dice to the adhvaryu for gambling.

sanskrit_iast: āgnyādheyikīṣv iṣṭiṣv agneḥ pavamānasya pāvakasya śucer aditer iti pavamānaḥ punātu tveṣas te agnī rakṣāṃsi aditir dyauḥ iti |
meaning: आग्न्याधेयिकीष्व् इष्टिष्व् अग्नेः पवमानस्य पावकस्य शुचेर् अदितेर् इति पवमानः पुनातु त्वेषस् ते अग्नी रक्षांसि अदितिर् द्यौः इति ।
text_mt: In the iṣṭis of the establishment of the fires, for Agni Pavamāna, Pāvaka, Śuci, and Aditi, [the respective offerings are made] with: "May Pavamāna purify", "Thy dreadful [glance]", "Agni, [slay] the demons", [and] "Aditi is heaven".

sanskrit_iast: yajamāno dvādaśarātram upavatsyadbhaktam ity uktam |
meaning: यजमानो द्वादशरात्रम् उपवत्स्यद्भक्तम् इत्य् उक्तम् ।
text_mt: The sacrificer shall fast for twelve nights on what is prescribed, as stated [in the Kauśikasūtra].

sanskrit_iast: brahmacārī vraty adho 'gnīn upaśete |
meaning: ब्रह्मचारी व्रत्य् अधो ऽग्नीन् उपशेते ।
text_mt: Chaste and observing his vow, he sleeps on the ground near the fires.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃprātar agnihotram |
meaning: सायंप्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम् ।
text_mt: The Agnihotra [is performed] evening and morning.

sanskrit_iast: gavīḍāṃ dohayitvāgnihotram adhiśrayati |
meaning: गवीडां दोहयित्वाग्निहोत्रम् अधिश्रयति ।
text_mt: Having had the cow's milk portion milked, he sets the Agnihotra [milk] on the fire.

sanskrit_iast: abhijvālya samudvāntam adbhiḥ pratyānīyodag udvāsayati |
meaning: अभिज्वाल्य समुद्वान्तम् अद्भिः प्रत्यानीयोदग् उद्वासयति ।
text_mt: Having made [the fire] flare up, he sprinkles water over it when it has boiled up and removes it towards the north.

sanskrit_iast: agniparistaraṇaṃ paryukṣaṇam ṛtaṃ tvā iti |
meaning: अग्निपरिस्तरणं पर्युक्षणम् ऋतं त्वा इति ।
text_mt: The strewing around of the fires and the circumambulatory sprinkling with water [are performed] with: "Thee, cosmic order..."

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyād āhavanīyam udakadhārāṃ ninayaty amṛtam asy amṛtam amṛtena saṃdhehi iti |
meaning: गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयम् उदकधारां निनयत्य् अमृतम् अस्य् अमृतम् अमृतेन संधेहि इति ।
text_mt: He pours a stream of water from the gārhapatya to the āhavanīya with: "Thou art immortality; join immortality with immortality!"

sanskrit_iast: sruksruvaṃ prakṣālitaṃ pratapati niṣṭaptam iti |
meaning: स्रुक्स्रुवं प्रक्षालितं प्रतपति निष्टप्तम् इति ।
text_mt: He heats the washed ladles, the sruc and sruva, with: "Burnt away [is the evil]..."

sanskrit_iast: sruveṇa sruci grahān unnayati
meaning: स्रुवेण स्रुचि ग्रहान् उन्नयति
text_mt: With the sruva he scoops up the draughts into the sruc. / Lifting the sruc with the kindling-stick on top level with his mouth, he steps forward towards the āhavanīya with: "Here I lift the sacrificer to the heavenly world."

sanskrit_iast: samiduttarāṃ srucaṃ mukhasaṃmitām udgṛhyāhavanīyam abhiprakrāmati idam ahaṃ yajamānaṃ svargaṃ lokam unnayāmi iti |
meaning: समिदुत्तरां स्रुचं मुखसंमिताम् उद्गृह्याहवनीयम् अभिप्रक्रामति इदम् अहं यजमानं स्वर्गं लोकम् उन्नयामि इति ।

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣi nidhāya samidham ādadhāty agnijyotiṣaṃ tvā vāyumatīṃ prāṇavatīṃ svargyāṃ svargāyopadadhāmi bhāsvatīm iti |
meaning: बर्हिषि निधाय समिधम् आदधात्य् अग्निज्योतिषं त्वा वायुमतीं प्राणवतीं स्वर्ग्यां स्वर्गायोपदधामि भास्वतीम् इति ।
text_mt: Placing [the ladle] on the sacred grass, he puts on the kindling-stick with: "With the light of Agni, accompanied by wind, accompanied by breath, leading to heaven, I place thee, the radiant, for heaven."

sanskrit_iast: sūryajyotiṣam iti prātaḥ |
meaning: सूर्यज्योतिषम् इति प्रातः ।
text_mt: In the morning, [he recites instead]: "With the light of Sūrya..."

sanskrit_iast: pradīptām abhijuhoti sajūr devena savitrā sajū rātryendravatyā | juṣāṇo agnir vetu svāhā iti | sajūr uṣasā iti juṣāṇaḥ sūryaḥ iti prātaḥ |
meaning: प्रदीप्ताम् अभिजुहोति सजूर् देवेन सवित्रा सजू रात्र्येन्द्रवत्या । जुषाणो अग्निर् वेतु स्वाहा इति । सजूर् उषसा इति जुषाणः सूर्यः इति प्रातः ।
text_mt: Over [the kindling-stick] once it has flared up, he offers with: "In union with the god Savitṛ, in union with the night accompanied by Indra, may Agni, being pleased, partake, svāhā!" In the morning: "In union with the dawn..." [and] "May Sūrya, being pleased..."

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ mā loko 'nusaṃtanutām iti gārhapatyam avekṣya prajāpate na tvad etāny anyaḥ iti manasaiva pūrṇatarām uttarāṃ juhoti |
meaning: अयं मा लोको ऽनुसंतनुताम् इति गार्हपत्यम् अवेक्ष्य प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्यः इति मनसैव पूर्णतराम् उत्तरां जुहोति ।
text_mt: Looking at the gārhapatya with: "May this world perpetuate itself for me", he offers the second [oblation], fuller [than the first], silently with the mind, with: "O Prajāpati, none other than thou..."

sanskrit_iast: sruvaṃ trir udañcam unnayati rudrān prīṇāmi iti |
meaning: स्रुवं त्रिर् उदञ्चम् उन्नयति रुद्रान् प्रीणामि इति ।
text_mt: Three times he raises the sruva towards the north with: "I gratify the Rudras."

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣi nidhāyonmṛjyottarataḥ pāṇī nimārṣṭy oṣadhivanaspatīn prīṇāmi iti |
meaning: बर्हिषि निधायोन्मृज्योत्तरतः पाणी निमार्ष्ट्य् ओषधिवनस्पतीन् प्रीणामि इति ।
text_mt: Placing [the ladle] on the sacred grass and wiping it upwards, he wipes his hands off towards the north with: "I gratify the herbs and trees."

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyam unmṛjya pitryupavītaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāṃ karomi iti |
meaning: द्वितीयम् उन्मृज्य पित्र्युपवीतं कृत्वा दक्षिणतः पितृभ्यः स्वधां करोमि इति ।
text_mt: Wiping it a second time and wearing his sacred thread in the ancestral manner, [he wipes off his hands] towards the south with: "To the fathers I make svadhā."

sanskrit_iast: aparāgnyoḥ kāmyam agnihotraṃ nityam ity ācāryāḥ |
meaning: अपराग्न्योः काम्यम् अग्निहोत्रं नित्यम् इत्य् आचार्याः ।
text_mt: The Agnihotra in the two other fires is optional; it is obligatory, say the teachers.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye samidham ādhāya sthālyāḥ sruveṇa juhoti iha puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātv iha prajāṃ ramayatu prajāpatiḥ | agnaye gṛhapataye rayimate puṣṭipataye svāhā iti |
meaning: गार्हपत्ये समिधम् आधाय स्थाल्याः स्रुवेण जुहोति इह पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर् दधात्व् इह प्रजां रमयतु प्रजापतिः । अग्नये गृहपतये रयिमते पुष्टिपतये स्वाहा इति ।
text_mt: Having placed a kindling-stick on the gārhapatya, he offers from the cooking-pot with the sruva: "May the lord of prosperity establish prosperity here, may Prajāpati delight the offspring here; to Agni, lord of the house, possessor of wealth, lord of prosperity, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: uktottarā |
meaning: उक्तोत्तरा ।

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgnāv agnaye 'nnādāyānnapataye svāhā iti pūrvā |
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नाव् अग्नये ऽन्नादायान्नपतये स्वाहा इति पूर्वा ।
text_mt:
In the dakṣiṇa fire, the first [oblation is made] with: "To Agni the food-eater, lord of food, svāhā!"

Having sprinkled with: "Truth by cosmic order...", he places the sruva, the sruc, and the sacred grass to the north of the fire.

sanskrit_iast: satyaṃ tvartena iti paryukṣya sruvaṃ srucaṃ barhiś cottareṇāgniṃ nidadhāti |
meaning: सत्यं त्वर्तेन इति पर्युक्ष्य स्रुवं स्रुचं बर्हिश् चोत्तरेणाग्निं निदधाति ।

sanskrit_iast: srukśeṣaṃ prāśnāti |
meaning: स्रुक्शेषं प्राश्नाति ।

sanskrit_iast: prāṇān prīṇāmi ity upaspṛśya | garbhān iti dvitīyam | viśvān devān ity antataḥ sarvam | aprakṣālitayodakaṃ srucā ninayati sarpetarajanān iti | barhiṣi prakṣālya sarpapuṇyajanān iti dvitīyam | gandharvāpsarasa ity apareṇa tṛtīyam |
meaning: प्राणान् प्रीणामि इत्य् उपस्पृश्य । गर्भान् इति द्वितीयम् । विश्वान् देवान् इत्य् अन्ततः सर्वम् । अप्रक्षालितयोदकं स्रुचा निनयति सर्पेतरजनान् इति । बर्हिषि प्रक्षाल्य सर्पपुण्यजनान् इति द्वितीयम् । गन्धर्वाप्सरस इत्य् अपरेण तृतीयम् ।
text_mt: Having touched [water] with: "I gratify the life-breaths", a second time with: "The embryos", and at the end everything with: "All the gods", he pours out water with the unwashed sruc with: "[I gratify] the serpents and other folks"; having washed it on the sacred grass, a second time with: "The serpents and holy folks"; to the west, a third time with: "The Gandharvas and Apsarases."

sanskrit_iast: saptarṣīn iti sruvaṃ srucaṃ ca pratapati |
meaning: सप्तर्षीन् इति स्रुवं स्रुचं च प्रतपति ।
text_mt: With: "The Seven Ṛṣis", he heats the sruva and the sruc. / With: "I lead [them] to the south", he wipes down the handle of the sruc; in the morning, he wipes it upwards.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇān nayāmīti srugdaṇḍam avamārṣṭi | prātar unmārṣṭi |
meaning: दक्षिणान् नयामीति स्रुग्दण्डम् अवमार्ष्टि । प्रातर् उन्मार्ष्टि ।

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇoktam agnyupasthānam |
meaning: ब्राह्मणोक्तम् अग्न्युपस्थानम् ।
text_mt: The attendance on the fires is as prescribed in the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: atha gavīḍādibhreṣe tasyai tasyai devatāyai juhuyāt |
meaning: अथ गवीडादिभ्रेषे तस्यै तस्यै देवतायै जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: Now, if there is a failure concerning the cow's milk portion and the like, he should offer to each respective deity.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśyām āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped darśapūrṇamāsāv āripsamāno agnāviṣṇū iti |
meaning: त्रयोदश्याम् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् दर्शपूर्णमासाव् आरिप्समानो अग्नाविष्णू इति ।
text_mt: On the thirteenth day, wishing to undertake the New and Full Moon sacrifices, he should offer a cake on eleven potsherds to Agni-and-Viṣṇu with: "Agni and Viṣṇu..."

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaṃ paurṇamāsam ārabhamāṇaḥ sarasvatyai ca caruṃ sarasvate dvādaśakapālaṃ sarasvati vrateṣu yasya vratam iti |
meaning: पूर्वं पौर्णमासम् आरभमाणः सरस्वत्यै च चरुं सरस्वते द्वादशकपालं सरस्वति व्रतेषु यस्य व्रतम् इति ।
text_mt: Beginning first with the Full Moon sacrifice, [he offers] also a pap to Sarasvatī and a cake on twelve potsherds to Sarasvat with: "Sarasvatī, in the observances..." [and] "Whose observance..."

sanskrit_iast: ādhānād vṛddhiś ced arvāk saṃvatsarād rohiṇyām utsṛjyāgnihotraṃ punarvasvoḥ punar ādadhītoṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om iti |
meaning: आधानाद् वृद्धिश् चेद् अर्वाक् संवत्सराद् रोहिण्याम् उत्सृज्याग्निहोत्रं पुनर्वस्वोः पुनर् आदधीतों भूर् भुवः स्वर् जनद् ओम् इति ।
text_mt: If there is prosperity after the establishment [of the fires], having relinquished the Agnihotra before the completion of a year under Rohiṇī, he should re-establish [the fires] under Punarvasu with: "Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om!"

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhīṣu pakvāsv āgrayaṇeṣṭiḥ |
meaning: ओषधीषु पक्वास्व् आग्रयणेष्टिः ।
text_mt: When the plants have ripened, the first-fruits offering (āgrayaṇa) takes place.

sanskrit_iast: idāvatsarāya iti purastāddhomasaṃsthitahomeṣv āvapeta |
meaning: इदावत्सराय इति पुरस्ताद्धोमसंस्थितहोमेष्व् आवपेत ।
text_mt: He inserts [the verse]: "To the current year..." in the preliminary offerings and concluding offerings.

sanskrit_iast: agna indra ity āgnendram | aindrāgnaṃ ca indrāgnī asmān iti |
meaning: अग्न इन्द्र इत्य् आग्नेन्द्रम् । ऐन्द्राग्नं च इन्द्राग्नी अस्मान् इति ।
text_mt: [The offering] to Agni-and-Indra is with: "O Agni, Indra...", and that to Indra-and-Agni is with: "Indra and Agni, to us..."

sanskrit_iast: yad vidvāṃsaḥ dvāvāpṛthivī upaśrutyā somo vīrudhām iti vaiśvadevadyāvāpṛthivīyasaumyān |
meaning: यद् विद्वांसः द्वावापृथिवी उपश्रुत्या सोमो वीरुधाम् इति वैश्वदेवद्यावापृथिवीयसौम्यान् ।
text_mt: The offerings to All-the-Gods, to Heaven-and-Earth, and to Soma [are made respectively] with: "What, knowing...", "Heaven and Earth, having heard...", [and] "Soma of the plants..."

sanskrit_iast: phālgunyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cāturmāsyāni prayuñjīta |
meaning: फाल्गुन्यां पौर्णमास्यां चातुर्मास्यानि प्रयुञ्जीत ।
text_mt: On the full moon day of the month of Phālguna, he should undertake the four-month sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyur vaiśvānarapārjanyeṣṭir vā agne vaiśvānara abhi kranda stanaya iti |
meaning: पूर्वेद्युर् वैश्वानरपार्जन्येष्टिर् वा अग्ने वैश्वानर अभि क्रन्द स्तनय इति ।
text_mt: Or on the previous day, the iṣṭi to Agni Vaiśvānara and Parjanya [takes place] with: "O Agni Vaiśvānara..." [and] "Cry out, thunder..."

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadeve nirmathyaṃ prahṛtaṃ bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau ity anumantrayate |
meaning: वैश्वदेवे निर्मथ्यं प्रहृतं भवतं नः समनसौ इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: In the Vaiśvadeva [offering], he consecrates with a mantra the churned [fire] when brought forward with: "Be of one mind with us..."

sanskrit_iast: agnāv agniḥ iti homam |
meaning: अग्नाव् अग्निः इति होमम् ।

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ nirmanthanam |
meaning: एवं निर्मन्थनम् ।

sanskrit_iast: āgneyaṃ saumyaṃ sāvitraṃ sārasvataṃ pauṣṇaṃ mārutaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dyāvāpṛthivīyam agnir vanaspatīnām somo vīrudhām savitā prasavānām sarasvati vrateṣu prapathe pathām marutaḥ parvatānām viśve devā mama dyāvāpṛthivī dātṝṇām iti |
meaning: आग्नेयं सौम्यं सावित्रं सारस्वतं पौष्णं मारुतं वैश्वदेवं द्यावापृथिवीयम् अग्निर् वनस्पतीनाम् सोमो वीरुधाम् सविता प्रसवानाम् सरस्वति व्रतेषु प्रपथे पथाम् मरुतः पर्वतानाम् विश्वे देवा मम द्यावापृथिवी दातॄणाम् इति ।
text_mt: [The offerings] to Agni, Soma, Savitṛ, Sarasvatī, Pūṣan, the Maruts, the Viśve Devas, and Heaven-and-Earth [are performed respectively with]: "Agni of the trees", "Soma of the plants", "Savitṛ of impulses", "Sarasvatī, in the observances", "On the far path of paths", "The Maruts of the mountains", "May all the gods [protect] mine", [and] "Heaven and Earth of the givers".

sanskrit_iast: vājinasya arvācīnaṃ vasuvidam iti |
meaning: वाजिनस्य अर्वाचीनं वसुविदम् इति ।
text_mt: For [the offering of] the whey [the mantra is]: 'Hitherward, wealth-finding...' (AV 3.16.6cd).

sanskrit_iast: tasya prāṇabhakṣān bhakṣayanti hotradhvaryubrahmāgnīdhrāḥ | pratyakṣaṃ yajamānaḥ | mithaḥ samupahūya |
meaning: तस्य प्राणभक्षान् भक्षयन्ति होत्रध्वर्युब्रह्माग्नीध्राः । प्रत्यक्षं यजमानः । मिथः समुपहूय ।
text_mt: The hotṛ, adhvaryu, brahman, and āgnīdhra consume portions of it by breathing upon [them]; the sacrificer manifestly, having mutually invited one another.

sanskrit_iast: yan me retaḥ prasicyate yad vā me apagacchati yad vā jāyate punas tena mā śivam āviśa | tena mā vājinaṃ kṛṇu tena suprajasaṃ kṛṇu tasya te vājipītasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi || iti prakṛtiḥ |
meaning: यन् मे रेतः प्रसिच्यते यद् वा मे अपगच्छति यद् वा जायते पुनस् तेन मा शिवम् आविश । तेन मा वाजिनं कृणु तेन सुप्रजसं कृणु तस्य ते वाजिपीतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि ॥ इति प्रकृतिः ।

sanskrit_iast: āṣāḍhyāṃ varuṇapraghāseṣv agnyoḥ praṇīyamānayor agne prehi iti japann eti |
meaning: आषाढ्यां वरुणप्रघासेष्व् अग्न्योः प्रणीयमानयोर् अग्ने प्रेहि इति जपन्न् एति ।

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇam agnim upaviśati |
meaning: दक्षिणम् अग्निम् उपविशति ।
text_mt: He sits down near the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: purastād ativrajyottare 'gnau hutvā dakṣiṇe juhoti |
meaning: पुरस्ताद् अतिव्रज्योत्तरे ऽग्नौ हुत्वा दक्षिणे जुहोति ।
text_mt: Having crossed over in front and made an offering in the northern fire, he makes an offering in the southern [fire].

sanskrit_iast: aticāraṃ pṛṣṭāṃ patnīm idam āpaḥ pra vahata iti mārjayanti |
meaning: अतिचारं पृष्टां पत्नीम् इदम् आपः प्र वहत इति मार्जयन्ति ।
text_mt: They wipe clean the wife, who has been questioned about transgression, with: 'Carry away, O waters, this...' (AV 7.89.3).

sanskrit_iast: pauṣṇāntān pañca |
meaning: पौष्णान्तान् पञ्च ।

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnaṃ vāruṇaṃ mārutaṃ kāyaṃ varuṇo 'pāṃ ya ātmadāḥ iti |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नं वारुणं मारुतं कायं वरुणो ऽपां य आत्मदाः इति ।
text_mt: [The offerings are] to Indra and Agni, to Varuṇa, to the Maruts, and to Ka, with: 'Varuṇa of the waters...' (AV 5.24.4) and 'He who gives the breath of life...' (AV 4.2.1).

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthaḥ somāt || antareṇa vedī viṣṇukramāḥ |
meaning: अवभृथः सोमात् ॥ अन्तरेण वेदी विष्णुक्रमाः ।

sanskrit_iast: kārttikyāṃ sākamedhāḥ |
meaning: कार्त्तिक्यां साकमेधाः ।
text_mt: On the full moon of Kārttika [occur] the Sākamedha rites.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyur iṣṭyām agner anīkavato acikradat iti | madhyaṃdine sāṃtapanānāṃ marutāṃ sāṃtapanā idam iti | sāyaṃ gṛhamedhināṃ tigmam anīkam iti |
meaning: पूर्वेद्युर् इष्ट्याम् अग्नेर् अनीकवतो अचिक्रदत् इति । मध्यंदिने सांतपनानां मरुतां सांतपना इदम् इति । सायं गृहमेधिनां तिग्मम् अनीकम् इति ।
text_mt: On the preceding day, in the sacrifice to Agni Anīkavat, [the mantra is]: 'He has cried...' (AV 3.3.1); at midday for the Sāṃtapana Maruts, 'O Sāṃtapanas, here...' (AV 7.77.1); in the evening for the Gṛhamedhin [Maruts], 'Sharp is the front...' (AV 4.27.7).

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgād īḍāntā |
meaning: आज्यभागाद् ईडान्ता ।

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte pūrṇadarvyaṃ pūrṇā darve iti |
meaning: श्वो भूते पूर्णदर्व्यं पूर्णा दर्वे इति ।

sanskrit_iast: krīḍināṃ marutāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ niyānam iti |
meaning: क्रीडिनां मरुतां कृष्णं नियानम् इति ।

sanskrit_iast: māhendryāṃ ṣaḍ aindrāgnāntān |
meaning: माहेन्द्र्यां षड् ऐन्द्राग्नान्तान् ।
text_mt: In the offering to Mahendra, [there are] six [offerings] ending with that to Indra and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: māhendraṃ vaiśvakarmaṇaṃ ye bhakṣayantaḥ iti |
meaning: माहेन्द्रं वैश्वकर्मणं ये भक्षयन्तः इति ।
text_mt: [Then] to Mahendra and to Viśvakarman, with: 'Those consuming...' (AV 2.35.1).

sanskrit_iast: pitryāyām ājyabhāgāntaṃ daivāvṛt | somāya pitṛmate | pitṛbhyaḥ somavaḍbhyaḥ vā barhiṣadaḥ pitaraḥ upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ agniṣvāttāḥ pitaraḥ agnaye kavyavāhanāya iti |
meaning: पित्र्यायाम् आज्यभागान्तं दैवावृत् । सोमाय पितृमते । पितृभ्यः सोमवड्भ्यः वा बर्हिषदः पितरः उपहूता नः पितरः अग्निष्वात्ताः पितरः अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय इति ।
text_mt: In the ancestral rite, up to the butter portion, the turn is toward the gods; [the oblations are] with: 'To Soma accompanied by the ancestors; to the ancestors rich in Soma...' (AV 18.4.72-73) or 'The ancestors seated on the sacred grass...' (AV 18.1.51), 'Invited are our ancestors...' (AV 18.3.45), 'The Agniṣvātta ancestors...' (AV 18.3.44), 'To Agni the bearer of funeral offerings...' (AV 18.4.71).

sanskrit_iast: purastāddhomān dakṣiṇāgner atipraṇīte juhoti |
meaning: पुरस्ताद्धोमान् दक्षिणाग्नेर् अतिप्रणीते जुहोति ।
text_mt: He offers the preliminary oblations into the fire carried forward from the dakṣiṇa fire.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāgnim atikramya pratyaṅṅ upaviśati | uttareṇa yajamāna āgnīdhraś ca |
meaning: दक्षिणेनाग्निम् अतिक्रम्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् उपविशति । उत्तरेण यजमान आग्नीध्रश् च ।
text_mt: Having stepped across to the south of the fire, he sits down facing west; to the north, the sacrificer and the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: astu svadhā iti pratyāśrāvayat |
meaning: अस्तु स्वधा इति प्रत्याश्रावयत् ।
text_mt: He causes the call of response to be made with: 'Let there be svadhā.'

sanskrit_iast: tad api ślokau vadataḥ pitryāyāṃ prāṅmukho brahmā hutvā homān purogamān | gatvā tu dakṣiṇenāgneḥ pratyaṅṅ āsīta karmaṇi || āgnīdhro yajamānaś cottareṇa tu tāv ubhau astu svadheti vaktavyaṃ pratyāśrāvaṇam atra tu iti |
meaning: तद् अपि श्लोकौ वदतः पित्र्यायां प्राङ्मुखो ब्रह्मा हुत्वा होमान् पुरोगमान् । गत्वा तु दक्षिणेनाग्नेः प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीत कर्मणि ॥ आग्नीध्रो यजमानश् चोत्तरेण तु ताव् उभौ अस्तु स्वधेति वक्तव्यं प्रत्याश्रावणम् अत्र तु इति ।

sanskrit_iast: iḍām avajighrati |
meaning: इडाम् अवजिघ्रति ।

sanskrit_iast: pariṣikte daivāvṛt | śaṃyvantā |
meaning: परिषिक्ते दैवावृत् । शंय्वन्ता ।
text_mt: When [the fire] is sprinkled with water, the turn is toward the gods; [the rite] ends with the śaṃyu [formula].

sanskrit_iast: vimitān niṣkrāmanto japanti ayā viṣṭhā iti |
meaning: विमितान् निष्क्रामन्तो जपन्ति अया विष्ठा इति ।
text_mt: Departing from the shed, they recite in a whisper: 'By this position...' (AV 7.3.1).

sanskrit_iast: prāñco 'bhyutkramya ud asya ketavaḥ ity ādityam upatiṣṭhante |
meaning: प्राञ्चो ऽभ्युत्क्रम्य उद् अस्य केतवः इत्य् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ते ।
text_mt: Stepping out toward the east, they pay homage to the sun with: 'Up his rays...' (AV 13.2.1).

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāñco divaṃ pṛthivīm ity agnīn |
meaning: दक्षिणाञ्चो दिवं पृथिवीम् इत्य् अग्नीन् ।
text_mt: [Turning] to the south, to the fires with: 'To heaven and earth...' (AV 3.21.7).

sanskrit_iast: athodañcaś catuṣpathe traiyambakaṃ yo agnau iti |
meaning: अथोदञ्चश् चतुष्पथे त्रैयम्बकं यो अग्नौ इति ।
text_mt: Then, [going] northwards, [they offer] at the crossroad the Traiyambaka cake with: 'He who in the fire...' (AV 7.78.1).

sanskrit_iast: yajamānāryajanāḥ savyahastapuroḍāśā dakṣiṇān ūrūn āghnānās triḥ prasavyam agnim anupariyanti tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt iti |
meaning: यजमानार्यजनाः सव्यहस्तपुरोडाशा दक्षिणान् ऊरून् आघ्नानास् त्रिः प्रसव्यम् अग्निम् अनुपरियन्ति त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकम् इव बन्धनान् मृत्योर् मुक्षीय मामृतात् इति ।
text_mt: The sacrificer and his noble family members, holding the sacrificial cakes in their left hands, beating their right thighs, circumambulate the fire three times counter-clockwise, [reciting]: 'We worship Tryambaka, the sweet-scented increaser of nourishment; like a gourd from its stem, may I be freed from death, not from immortality' (ṚV 7.59.12).

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇahastapuroḍāśāḥ pradakṣiṇam |
meaning: दक्षिणहस्तपुरोडाशाः प्रदक्षिणम् ।
text_mt: [Then] holding the sacrificial cakes in their right hands, clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: mūtayoḥ pramuktayor yo naḥ svaḥ iti japati |
meaning: मूतयोः प्रमुक्तयोर् यो नः स्वः इति जपति ।
text_mt: When the two baskets are untied, he recites in a whisper: 'He who is our own...' (AV 1.19.3).

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāvṛta āvrajanti |
meaning: दक्षिणावृत आव्रजन्ति ।
text_mt: Turning to the right, they return.

sanskrit_iast: athādityeṣṭiḥ |
meaning: अथादित्येष्टिः ।

sanskrit_iast: phālgunyāṃ śunāsīryam |
meaning: फाल्गुन्यां शुनासीर्यम् ।
text_mt: On the full moon of Phālguna [occurs] the Śunāsīrya rite.

sanskrit_iast: punaḥprayoge pūrvedyuḥ |
meaning: पुनःप्रयोगे पूर्वेद्युः ।
text_mt: In the case of repeated performance, [it takes place] on the preceding day.

sanskrit_iast: pauṣṇāntān pañca |
meaning: पौष्णान्तान् पञ्च ।

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyaṃ śunāsīryaṃ sauryam ekayā ca śunāsīreha sūryaś cakṣuṣām iti |
meaning: वायव्यं शुनासीर्यं सौर्यम् एकया च शुनासीरेह सूर्यश् चक्षुषाम् इति ।
text_mt: [Then the offerings] to Vāyu, to Śunāsīra, and to Sūrya, with: 'And with one...' (AV 7.4.1), 'O Śunā and Sīra, here...' (AV 3.17.7), and 'Sūrya of the eyes...' (AV 5.24.9).

sanskrit_iast: atha paśau vaiṣṇavaṃ pūrṇahomam uru viṣṇo iti |
meaning: अथ पशौ वैष्णवं पूर्णहोमम् उरु विष्णो इति ।
text_mt: Now in the animal sacrifice, [he offers] the full oblation to Viṣṇu with: 'Broadly, O Viṣṇu...' (ŚS 7.26.3c; PS 20.7.7).

sanskrit_iast: arātīyoḥ iti yūpaṃ vṛścyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: अरातीयोः इति यूपं वृश्च्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the sacrificial post being cut down, with: 'Hostile...' (AV 10.6.1).

sanskrit_iast: yat tvā śikvaḥ iti prakṣālyamānam |
meaning: यत् त्वा शिक्वः इति प्रक्षाल्यमानम् ।
text_mt: [And] being washed, with: 'That which to thee, O clever one...' (AV 10.6.3).

sanskrit_iast: añjate vyañjate ity abhyajyamānam |
meaning: अञ्जते व्यञ्जते इत्य् अभ्यज्यमानम् ।
text_mt: [And] being anointed, with: 'They anoint, they smear...' (AV 18.3.18).

sanskrit_iast: svāktaṃ me ity ājyamānam | gandhapravādābhir anulipyamānam |
meaning: स्वाक्तं मे इत्य् आज्यमानम् । गन्धप्रवादाभिर् अनुलिप्यमानम् ।
text_mt: [And] being smeared with clarified butter, with: 'Well-anointed for me...' (AV 7.30); [and] being smeared with fragrant substances, [with verses] mentioning fragrance.

sanskrit_iast: yat te vāsaḥ iti paridhāpyamānam |
meaning: यत् ते वासः इति परिधाप्यमानम् ।
text_mt: [And] being clothed, with: 'The garment that is thine...' (AV 8.2.16).

sanskrit_iast: vanaspate stīrṇam iti barhiṣy āsādyamānam |
meaning: वनस्पते स्तीर्णम् इति बर्हिष्य् आसाद्यमानम् ।
text_mt: [And] being laid down on the sacred grass, with: 'O tree, strewn...' (AV 12.3.33).

sanskrit_iast: vanaspatiḥ saha yasyāṃ sadaḥ ity ucchrīyamāṇam |
meaning: वनस्पतिः सह यस्यां सदः इत्य् उच्छ्रीयमाणम् ।
text_mt: [And] being erected, with: 'The tree together...' (AV 12.3.15) and 'Upon which the shed...' (AV 12.1.38).

sanskrit_iast: dhartā dhriyasva iti pādenāvaṭe nidhīyamānam |
meaning: धर्ता ध्रियस्व इति पादेनावटे निधीयमानम् ।

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi iti dvābhyām ucchritam |
meaning: विष्णोः कर्माणि इति द्वाभ्याम् उच्छ्रितम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates it when] erected, with two verses: 'The deeds of Viṣṇu...' (AV 7.26.6-7).

sanskrit_iast: samiddho adya iti prayājān |
meaning: समिद्धो अद्य इति प्रयाजान् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the fore-offerings with: 'Kindled today...' (AV 5.12.1).

sanskrit_iast: nārāśaṃsināṃ devo deveṣu iti dvitīyam |
meaning: नाराशंसिनां देवो देवेषु इति द्वितीयम् ।
text_mt: For those containing the Nārāśaṃsa verse, the second [verse is]: 'God among the gods...' (AV 5.27.2-3).

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvā asya itīṣṭakāpaśau |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वा अस्य इतीष्टकापशौ ।
text_mt: In the case of the brick animal sacrifice, [the verse is]: 'Upright are his...' (AV 5.27).

sanskrit_iast: ānayaitam ityādyāñjanāntam |
meaning: आनयैतम् इत्याद्याञ्जनान्तम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates the victim] beginning with: 'Lead him near...' (AV 9.5.1) up to the anointing.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya bhāgam iti yathādevatam |
meaning: इन्द्राय भागम् इति यथादेवतम् ।
text_mt: With: 'To Indra a share...' (AV 9.5.2), according to the deity.

sanskrit_iast: ya īśe iti pramucyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: य ईशे इति प्रमुच्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra [the animal] being released, with: 'He who rules...' (AV 2.34.1).

sanskrit_iast: nīyamāne pramucyamānahomāñ juhuyāt pramucyamāno bhuvanasya gopa paśur no atra prati bhāgam etu | agnir yajñaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantuṃ devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan || yau te daṃṣṭrau ropayiṣṇū jihmāyete dakṣiṇā saṃ ca paśyataḥ | anāṣṭraṃ naḥ pitaras tat kṛṇota yūpe baddhaṃ pramumucimā yadannam || ahrastas tvam abhijuṣṭaḥ parehīndrasya goṣṭham api dhāva vidvān | dhīrāsas tvā kavayaḥ saṃmṛjantv iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānāya dattvā iti |
meaning: नीयमाने प्रमुच्यमानहोमाञ् जुहुयात् प्रमुच्यमानो भुवनस्य गोप पशुर् नो अत्र प्रति भागम् एतु । अग्निर् यज्ञं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुं देवो देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन् ॥ यौ ते दंष्ट्रौ रोपयिष्णू जिह्मायेते दक्षिणा सं च पश्यतः । अनाष्ट्रं नः पितरस् तत् कृणोत यूपे बद्धं प्रमुमुचिमा यदन्नम् ॥ अह्रस्तस् त्वम् अभिजुष्टः परेहीन्द्रस्य गोष्ठम् अपि धाव विद्वान् । धीरासस् त्वा कवयः संमृजन्त्व् इषम् ऊर्जं यजमानाय दत्त्वा इति ।
text_mt: While [the animal] is being led [to the post], he should offer the oblations of being released, with: 'Being released, protector of the world, may our victim come forward to receive its portion here; / may Agni the god, knowing, carry the threefold sacrificial offering woven with seven threads to the gods. // Your two tusks that injure, which turn aside and look together to the south: / make that safe for us, O ancestors, whatever food tied to the post we have released. // Unweakened, well-welcomed, go forth; run to Indra's cattle pen, knowing [the way]; / may the steadfast poets wipe you clean, having given food and strength to the sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: śāsyamāne pradakṣiṇam āvartante |
meaning: शास्यमाने प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तन्ते ।
text_mt: While it is being slaughtered, they turn around sunwise.

sanskrit_iast: vapāyāḥ jātavedo vapayā iti | śaṃbhumayobhubhyāṃ cātvāle marjayanti |
meaning: वपायाः जातवेदो वपया इति । शंभुमयोभुभ्यां चात्वाले मर्जयन्ति ।
text_mt: With '[O Agni] Jātavedas, with the omentum...' [at the offering] of the omentum; and with the two [hymns] 'Saṃbhu' and 'Mayobhu' they wash themselves at the pit.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnaṃ purodāśam āvadānikaṃ ca |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नं पुरोदाशम् आवदानिकं च ।
text_mt: The sacrificial cake is for Indra-Agni, and [portions are taken] from each limb.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpreṣita āgnīdhraḥ śāmitrād aupayajān aṅgārān hotuḥ purastān nirvapati |
meaning: संप्रेषित आग्नीध्रः शामित्राद् औपयजान् अङ्गारान् होतुः पुरस्तान् निर्वपति ।
text_mt: Being prompted, the āgnīdhra pours out the embers for the after-offerings from the slaughtering fire in front of the hotṛ priest.

sanskrit_iast: hṛdayaśūla upamite apsu te rājan iti japanti |
meaning: हृदयशूल उपमिते अप्सु ते राजन् इति जपन्ति ।
text_mt: When the heart-spit is set upright, they murmur: 'In the waters to you, O king...'

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgneneṣṭvā kāmyaḥ paśuḥ |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नेनेष्ट्वा काम्यः पशुः ।
text_mt: Having offered the [cake] for Indra-Agni, there is an optional animal [offering].

sanskrit_iast: somena yakṣyamāṇa aindrāgnam usram ālabheta yasya pitā pitāmahaḥ somaṃ na pibet |
meaning: सोमेन यक्ष्यमाण ऐन्द्राग्नम् उस्रम् आलभेत यस्य पिता पितामहः सोमं न पिबेत् ।
text_mt: One intending to sacrifice with Soma, whose father or grandfather did not drink Soma, should seize a bull dedicated to Indra-Agni.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijo vṛṇīte | atharvāṅgirovidaṃ brahmāṇam | sāmavidam udgātāram | ṛgvidaṃ hotāram | yajurvidam adhvaryum |
meaning: ऋत्विजो वृणीते । अथर्वाङ्गिरोविदं ब्रह्माणम् । सामविदम् उद्गातारम् । ऋग्विदं होतारम् । यजुर्विदम् अध्वर्युम् ।
text_mt: He chooses the officiating priests: a brahman priest learned in the Atharvāṅgiras; an udgātṛ priest learned in the Sāmaveda; a hotṛ priest learned in the Ṛgveda; an adhvaryu priest learned in the Yajurveda.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇācchaṃsī potāgnīdhra iti brahmaṇo 'nucarāḥ sadasyaś ca | prastotā pratihartā subrahmaṇya ity udgātuḥ | maitrāvaruṇo 'cchāvāko grāvastud iti hotuḥ | pratiprasthātā neṣṭonnetety adhvaryoḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी पोताग्नीध्र इति ब्रह्मणो ऽनुचराः सदस्यश् च । प्रस्तोता प्रतिहर्ता सुब्रह्मण्य इत्य् उद्गातुः । मैत्रावरुणो ऽच्छावाको ग्रावस्तुद् इति होतुः । प्रतिप्रस्थाता नेष्टोन्नेतेत्य् अध्वर्योः ।
text_mt: The brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, potṛ, and āgnīdhra, as well as the sadasya, are assistants of the brahman priest; the prastotṛ, pratihartṛ, and subrahmaṇya belong to the udgātṛ; the maitrāvaruṇa, acchāvāka, and grāvastut belong to the hotṛ; the pratiprasthātṛ, neṣṭṛ, and unnetṛ belong to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vasantādiṣu yathāvarṇam | devayajanam ity uktam |
meaning: वसन्तादिषु यथावर्णम् । देवयजनम् इत्य् उक्तम् ।
text_mt: In spring and the other [seasons] according to social class; the sacrificial ground has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: yasya śvabhra ūrmo vṛkṣaḥ parvato nadī panthā vā purastāt syāt | na devayajanamātraṃ purastāt paryavaśiṣyet |
meaning: यस्य श्वभ्र ऊर्मो वृक्षः पर्वतो नदी पन्था वा पुरस्तात् स्यात् । न देवयजनमात्रं पुरस्तात् पर्यवशिष्येत् ।
text_mt: 'If in front of him there should be a chasm, a surge, a tree, a mountain, a river, or a path, no portion of sacrificial ground should remain left over in front.'

sanskrit_iast: somarūpāṇy anudhyāyet |
meaning: सोमरूपाण्य् अनुध्यायेत् ।
text_mt: He should contemplate the forms of Soma.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣaṇīyāyām āgnāvaiṣṇavam |
meaning: दीक्षणीयायाम् आग्नावैष्णवम् ।
text_mt: In the consecration offering, [the cake] is for Agni-Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: patnīsaṃyājāntā |
meaning: पत्नीसंयाजान्ता ।

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitaḥ abhyañjanam ity abhyajyamāno japati |
meaning: दीक्षितः अभ्यञ्जनम् इत्य् अभ्यज्यमानो जपति ।
text_mt: The consecrated [sacrificer], being anointed, murmurs: 'Anointment...'

sanskrit_iast: punantu mā iti pāvyamānaḥ |
meaning: पुनन्तु मा इति पाव्यमानः ।
text_mt: Being purified, [he murmurs]: 'May they purify me...'

sanskrit_iast: sutrāmāṇam iti kṛṣṇājinam upaveśitaḥ |
meaning: सुत्रामाणम् इति कृष्णाजिनम् उपवेशितः ।
text_mt: Being seated on a black antelope skin, [he murmurs]: 'The good protector...'

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitāvedanāt kāmaṃ caranti |
meaning: दीक्षितावेदनात् कामं चरन्ति ।
text_mt: From the announcement of the consecrated [sacrificer] onward, they act as they please.

sanskrit_iast: astam ite vāgvisarjanād astaṃyate namaḥ iti namaskṛtya nakṣatrāṇāṃ mā saṃkāśaś ca pratīkāśaś cāvatām iti nakṣatrāṇy upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अस्तम् इते वाग्विसर्जनाद् अस्तंयते नमः इति नमस्कृत्य नक्षत्राणां मा संकाशश् च प्रतीकाशश् चावताम् इति नक्षत्राण्य् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: At sunset, before the release of speech, having bowed down with 'Homage to the setting one!', he waits upon the constellations with: 'May the sight and counter-sight of the constellations protect me!'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāgniṃ kaśipvityādi vīkṣaṇāntam |
meaning: दक्षिणेनाग्निं कशिप्वित्यादि वीक्षणान्तम् ।
text_mt: To the south of the fire, beginning with the straw cushion and ending with looking [at the fire, is performed].

sanskrit_iast: punaḥ prāṇaḥ iti mantroktāny abhimantrayate |
meaning: पुनः प्राणः इति मन्त्रोक्तान्य् अभिमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He addresses [the bodily parts] mentioned in the mantra with: 'Again breath...'

sanskrit_iast: ādityasya mā saṃkāśaḥ | udyate namaḥ ity ādityam upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: आदित्यस्य मा संकाशः । उद्यते नमः इत्य् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: With 'May the sight of the sun...' and 'Homage to the rising one!', he waits upon the sun.

sanskrit_iast: vratāni |
meaning: व्रतानि ।

sanskrit_iast: apratyutthāyikaḥ | anabhivādukaḥ |
meaning: अप्रत्युत्थायिकः । अनभिवादुकः ।
text_mt: He does not rise up [to greet anyone]; he does not salute [anyone].

sanskrit_iast: na nāma gṛhṇāti | vicakṣaṇottaraṃ brāhmaṇasya canasitottaraṃ prājāpatyasya |
meaning: न नाम गृह्णाति । विचक्षणोत्तरं ब्राह्मणस्य चनसितोत्तरं प्राजापत्यस्य ।
text_mt: He does not utter a name; [the address] of a brāhmaṇa ends in 'vicakṣaṇa'; of a man of the people [it ends] in 'canasita'.

sanskrit_iast: na dānahomapākādhyayanāni | na vasūni |
meaning: न दानहोमपाकाध्ययनानि । न वसूनि ।
text_mt: There are no giving of gifts, oblations, cooking, or study; no [accepting of] wealth.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinaṃ vasīta |
meaning: कृष्णाजिनं वसीत ।

sanskrit_iast: kurīraṃ dhārayet |
meaning: कुरीरं धारयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: muṣṭī kuryāt |
meaning: मुष्टी कुर्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhaprabhṛtayas tisra ucchrayet |
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठप्रभृतयस् तिस्र उच्छ्रयेत् ।
text_mt: He should raise three [fingers], beginning with the thumb.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgaśṛṅgaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tena kaṣeta |
meaning: मृगशृङ्गं गृह्णीयात् । तेन कषेत ।
text_mt: He should take a black-buck horn; with it he should scratch himself.

sanskrit_iast: yasya vāg vāyatā syān muṣṭī vāvasṛṣṭau sa etāni japet |
meaning: यस्य वाग् वायता स्यान् मुष्टी वावसृष्टौ स एतानि जपेत् ।
text_mt: If his speech should wander or his fists be opened, he should murmur these [mantras]:

sanskrit_iast: agnihotraṃ ca mā paurṇamāsaś ca yajñaḥ purastāt pratyañcam ubhau kāmaprau bhūtvā kṣityā sahāviśatām | vasatiś ca māmāvāsyaś ca yajñaḥ paścāt prāñcam | manaś ca mā pitṛyajñaś ca yajño dakṣiṇata udañcam | vāk ca meṣṭiś cottarato dakṣiṇāñcam | retaś ca mānnaṃ ceta ūrdhvam | cakṣuś ca mā paśubandhaś ca yajño 'muto 'rvāñcam iti |
meaning: अग्निहोत्रं च मा पौर्णमासश् च यज्ञः पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चम् उभौ कामप्रौ भूत्वा क्षित्या सहाविशताम् । वसतिश् च मामावास्यश् च यज्ञः पश्चात् प्राञ्चम् । मनश् च मा पितृयज्ञश् च यज्ञो दक्षिणत उदञ्चम् । वाक् च मेष्टिश् चोत्तरतो दक्षिणाञ्चम् । रेतश् च मान्नं चेत ऊर्ध्वम् । चक्षुश् च मा पशुबन्धश् च यज्ञो ऽमुतो ऽर्वाञ्चम् इति ।
text_mt: 'May the Agnihotra and the Full Moon sacrifice, both fulfilling desires, enter me from the east facing westward, together with the earth; and may the dwelling and the New Moon sacrifice [enter me] from the west facing eastward; and may mind and the ancestral sacrifice [enter me] from the south facing northward; and may speech and the sacrifice [enter me] from the north facing southward; and may semen and food [enter me] upward from here; and may sight and the animal sacrifice [enter me] hitherward from yonder.' / And at the end of the consecration [he murmurs this] for the attainment of wealth.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣānte ca vasusaṃpattaye |
meaning: दीक्षान्ते च वसुसंपत्तये ।

sanskrit_iast: nainaṃ bahirvedyabhyudiyān nābhyastamiyāt | nādhiṣṇye pratapet |
meaning: नैनं बहिर्वेद्यभ्युदियान् नाभ्यस्तमियात् । नाधिष्ण्ये प्रतपेत् ।
text_mt: [The sun] should not rise over him outside the altar, nor should it set over him [outside the altar]; he should not warm himself at an unordained hearth.

sanskrit_iast: satyaṃ vadet |
meaning: सत्यं वदेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: vratalope yad asmṛti ity agnim upatiṣṭhate |
meaning: व्रतलोपे यद् अस्मृति इत्य् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: Upon the breach of a sacrificial observance, he waits upon the fire with: 'Whatever out of unmindfulness...'

sanskrit_iast: satyaṃ bṛhat iti loṣṭam ādāya śuddhā na āpaḥ iti mūtrapurīṣe kṣārayati | pavitreṇa pṛthivi iti loṣṭenātmānam utpunāti |
meaning: सत्यं बृहत् इति लोष्टम् आदाय शुद्धा न आपः इति मूत्रपुरीषे क्षारयति । पवित्रेण पृथिवि इति लोष्टेनात्मानम् उत्पुनाति ।
text_mt: Taking a clod of earth with 'Truth, high...', he discharges urine and excrement with 'Pure to us the waters...'; with the clod of earth he purifies himself with 'With a purifier, O earth...'

sanskrit_iast: ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ iti śīrṇaṃ daṇḍādy abhimantrayate | svapneṣūktam | divo nu mām iti ca |
meaning: य ऋते चिद् अभिश्रिषः इति शीर्णं दण्डाद्य् अभिमन्त्रयते । स्वप्नेषूक्तम् । दिवो नु माम् इति च ।
text_mt: With 'Who even without bindings...', he addresses a broken staff or the like; during dreams, [the formulas] have been stated; and with 'From the sky now upon me...'

sanskrit_iast: yad atrāpi madhor ahaṃ niraṣṭhaviṣam asmṛtam | agniś ca tat savitā ca punar me jaṭhare dhattām iti jāmbīlaskandana ātmānam anumantrayate |
meaning: यद् अत्रापि मधोर् अहं निरष्ठविषम् अस्मृतम् । अग्निश् च तत् सविता च पुनर् मे जठरे धत्ताम् इति जाम्बीलस्कन्दन आत्मानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: Upon spitting out saliva, he consecrates himself with: 'Whatever sweet [sap] I have spat out here unmindfully, may Agni and Savitṛ place that back into my belly.'

sanskrit_iast: yad atrāpi rasasya me parā papātāsmṛtam | tad ihopahvayāmahe tan ma ā pyāyatāṃ punaḥ iti retasaḥ |
meaning: यद् अत्रापि रसस्य मे परा पपातास्मृतम् । तद् इहोपह्वयामहे तन् म आ प्यायतां पुनः इति रेतसः ।
text_mt: Upon [the discharge] of semen, [he consecrates himself] with: 'Whatever fluid of mine has fallen away here unmindfully, that we summon here; may that swell up for me again.'

sanskrit_iast: paro 'pehi ity aśastaśaṃsane |
meaning: परो ऽपेहि इत्य् अशस्तशंसने ।
text_mt: When hearing an inauspicious utterance, [he murmurs]: 'Go away far...'

sanskrit_iast: aśmanvatī ity apāṃ taraṇe |
meaning: अश्मन्वती इत्य् अपां तरणे ।
text_mt: When crossing waters: 'Stony...'

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ samudrāt ity anācchāditābhivarṣaṇe |
meaning: अपः समुद्रात् इत्य् अनाच्छादिताभिवर्षणे ।
text_mt: When rained upon while uncovered: 'Waters from the ocean...'

sanskrit_iast: ava jyām iva iti krodhe |
meaning: अव ज्याम् इव इति क्रोधे ।

sanskrit_iast: ṛtumatīṃ jāyāṃ sārūpavatsaṃ śrapayitvābhighāryodvāsyoddhṛtyābhihiṃkṛtya garbhavedanapuṃsavanaiḥ saṃpātavantaṃ parām eva prāśayet |
meaning: ऋतुमतीं जायां सारूपवत्सं श्रपयित्वाभिघार्योद्वास्योद्धृत्याभिहिंकृत्य गर्भवेदनपुंसवनैः संपातवन्तं पराम् एव प्राशयेत् ।
text_mt: Having cooked [a dish of rice] with the milk of a cow having a calf of the same color for his wife who is in her season, having poured clarified butter over it, taken it off [the fire], brought it out, made the 'hiṃ' sound over it, and provided it with remnants [of ghee] through the foetus-finding and male-producing [rites], he should make her consume the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: tisro dīkṣāḥ | aparimitā vā | dvādaśāhīnasya |
meaning: तिस्रो दीक्षाः । अपरिमिता वा । द्वादशाहीनस्य ।
text_mt: There are three days of initiation; or unlimited [days]; twelve of an ahīna sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣānte prāyaṇīyāyāṃ pathyāyāḥ svaster agneḥ somasya savitur aditeḥ pathyā revatīḥ vedaḥ svastiḥ iti |
meaning: दीक्षान्ते प्रायणीयायां पथ्यायाः स्वस्तेर् अग्नेः सोमस्य सवितुर् अदितेः पथ्या रेवतीः वेदः स्वस्तिः इति ।
text_mt: At the conclusion of the initiation, at the prāyaṇīyā offering [belonging] to Pathyā Svasti, Agni, Soma, Savitṛ, and Aditi, [he consecrates] with: "Pathyā, wealthy...", "Knowledge, well-being..."

sanskrit_iast: śaṃyvantā |
meaning: शंय्वन्ता ।

sanskrit_iast: dhrauvasya pūrṇāhutiṃ yasyoruṣu iti |
meaning: ध्रौवस्य पूर्णाहुतिं यस्योरुषु इति ।
text_mt: [He offers] the full-spoon offering from the dhruvā ladling with: "In whose wide..."

sanskrit_iast: niṣkramya somakrayaṇīṃ prapādyamānāṃ divaṃ ca roha ity anumantrayate |
meaning: निष्क्रम्य सोमक्रयणीं प्रपाद्यमानां दिवं च रोह इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: Having stepped forth, he consecrates with a mantra the cow to purchase Soma while she is being brought forward, with: "And mount to heaven..."

sanskrit_iast: padābhihomam iḍāyās padam iti |
meaning: पदाभिहोमम् इडायास् पदम् इति ।
text_mt: [He offers] the footprint oblation with: "The footprint of Iḍā..."

sanskrit_iast: uparavadeśe carmaṇi somam abhi tyam iti hiraṇyapāṇir vicinoti |
meaning: उपरवदेशे चर्मणि सोमम् अभि त्यम् इति हिरण्यपाणिर् विचिनोति ।
text_mt: With gold in hand, he sorts the soma on the hide in the place of the uparavas, with: "Toward that..."

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ sahasram ity anumantrayate |
meaning: अयं सहस्रम् इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates [it] with a mantra with: "This thousand..."

sanskrit_iast: krīte kurīraṃ nirmuṣṇāti |
meaning: क्रीते कुरीरं निर्मुष्णाति ।
