text_mt: When it has been purchased, he takes off the head-net.

sanskrit_iast: ud āyuṣā ity uttiṣṭhati |
meaning: उद् आयुषा इत्य् उत्तिष्ठति ।
text_mt: He stands up with: "Upward with life..."

sanskrit_iast: prohyamāṇe 'pratirathaṃ japati |
meaning: प्रोह्यमाणे ऽप्रतिरथं जपति ।
text_mt: While it is being conveyed forward, he silently recites the Apratiratha hymn.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa iti rājānaṃ rājavahanād āsandyāṃ nīyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण इति राजानं राजवहनाद् आसन्द्यां नीयमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the King [Soma] as he is being carried from the vehicle of the King to the stool, with: "Firm with the firm..."

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāgnim āsthāpita ātithyāyāṃ havir abhimṛśanti yajñena yajñam iti |
meaning: दक्षिणेनाग्निम् आस्थापित आतिथ्यायां हविर् अभिमृशन्ति यज्ञेन यज्ञम् इति ।
text_mt: When he has been placed to the south of the fire, at the ātithyā reception they touch the sacrificial offering with: "By means of the sacrifice the sacrifice..."

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇor nu kam iti |
meaning: वैष्णवं विष्णोर् नु कम् इति ।
text_mt: [And] the Vaiṣṇava [cake] with: "Viṣṇu's now [deeds]..."

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntā |
meaning: इडान्ता ।

sanskrit_iast: tānūnaptrapātre pañcakṛtvo 'vadyanty ājyam āpataye tvā gṛhṇāmi paripataye tvā tanūnaptre tvā śākvarāya tvā śakmana ojiṣṭhāya tvā iti |
meaning: तानूनप्त्रपात्रे पञ्चकृत्वो ऽवद्यन्त्य् आज्यम् आपतये त्वा गृह्णामि परिपतये त्वा तनूनप्त्रे त्वा शाक्वराय त्वा शक्मन ओजिष्ठाय त्वा इति ।
text_mt: They portion clarified butter five times into the cup of the covenant (tānūnaptra) with: "I take you for the Lord of arrival; I take you for the Lord of departure; I take you for Tanūnapāt; I take you for the Śākvara; I take you for the mightiest of strength." / They touch it.

sanskrit_iast: tad abhimṛśanti |
meaning: तद् अभिमृशन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣṭam asyanādhṛṣyaṃ devānām ojo 'bhiśastipā anabhiśastiḥ | anu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatir manyatām anu tapas tapaspatiḥ | añjasā satyam upageṣaṃ svite mā dhāḥ iti dīkṣāliṅgaṃ dīkṣitaḥ |
meaning: अनाधृष्टम् अस्यनाधृष्यं देवानाम् ओजो ऽभिशस्तिपा अनभिशस्तिः । अनु मे दीक्षां दीक्षापतिर् मन्यताम् अनु तपस् तपस्पतिः । अञ्जसा सत्यम् उपगेषं स्विते मा धाः इति दीक्षालिङ्गं दीक्षितः ।
text_mt: With the formula marking initiation, the initiated [sacrificer mutters]: "You are unassailable, the unassailable power of the gods, protecting against curse, beyond curse. May the Lord of initiation approve my initiation; may the Lord of ascetic heat approve my ascetic heat. May I directly attain the truth; place me in good welfare."

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur āgnīdhram āha agnīt madantyāpāḥ iti |
meaning: अध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्रम् आह अग्नीत् मदन्त्यापाः इति ।
text_mt: The adhvaryu says to the āgnīdhra: "O Agnīdh, are the waters exhilarating?"

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhro madanti devīr amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ iti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रो मदन्ति देवीर् अमृता ऋतावृधः इति ।
text_mt: The āgnīdhra [replies]: "Exhilarating are the divine, immortal ones, increasers of the truth."

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryus tābhir udehi iti |
meaning: अध्वर्युस् ताभिर् उदेहि इति ।
text_mt: The adhvaryu [says]: "Come up with them!"

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhras tāḥ kuśair udānayati |
meaning: आग्नीध्रस् ताः कुशैर् उदानयति ।
text_mt: The āgnīdhra brings them up with kuśa blades.

sanskrit_iast: tā upaspṛśya somam āpyāyayanti aṃśur aṃśuṣ ṭe deva somāpyāyatām indrāyaikadhanavide | ā tubhyam indraḥ pyāyatām ā tvam indrāya pyāyasva || āpyāyayāsmānt sakhīnt sanyā medhayā prajayā dhanena | svasti te deva soma sutyām udṛcam aśīya iti |
meaning: ता उपस्पृश्य सोमम् आप्याययन्ति अंशुर् अंशुष् टे देव सोमाप्यायताम् इन्द्रायैकधनविदे । आ तुभ्यम् इन्द्रः प्यायताम् आ त्वम् इन्द्राय प्यायस्व ॥ आप्याययास्मान्त् सखीन्त् सन्या मेधया प्रजया धनेन । स्वस्ति ते देव सोम सुत्याम् उदृचम् अशीय इति ।
text_mt: Having touched them, they swell the soma with: "May stalk after stalk swell for you, divine Soma, for Indra who finds unique wealth. May Indra swell for you; do you swell for Indra! / Swell us, our companions, with gain, wisdom, offspring, and wealth. Well-being to you, divine Soma; may I attain the completion of the pressing!"

sanskrit_iast: punar upaspṛśyottānahastāḥ prastare nihnuvata eṣṭā rāya eṣṭā vāmāni preṣe bhagāya ṛtamṛtavādibhyo namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyai iti |
meaning: पुनर् उपस्पृश्योत्तानहस्ताः प्रस्तरे निह्नुवत एष्टा राय एष्टा वामानि प्रेषे भगाय ऋतमृतवादिभ्यो नमो दिवे नमः पृथिव्यै इति ।
text_mt: Having touched [the waters] again, with palms turned upward they make denial upon the prastara grass bundle with: "Desirous of wealth, desirous of blessings, forward to the impulse of Fortune! Homage to the truth-speakers of the truth! Homage to heaven, homage to earth!"

sanskrit_iast: pravargyāya purastāddhomān hutvā gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇenopaviśati |
meaning: प्रवर्ग्याय पुरस्ताद्धोमान् हुत्वा गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणेनोपविशति ।
text_mt: Having offered the preliminary offerings for the Pravargya, he sits down south of the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: na prathamayajñe pravargyaṃ kurvīta | kāmam anūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ |
meaning: न प्रथमयज्ञे प्रवर्ग्यं कुर्वीत । कामम् अनूचानः श्रोत्रियः ।
text_mt: One should not perform the Pravargya at a first sacrifice; at will, [however], a learned Vedic scholar [may do so].

sanskrit_iast: antardhāyādhvaryur āha brahman gharmeṇa pracariṣyāmaḥ iti |
meaning: अन्तर्धायाध्वर्युर् आह ब्रह्मन् घर्मेण प्रचरिष्यामः इति ।
text_mt: Having placed a screen, the adhvaryu says: "O brahman priest, we will proceed with the hot milk cauldron (gharma)."

sanskrit_iast: pracarata gharmam ity anujānāti |
meaning: प्रचरत घर्मम् इत्य् अनुजानाति ।
text_mt: He grants permission: "Proceed with the hot milk cauldron!" / Either entirely aloud or in a whisper.

sanskrit_iast: uccaiḥ sarvam upāṃśu vā |
meaning: उच्चैः सर्वम् उपांशु वा ।

sanskrit_iast: gharmaṃ tāpyamānum upāsīta |
meaning: घर्मं ताप्यमानुम् उपासीत ।
text_mt: He attends to the hot milk cauldron while it is being heated.

sanskrit_iast: gharmaṃ tapāmy amṛtasya dhārayā devebhyo havyaṃ paridāṃ savitre | śukraṃ devāḥ śṛtam adantu havyam āsañ juhvānam amṛtasya yonau || devānām adhipā eti gharma ṛtena bhrājann amṛtaṃ vicaṣṭe | hiraṇyavarṇo nabhaso deva sūryo gharmo bhrājan divo antān paryeṣi vidyutā || vaiśvānaraḥ samudraṃ paryeti śukro gharmo bhrājan tejasā rocamānaḥ | nudañ chatrūn pradahan me sapatnān ādityo dyām adhyarukṣad vipaścit || vi dyotate dyotata ā ca dyotata apsv antar amṛto gharma udyan || hantā vṛtrasya haritām anīkam anādhṛṣṭās tanvaḥ sūryasya || gharmaḥ paścād uta gharmaḥ purastād ayodaṃṣṭrāya dviṣato 'pi dadhmaḥ | vaiśvānaraḥ śītarūre vasānaḥ sapatnān me dviṣato hantu sarvān | ṛtūn ṛtubhiḥ śrapayati brahmaṇaikavīro gharmaḥ śucānaḥ samidhā samiddhaḥ || brahma tvā tapati brahmaṇā tejasā ca || gharmaḥ sāhasraḥ samidhā samiddhaḥ | asapatnāḥ pradiśo me bhavantu | sapatnān sarvān me sūryo hantu vaiśvānaro hariḥ || gharmas taptaḥ pra dahatu bhrātṛvyān dviṣato vṛṣā | udyan me śukra ādityo vimṛdho hantu sūryaḥ || brahma jajñānam iyaṃ pitryā iti śastravad ardharcaśa āhāvapratigaravarjam |
meaning: घर्मं तपाम्य् अमृतस्य धारया देवेभ्यो हव्यं परिदां सवित्रे । शुक्रं देवाः शृतम् अदन्तु हव्यम् आसञ् जुह्वानम् अमृतस्य योनौ ॥ देवानाम् अधिपा एति घर्म ऋतेन भ्राजन्न् अमृतं विचष्टे । हिरण्यवर्णो नभसो देव सूर्यो घर्मो भ्राजन् दिवो अन्तान् पर्येषि विद्युता ॥ वैश्वानरः समुद्रं पर्येति शुक्रो घर्मो भ्राजन् तेजसा रोचमानः । नुदञ् छत्रून् प्रदहन् मे सपत्नान् आदित्यो द्याम् अध्यरुक्षद् विपश्चित् ॥ वि द्योतते द्योतत आ च द्योतत अप्स्व् अन्तर् अमृतो घर्म उद्यन् ॥ हन्ता वृत्रस्य हरिताम् अनीकम् अनाधृष्टास् तन्वः सूर्यस्य ॥ घर्मः पश्चाद् उत घर्मः पुरस्ताद् अयोदंष्ट्राय द्विषतो ऽपि दध्मः । वैश्वानरः शीतरूरे वसानः सपत्नान् मे द्विषतो हन्तु सर्वान् । ऋतून् ऋतुभिः श्रपयति ब्रह्मणैकवीरो घर्मः शुचानः समिधा समिद्धः ॥ ब्रह्म त्वा तपति ब्रह्मणा तेजसा च ॥ घर्मः साहस्रः समिधा समिद्धः । असपत्नाः प्रदिशो मे भवन्तु । सपत्नान् सर्वान् मे सूर्यो हन्तु वैश्वानरो हरिः ॥ घर्मस् तप्तः प्र दहतु भ्रातृव्यान् द्विषतो वृषा । उद्यन् मे शुक्र आदित्यो विमृधो हन्तु सूर्यः ॥ ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् इयं पित्र्या इति शस्त्रवद् अर्धर्चश आहावप्रतिगरवर्जम् ।
text_mt: With: "I heat the cauldron with a stream of immortality...", "The overlord of the gods goes, the cauldron shining with cosmic order...", "Vaiśvānara encompasses the ocean, the bright cauldron blazing with splendor...", "It flashes, it blazes, and it shines forth, the immortal cauldron rising within the waters...", "The thousandfold cauldron kindled with firewood...", "The brahman born first...", "This ancestral...", [he recites] like a śastra verse by half-verse, without the call and response.

sanskrit_iast: rucir asi iti rucitam anumantrayate |
meaning: रुचिर् असि इति रुचितम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: When it has shone brightly, he consecrates it with a mantra with: "You are brightness..."

sanskrit_iast: gharmadhug dohāyottiṣṭhataḥ ut tiṣṭhatāva paśyata iti |
meaning: घर्मधुग् दोहायोत्तिष्ठतः उत् तिष्ठताव पश्यत इति ।
text_mt: While the two stand up for the milking of the cauldron cow, [he recites]: "Stand up, look down..."

sanskrit_iast: upa hvaye iti gharmadughām |
meaning: उप ह्वये इति घर्मदुघाम् ।
text_mt: Toward the cow that gives milk for the cauldron, [he recites]: "I call near..."

sanskrit_iast: gharmasūktena gharmaṃ hūyamānam | svāhākṛtaḥ iti dvābhyāṃ gharmasya vaṣaṭkṛte 'nuvaṣaṭkṛte |
meaning: घर्मसूक्तेन घर्मं हूयमानम् । स्वाहाकृतः इति द्वाभ्यां घर्मस्य वषट्कृते ऽनुवषट्कृते ।
text_mt: While the hot milk cauldron is being offered, [he consecrates it] with the Gharma hymn; at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call of the cauldron, with the two [verses]: "Made svāhā..."

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣo vājinavat śṛtaṃ havir madhu havir aśyāma te gharma madhumataḥ pitṛmato vājimato bṛhaspatimato viśvadevyāvataḥ iti |
meaning: भक्षो वाजिनवत् शृतं हविर् मधु हविर् अश्याम ते घर्म मधुमतः पितृमतो वाजिमतो बृहस्पतिमतो विश्वदेव्यावतः इति ।
text_mt: The consumption is like that of the vājina whey: "Sweet sacrificial offering, boiled sacrificial offering, may we partake of you, cauldron, rich in sweetness, accompanied by the Fathers, accompanied by the Vājins, accompanied by Bṛhaspati, accompanied by the All-Gods."

sanskrit_iast: satre hotādhvaryur brahmodgātānucarā gṛhapatiś ca |
meaning: सत्रे होताध्वर्युर् ब्रह्मोद्गातानुचरा गृहपतिश् च ।
text_mt: At a sacrificial session, the hotṛ, adhvaryu, brahman priest, udgātṛ, their assistants, and the master of the house [partake].

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭakhare pavitrair mārjayante |
meaning: उच्छिष्टखरे पवित्रैर् मार्जयन्ते ।
text_mt: They cleanse themselves with strainers at the mound of the remnants.

sanskrit_iast: sūyavasāt iti triruktāyāṃ saṃsthitahomān |
meaning: सूयवसात् इति त्रिरुक्तायां संस्थितहोमान् ।
text_mt: When "From rich pasturage..." has been recited three times, [he performs] the concluding offerings.

sanskrit_iast: upasadyāgneyasaumyavaiṣṇavān |
meaning: उपसद्याग्नेयसौम्यवैष्णवान् ।
text_mt: At the Upasad, [the offerings] are to Agni, Soma, and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkārāntā | āpyāyananihnavane |
meaning: वषट्कारान्ता । आप्यायननिह्नवने ।
text_mt: [They] end with the vaṣaṭ-call. [Then take place] the swelling and the mutual greeting.

sanskrit_iast: yatrāhādhvaryur agnīd devapatnīr vyācakṣva iti tadapareṇa gārhapatyaṃ prāṅmukhas tiṣṭhann anavānann āgnīdhro devapatnīr vyācaṣṭe | pṛthivy agneḥ patnī vāg vātasya patnī senendrasya patnī dhenā bṛhaspateḥ patnī pathyā pūṣṇaḥ patnī gāyatrī vasūnāṃ patnī triṣṭub rudrāṇāṃ patnī jagaty ādityānāṃ patny anuṣṭub mitrasya patnī virāḍ varuṇasya patnī paṅktir viṣṇoḥ patnī dīkṣā somasya rājñaḥ patnī iti |
meaning: यत्राहाध्वर्युर् अग्नीद् देवपत्नीर् व्याचक्ष्व इति तदपरेण गार्हपत्यं प्राङ्मुखस् तिष्ठन्न् अनवानन्न् आग्नीध्रो देवपत्नीर् व्याचष्टे । पृथिव्य् अग्नेः पत्नी वाग् वातस्य पत्नी सेनेन्द्रस्य पत्नी धेना बृहस्पतेः पत्नी पथ्या पूष्णः पत्नी गायत्री वसूनां पत्नी त्रिष्टुब् रुद्राणां पत्नी जगत्य् आदित्यानां पत्न्य् अनुष्टुब् मित्रस्य पत्नी विराड् वरुणस्य पत्नी पङ्क्तिर् विष्णोः पत्नी दीक्षा सोमस्य राज्ञः पत्नी इति ।
text_mt: When the adhvaryu says: "Agnīdh, proclaim the wives of the gods!", then, standing to the west of the gārhapatya facing east, without taking a breath, the āgnīdhra proclaims the wives of the gods: "The earth is the wife of Agni; Speech is the wife of Vāta; the Army is the wife of Indra; Dhenā is the wife of Bṛhaspati; Pathyā is the wife of Pūṣan; the Gāyatrī is the wife of the Vasus; the Triṣṭubh is the wife of the Rudras; the Jagatī is the wife of the Ādityas; the Anuṣṭubh is the wife of Mitra; the Virāj is the wife of Varuṇa; the Paṅkti is the wife of Viṣṇu; the Dīkṣā is the wife of King Soma!"

sanskrit_iast: subrahmaṇyāhvāne sarvatra yasyāṃ sadaḥ iti tisro japati |
meaning: सुब्रह्मण्याह्वाने सर्वत्र यस्यां सदः इति तिस्रो जपति ।
text_mt: At every chanting of the Subrahmaṇyā, he mutters the three [verses beginning]: "In which the sadas [is]..."

sanskrit_iast: evam aparāhṇe gharmopasadau | aparedyuḥ pūrvāhṇe 'parāhṇe ca | aupavasathye samāse |
meaning: एवम् अपराह्णे घर्मोपसदौ । अपरेद्युः पूर्वाह्णे ऽपराह्णे च । औपवसथ्ये समासे ।
text_mt: In the same manner in the afternoon [take place] the gharma and the upasad; on the next day, in the forenoon and in the afternoon; on the preparation-day combined.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tisro 'gniṣṭomasya | dvādaśāhīnasya |
meaning: एवं तिस्रो ऽग्निष्टोमस्य । द्वादशाहीनस्य ।
text_mt: Thus three [days of upasads] are for an Agniṣṭoma; twelve for an ahīna.

sanskrit_iast: vi mimīṣva iti vediṃ mimānam anumantrayate |
meaning: वि मिमीष्व इति वेदिं मिमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the [adhvaryu] measuring the vedi with: "Measure out..."

sanskrit_iast: yasyāṃ vedim iti vediṃ parigṛhyamāṇām |
meaning: यस्यां वेदिम् इति वेदिं परिगृह्यमाणाम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the vedi being enclosed [by a line] with: "In which the vedi..."

sanskrit_iast: agnau praṇīyamāne agne prehi iti japitvā bahirvedy upaviśati |
meaning: अग्नौ प्रणीयमाने अग्ने प्रेहि इति जपित्वा बहिर्वेद्य् उपविशति ।
text_mt: While the fire is being carried forward, having muttered: "Go forward, O Agni...", he sits down outside the vedi.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇahavirdhānasya vartmābhihomam idaṃ viṣṇuḥ iti | uttarasya trīṇi padā iti |
meaning: दक्षिणहविर्धानस्य वर्त्माभिहोमम् इदं विष्णुः इति । उत्तरस्य त्रीणि पदा इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates with a mantra] the oblation into the wheel-track of the southern havirdhāna [cart] with: "This, Viṣṇu...", and of the northern [cart] with: "Three steps..."

sanskrit_iast: havirdhāne pravartyamāne itaś ca mā iti dvābhyām anumantrayate |
meaning: हविर्धाने प्रवर्त्यमाने इतश् च मा इति द्वाभ्याम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: While the two havirdhāna [carts] are being rolled forward, he consecrates [them] with a mantra with the two [verses]: "From here and from me..."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor nu kam ity upastambhanam upastabhyamānam |
meaning: विष्णोर् नु कम् इत्य् उपस्तम्भनम् उपस्तभ्यमानम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the prop being put under with: "Indeed now of Viṣṇu..."

sanskrit_iast: manve vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ity audumbaryā abhihomam |
meaning: मन्वे वां द्यावापृथिवी इत्य् औदुम्बर्या अभिहोमम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the oblation over the audumbarī [post] with: "I contemplate you both, Heaven and Earth..."

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomayoḥ praṇayanāyāmantritas tīrthena patnīśālam āvrajati | cātvālotkarāv antareṇāgnīdhrīyalakṣaṇam uttareṇa sadaś ceti tīrtham |
meaning: अग्नीषोमयोः प्रणयनायामन्त्रितस् तीर्थेन पत्नीशालम् आव्रजति । चात्वालोत्कराव् अन्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयलक्षणम् उत्तरेण सदश् चेति तीर्थम् ।
text_mt: Having been summoned for the carrying forward of Agni and Soma, he comes to the patnī's hall along the sacred path. The sacred path is between the pit and the rubbish heap, to the north of the marker of the āgnīdhra hearth, and [to the north of] the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: ācamanādi vīkṣaṇāntam |
meaning: आचमनादि वीक्षणान्तम् ।
text_mt:
[The acts] beginning with the sipping of water and ending with the gaze [take place as before].

He follows Agni and Soma being carried forward with the half-verse: "King Soma..."

sanskrit_iast: somaṃ rājānam ity ardharcenāgnīṣomau praṇīyamānāv anuvrajati |
meaning: सोमं राजानम् इत्य् अर्धर्चेनाग्नीषोमौ प्रणीयमानाव् अनुव्रजति ।

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīyahomād āgnīdhrīyam uttareṇāgnim apareṇātivrajyāsāda upaviśati |
meaning: आग्नीध्रीयहोमाद् आग्नीध्रीयम् उत्तरेणाग्निम् अपरेणातिव्रज्यासाद उपविशति ।
text_mt: From the offering at the āgnīdhra hearth, having walked past to the north of the āgnīdhra hearth and to the west of the fire, he sits down in his seat.

sanskrit_iast: athāgnīṣomīye paśāv uktā dharmāḥ | etena paśavo vyākhyātāḥ |
meaning: अथाग्नीषोमीये पशाव् उक्ता धर्माः । एतेन पशवो व्याख्याताः ।
text_mt: Now the rules are stated for the animal offering to Agni and Soma. By this, the animal offerings are explained.

sanskrit_iast: patnīsaṃyājāntaḥ |
meaning: पत्नीसंयाजान्तः ।

sanskrit_iast: vasatīvarīḥ parihriyamāṇāḥ pūrṇa nāri prabhara ity anumantrayate |
meaning: वसतीवरीः परिह्रियमाणाः पूर्ण नारि प्रभर इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the vasatīvarī waters being carried around with: "Full, O woman, bring forward...", and while they are being placed in the āgnīdhra hearth with the following [verse]: "Those over there..."

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīye sthāpyamānā uttarayā amūryāḥ iti ca |
meaning: आग्नीध्रीये स्थाप्यमाना उत्तरया अमूर्याः इति च ।

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitas tatra vasati |
meaning: दीक्षितस् तत्र वसति ।

sanskrit_iast: apararātra ṛtvijaḥ prabodhitāḥ śālādvārye 'pa upaspṛśanti |
meaning: अपररात्र ऋत्विजः प्रबोधिताः शालाद्वार्ये ऽप उपस्पृशन्ति ।
text_mt: In the latter part of the night, having been awakened, the officiating priests touch water at the door of the hall.

sanskrit_iast: havirupāvahṛta ityādi vaiśvānaro 'gniṣṭoma ityantābhir yajñatanūbhiḥ purā pracaritor āgnīdhrīye juhoti |
meaning: हविरुपावहृत इत्यादि वैश्वानरो ऽग्निष्टोम इत्यन्ताभिर् यज्ञतनूभिः पुरा प्रचरितोर् आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति ।
text_mt: Before the two [priests] proceed, he offers into the āgnīdhra hearth with the 'sacrificial bodies', beginning with: "The havis has been brought down..." and ending with: "The Agniṣṭoma is Vaiśvānara..."

sanskrit_iast: yajūṃṣi yajñe iti ca | viṣpardhāyāṃ caturbhiścaturbhiḥ purastāt prātaranuvākasya |
meaning: यजूंषि यज्ञे इति च । विष्पर्धायां चतुर्भिश्चतुर्भिः पुरस्तात् प्रातरनुवाकस्य ।
text_mt: And with: "The sacrificial formulas in the sacrifice..." In the case of a contest [between rivals], with four [formulas] each before the morning litany.

sanskrit_iast: enaṃ dakṣiṇenāhavanīyam apareṇātivrajyāsāda upaviśati |
meaning: एनं दक्षिणेनाहवनीयम् अपरेणातिव्रज्यासाद उपविशति ।
text_mt: Having walked past to the south of this [hearth] and to the west of the āhavanīya, he sits down in his seat.

sanskrit_iast: upaviṣṭe hotari hotāraṃ yad asmṛti iti hutvā purastāddhomān juhoti |
meaning: उपविष्टे होतरि होतारं यद् अस्मृति इति हुत्वा पुरस्ताद्धोमान् जुहोति ।
text_mt: When the hotṛ has sat down, having offered [an oblation] to the hotṛ with: "What of forgetfulness...", he offers the preliminary offerings.

sanskrit_iast: pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā iti catvāri sūktāni prātaranuvākam anu japati |
meaning: पातं न इन्द्रापूषणा इति चत्वारि सूक्तानि प्रातरनुवाकम् अनु जपति ।
text_mt: He mutters along with the morning litany the four hymns: "Protect us, Indra and Pūṣan..."

sanskrit_iast: ambayo yanti iti trīṇy aponaptrīyam |
meaning: अम्बयो यन्ति इति त्रीण्य् अपोनप्त्रीयम् ।
text_mt: [He mutters] the three [hymns]: "The mothers go..." along with the aponaptrīya [hymn].

sanskrit_iast: indra juṣasva iti rājñy abhiṣūyamāṇe 'bhiṣavaṇahomān juhoti | upāṃśugrahahomam sūryo dyām ity udite | antaryāmīyaṃ ca |
meaning: इन्द्र जुषस्व इति राज्ञ्य् अभिषूयमाणे ऽभिषवणहोमान् जुहोति । उपांशुग्रहहोमम् सूर्यो द्याम् इत्य् उदिते । अन्तर्यामीयं च ।
text_mt: While the King [Soma] is being pressed, he offers the pressing-oblations with: "Indra, take pleasure..."; the offering of the Upāṃśu draught with: "The sun [has ascended] the sky..." after [the sun] has risen; and that of the Antaryāma [draught].

sanskrit_iast: havirdhāne pūrveṇātītya khare copaviśya divas pṛthivyāḥ iti madhusūktena rājānaṃ saṃśrayati |
meaning: हविर्धाने पूर्वेणातीत्य खरे चोपविश्य दिवस् पृथिव्याः इति मधुसूक्तेन राजानं संश्रयति ।
text_mt: Having passed to the east of the two havirdhāna carts and having sat down on the mound, he addresses King [Soma] with the honey-hymn: "From heaven, from earth..."

sanskrit_iast: indrāya somam ṛtvijaḥ iti droṇakalaśastham anumantrayate |
meaning: इन्द्राय सोमम् ऋत्विजः इति द्रोणकलशस्थम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates with a mantra the [soma] resting in the droṇa-trough with: "To Indra the soma, O priests..."

sanskrit_iast: dhṛṣat piba iti mādhyandine |
meaning: धृषत् पिब इति माध्यन्दिने ।
text_mt: At the midday [service, he does so] with: "Boldly drink..."

sanskrit_iast: yatra vijānāti brahmant somo 'skan iti tam etayālabhyābhimantrayate abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nū na idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ | vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat iti |
meaning: यत्र विजानाति ब्रह्मन्त् सोमो ऽस्कन् इति तम् एतयालभ्याभिमन्त्रयते अभूद् देवः सविता वन्द्यो नू न इदानीम् अह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः । वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत् इति ।
text_mt: When he perceives: "O brahman, soma has spilled!", having touched it, he addresses it with this [verse]: "God Savitṛ has become worthy of praise; now indeed he is to be addressed by men at this time of day, he who distributes jewels to mankind, so that he may place the most excellent wealth with us here." With the seven [verses beginning]: "The fires that are within the waters...", he offers over it.

sanskrit_iast: ye agnayo apsv antaḥ iti saptabhir abhijuhoti |
meaning: ये अग्नयो अप्स्व् अन्तः इति सप्तभिर् अभिजुहोति ।

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā prastotodgātā pratihartā brahmā sunvan samanvārabdhā bahiṣpavamānāya visṛpya vaipruṣān homān juhvati drapsaś caskanda iti || yas te drapsaḥ skandati yas te aṃśur bāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt | adhvaryor vā pari yaḥ pavitrāt taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam || drapsaḥ patito 'tyasyavaś ca yaḥ paraḥ srucaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase || yas te drapsaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ dhānāsomaḥ parīvāpaḥ karambhaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu varcase || yan me skannam iti |
meaning: अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रस्तोतोद्गाता प्रतिहर्ता ब्रह्मा सुन्वन् समन्वारब्धा बहिष्पवमानाय विसृप्य वैप्रुषान् होमान् जुह्वति द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द इति ॥ यस् ते द्रप्सः स्कन्दति यस् ते अंशुर् बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् । अध्वर्योर् वा परि यः पवित्रात् तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् ॥ द्रप्सः पतितो ऽत्यस्यवश् च यः परः स्रुचः । अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः सं तं सिञ्चतु राधसे ॥ यस् ते द्रप्सः पतितः पृथिव्यां धानासोमः परीवापः करम्भः । अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः सं तं सिञ्चतु वर्चसे ॥ यन् मे स्कन्नम् इति ।
text_mt: The adhvaryu, the pratiprasthātā, the prastotṛ, the udgātṛ, the pratihartṛ, the brahman priest, [and] the presser, keeping hold of one another, having glided forward for the Bahiṣpavamāna [chant], offer the oblations for the spilt drops with: "A drop has spilled...", "The drop of yours that spills, the shoot of yours that, fallen from the arms, [falls] from the lap of the pressing-board, or that [falls] from the filter of the adhvaryu, that of yours I offer, made with the vaṣaṭ-call in mind / The drop that has fallen downwards, and that which is beyond the ladle, may this god Bṛhaspati pour it together for bounty / The drop of yours that has fallen on the earth—the parched grain, the soma, the roasted barley, the porridge—may this god Bṛhaspati pour it together for splendor!", [and with] "What of mine has spilled..."

sanskrit_iast: cātvālād dakṣiṇata upaviśanti |
meaning: चात्वालाद् दक्षिणत उपविशन्ति ।
text_mt: They sit down to the south of the pit.

sanskrit_iast: doṣo gāya iti japann udgātāram īkṣate |
meaning: दोषो गाय इति जपन्न् उद्गातारम् ईक्षते ।
text_mt: Muttering: "Sing in the evening...", he looks at the udgātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: stotropākaraṇāt prastotā brahmāṇam āmantrayate brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstaḥ iti |
meaning: स्तोत्रोपाकरणात् प्रस्तोता ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्रयते ब्रह्मन् स्तोष्यामः प्रशास्तः इति ।
text_mt: Before the beginning of the stotra, the prastotṛ addresses the brahman priest: "Brahman, we shall sing the praise, O director!"

sanskrit_iast: tatra raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinva | savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta | deva savitar etat te prāha tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja | āyuṣmatyā ṛco māpagāyata tanūpāt sāmnaḥ | satyā va āśiṣaḥ santu satyā ākūtayaḥ | ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca vadata | bṛhaspate 'numatyoṃ bhūr janad indravanta ity uktvā stuta iti prathamayā svaramātrayā prasauti | madhyamayā mādhyaṃdine | uttamayā tṛtīyasavane |
meaning: तत्र रश्मिर् असि क्षयाय त्वा क्षयं जिन्व । सवितृप्रसूता बृहस्पतये स्तुत । देव सवितर् एतत् ते प्राह तत् प्र च सुव प्र च यज । आयुष्मत्या ऋचो मापगायत तनूपात् साम्नः । सत्या व आशिषः सन्तु सत्या आकूतयः । ऋतं च सत्यं च वदत । बृहस्पते ऽनुमत्यों भूर् जनद् इन्द्रवन्त इत्य् उक्त्वा स्तुत इति प्रथमया स्वरमात्रया प्रसौति । मध्यमया माध्यंदिने । उत्तमया तृतीयसवने ।
text_mt: At that point, having recited: 'You are a ray; for dwelling I [call] upon you, quicken the dwelling! Impelled by Savitṛ, chant praise for Bṛhaspati! O god Savitṛ, this he has declared to you; impel that and sacrifice that! Do not sing away from the long-lived verse; [you are] the body-protector of the sāman. May your blessings come true; may your intentions come true. Speak truth and reality. O Bṛhaspati, with assent, oṃ, bhūḥ, janat, accompanied by Indra!', he impels with the word 'stuta' (chant praise!) in the first pitch-register; in the middle [register] at the midday pressing; in the highest [register] at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: bhuvaḥ iti mādhyaṃdine | svar iti tṛtīyasavane |
meaning: भुवः इति माध्यंदिने । स्वर् इति तृतीयसवने ।
text_mt: [He inserts] 'bhuvaḥ' at the midday pressing; 'svar' at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyādiṣv ahīne ca oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad vṛdhat karad ruhan mahat tac cham om iti ca |
meaning: उक्थ्यादिष्व् अहीने च ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् जनद् वृधत् करद् रुहन् महत् तच् छम् ओम् इति च ।
text_mt: At an Ukthya and subsequent [rites] and at an ahīna sacrifice, [he inserts] also: 'oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad vṛdhat karad ruhan mahat tac cham om'.

sanskrit_iast: viṣpardhamānayoḥ savṛtasomayoḥ stomabhāgānām uparyupari stuteṣe stutorje stuta devasya savituḥ save | bṛhaspatiṃ vaḥ prajāpatiṃ vo vasūn vo devān rudrān vo devān ādityān vo devān sādhyān vo devān āpyān vo devān viśvān vo devān sarvān vo devān viśvatas pari havāmahe | janebhyo 'smākam astu kevala itaḥ kṛṇotu vīryam iti japan pareṣāṃ brahmāṇam avekṣeta |
meaning: विष्पर्धमानयोः सवृतसोमयोः स्तोमभागानाम् उपर्युपरि स्तुतेषे स्तुतोर्जे स्तुत देवस्य सवितुः सवे । बृहस्पतिं वः प्रजापतिं वो वसून् वो देवान् रुद्रान् वो देवान् आदित्यान् वो देवान् साध्यान् वो देवान् आप्यान् वो देवान् विश्वान् वो देवान् सर्वान् वो देवान् विश्वतस् परि हवामहे । जनेभ्यो ऽस्माकम् अस्तु केवल इतः कृणोतु वीर्यम् इति जपन् परेषां ब्रह्माणम् अवेक्षेत ।
text_mt: When two rivals are competing with concurrent Soma sacrifices, muttering over and above the stomabhāga formulas: 'In the praise for refreshment, in the praise for strength, praised in the impulse of the god Savitṛ. Bṛhaspati, Prajāpati, your Vasu gods, your Rudra gods, your Āditya gods, your Sādhya gods, your Āpya gods, your All-gods, all your gods we summon from all around! To our people let [him] belong entirely; from here may he perform valor!', he should look toward the brahman priest of the others. / He consecrates the chant with the mantra: 'You are the praise of the chanted, full of strength, full of milk! May the praised chant yield strength to me; may the praise of the chanted come to me! Possessing vigorous faculty, we call; may we milk offspring and food! May that true blessing of mine be among the gods; may it cause me to attain sacred brilliance!'

sanskrit_iast: stutasya stutam asy ūrjasvat payasvat | ūrjaṃ mahyaṃ stutaṃ duhām ā mā stutasya stutaṃ gamet | indriyāvanto havāmahe dhukṣīmahi prajām iṣam | sā me satyāśīr deveṣv astu | brahmavarcasaṃ mā gamayet iti stotram anumantrayate |
meaning: स्तुतस्य स्तुतम् अस्य् ऊर्जस्वत् पयस्वत् । ऊर्जं मह्यं स्तुतं दुहाम् आ मा स्तुतस्य स्तुतं गमेत् । इन्द्रियावन्तो हवामहे धुक्षीमहि प्रजाम् इषम् । सा मे सत्याशीर् देवेष्व् अस्तु । ब्रह्मवर्चसं मा गमयेत् इति स्तोत्रम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।

sanskrit_iast: indrasya kukṣiḥ ity āsikte some pūtabhṛtam |
meaning: इन्द्रस्य कुक्षिः इत्य् आसिक्ते सोमे पूतभृतम् ।
text_mt: When the Soma is poured, [he consecrates] the pūtabhṛt vessel with [the verse]: 'Indra’s belly...' [AV 7.111.1].

sanskrit_iast: stute bahiṣpavamāne vācayati śyeno 'si iti | vṛṣāsi iti mādhyaṃdine | ṛbhur asi ity ārbhave |
meaning: स्तुते बहिष्पवमाने वाचयति श्येनो ऽसि इति । वृषासि इति माध्यंदिने । ऋभुर् असि इत्य् आर्भवे ।
text_mt: When the Bahiṣpavamāna chant is completed, he makes [the sacrificer] recite: 'You are a hawk...' [AV 6.48.1]; 'You are a bull...' [AV 6.48.3] at the midday pressing; 'You are an Ṛbhu...' [AV 6.48.2] at the Ārbhava chant.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇoktān ity anubrāhmaṇinaḥ |
meaning: ब्राह्मणोक्तान् इत्य् अनुब्राह्मणिनः ।
text_mt: '[Recite the formulas] taught in the Brāhmaṇa,' say the Anubrāhmaṇins.

sanskrit_iast: athādhvaryur āha agnīd agnīn vihara barhi stṛṇīhi paroḍāśān alaṃkuru iti |
meaning: अथाध्वर्युर् आह अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर बर्हि स्तृणीहि परोडाशान् अलंकुरु इति ।
text_mt: Then the adhvaryu says: 'Agnīdhra, distribute the fires, strew the sacred grass, prepare the sacrificial cakes!'

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhra āgnīdhrīyād aṅgārair dve savane viharati | śalākābhis tṛtīyasavanam | pratyaṅmukho hotṛmaitrāvaruṇabrāhmaṇācchaṃsipotṛneṣṭracchāvākānāṃ dhiṣṇyeṣu mārjālīye |
meaning: आग्नीध्र आग्नीध्रीयाद् अङ्गारैर् द्वे सवने विहरति । शलाकाभिस् तृतीयसवनम् । प्रत्यङ्मुखो होतृमैत्रावरुणब्राह्मणाच्छंसिपोतृनेष्ट्रच्छावाकानां धिष्ण्येषु मार्जालीये ।
text_mt: The āgnīdhra distributes [fire] from the āgnīdhra hearth with burning coals at the two pressings; with splinters of wood at the third pressing; facing west, upon the dhiṣṇya hearths of the hotṛ, maitrāvaruṇa, brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, potṛ, neṣṭṛ, acchāvāka, and upon the mārjālīya.

sanskrit_iast: tatraiva pratyānayati |
meaning: तत्रैव प्रत्यानयति ।
text_mt: He returns [the embers] to that very place.

sanskrit_iast: anu pṛṣṭyām āstīrya puroḍāśān alaṃkurute |
meaning: अनु पृष्ट्याम् आस्तीर्य पुरोडाशान् अलंकुरुते ।
text_mt: Having strewn [grass] along the spine-line, he prepares the sacrificial cakes.

sanskrit_iast: ye agnayo vihṛtā dhiṣṇyāḥ pṛthivīm anu | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas te no mā hiṃsiṣuḥ iti vihṛtān anumantrayate | uttarayoḥ savanayoḥ punar maitv indriyam iti | āhavanīyam apareṇetyuktam |
meaning: ये अग्नयो विहृता धिष्ण्याः पृथिवीम् अनु । ते नः पान्तु ते नो ऽवन्तु तेभ्यो नमस् ते नो मा हिंसिषुः इति विहृतान् अनुमन्त्रयते । उत्तरयोः सवनयोः पुनर् मैत्व् इन्द्रियम् इति । आहवनीयम् अपरेणेत्युक्तम् ।
text_mt: He consecrates the distributed fires with the mantra: 'The fires that have been distributed along the earth as dhiṣṇyas, may they protect us, may they help us; homage to them, may they not harm us!' At the latter two pressings, [he consecrates them] with: 'May my faculty return to me...' [AV 7.67.1]. It has already been stated that [he does so standing] behind the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pravṛtāḥ pravṛtāhutīr juhvati juṣṭo vāce bhūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspataye devi vāg yad vāco madhumattamaṃ tasmin mā dhāḥ svāhā | vāce svāhā vācaspataye svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā iti | manasā caturthīm |
meaning: प्रवृताः प्रवृताहुतीर् जुह्वति जुष्टो वाचे भूयासं जुष्टो वाचस्पतये देवि वाग् यद् वाचो मधुमत्तमं तस्मिन् मा धाः स्वाहा । वाचे स्वाहा वाचस्पतये स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा इति । मनसा चतुर्थीम् ।
text_mt: Those who have been chosen offer the election oblations with the formulas: 'May I be agreeable to Speech, agreeable to the Lord of Speech! O divine Speech, place me in that which of speech is sweetest, svāhā! To Speech svāhā! To the Lord of Speech svāhā! To Sarasvatī svāhā!' [He offers] the fourth [oblation] mentally. / Some say [there are] seven oblations: 'To Sarasvant svāhā! To greatness, to joint greatness, svāhā! By verse, the stoma...' [AV 5.24.1-17 / etc.].

sanskrit_iast: saptāhutīr ity eke sarasvate svāhā mahobhyaḥ saṃmahobhyaḥ svāhā | ṛcā stomam iti |
meaning: सप्ताहुतीर् इत्य् एके सरस्वते स्वाहा महोभ्यः संमहोभ्यः स्वाहा । ऋचा स्तोमम् इति ।

sanskrit_iast: vapāmārjanānta upotthāya divas pṛṣṭhe ity ādityam upatiṣṭhante |
meaning: वपामार्जनान्त उपोत्थाय दिवस् पृष्ठे इत्य् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ते ।
text_mt: At the conclusion of the cleansing after the omentum [offering], having risen up, they revere the sun with [the verse]: 'Upon the back of the sky...' [AV 13.2.37].

sanskrit_iast: mā pra gāma ity āvrajyāhavanīyaṃ nirmathyaṃ yūpam ādityam agnayaḥ sagarā stha sagareṇa nāmnā raudreṇānīkena pāta māgnayaḥ pipṛta māgnayo gopāyata mā namo vo 'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa iti |
meaning: मा प्र गाम इत्य् आव्रज्याहवनीयं निर्मथ्यं यूपम् आदित्यम् अग्नयः सगरा स्थ सगरेण नाम्ना रौद्रेणानीकेन पात माग्नयः पिपृत माग्नयो गोपायत मा नमो वो ऽस्तु मा मा हिंसिष्ट इति ।
text_mt: Having walked up with [the verse]: 'May we not depart...' [AV 13.1.59], [they revere] the āhavanīya fire, the churned-out fire, the sacrificial post, and the sun with: 'You fires are of the ocean; by your oceanic name, with your fierce array, protect me, O fires; nourish me, O fires; watch over me, homage be to you, do not harm me!'

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīyam uttareṇa sado 'bhivrajanti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रीयम् उत्तरेण सदो ऽभिव्रजन्ति ।
text_mt: They proceed toward the sadas shed north of the āgnīdhra fire-hearth.

sanskrit_iast: dhiṣṇyavanto yajamānaś ca pūrvayā dvārā prasarpanti | apare 'parayā |
meaning: धिष्ण्यवन्तो यजमानश् च पूर्वया द्वारा प्रसर्पन्ति । अपरे ऽपरया ।
text_mt: Those who possess dhiṣṇyas and the sacrificer glide in through the eastern door; the others through the western door.

sanskrit_iast: sadaḥ prasṛpsyanto dhiṣṇyān namaskurvanti dhiṣṇyebhyo namo namaḥ iti |
meaning: सदः प्रसृप्स्यन्तो धिष्ण्यान् नमस्कुर्वन्ति धिष्ण्येभ्यो नमो नमः इति ।
text_mt:
About to glide into the sadas shed, they pay homage to the dhiṣṇyas with: 'Homage, homage to the dhiṣṇyas!'

As they glide in, [they salute] the overseer with: 'Homage to the overseer!'; the overhearing witness with: 'Homage to the overhearing witness!' / They revere the pit, the rubbish heap, the slaughtering place, the dung-hole, the āgnīdhra hearth, the acchāvāka's reciting place, the mārjālīya, the mound, and the other dhiṣṇyas with: 'You fires are of the ocean...' [cf. 18.8].

sanskrit_iast: draṣṭre namaḥ iti draṣṭāraṃ prasarpantaḥ | upaśrotre namaḥ ity upaśrotāram |
meaning: द्रष्ट्रे नमः इति द्रष्टारं प्रसर्पन्तः । उपश्रोत्रे नमः इत्य् उपश्रोतारम् ।

sanskrit_iast: cātvālotkaraśāmitrovadhyagohāstāvāagnīdhrīyācchāvākavādaṃ mārjālīyaṃ kharaṃ dhiṣṇyān anyāṃś copatiṣṭhante agnayaḥ sagarā stha iti |
meaning: चात्वालोत्करशामित्रोवध्यगोहास्तावाअग्नीध्रीयाच्छावाकवादं मार्जालीयं खरं धिष्ण्यान् अन्यांश् चोपतिष्ठन्ते अग्नयः सगरा स्थ इति ।

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣaṃ vīhi iti sado 'bhimṛśanti | devī dvārau mā mā santāptaṃ lokaṃ me lokakṛtau kṛṇutam iti dvārye |
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षं वीहि इति सदो ऽभिमृशन्ति । देवी द्वारौ मा मा सन्ताप्तं लोकं मे लोककृतौ कृणुतम् इति द्वार्ये ।
text_mt: They touch the sadas shed with: 'Traverse the wide intermediate space!'; and the two door-posts with: 'O divine door-leaves, do not scorch me!' and 'Make a room for me, you room-makers!'

sanskrit_iast: prasṛpya anukhyātre namaḥ ity anukhyātāram | uttareṇa dhiṣṇyān parikramya svaṃ svaṃ dhiṣṇyam abhiprasṛptāḥ upadraṣṭre namaḥ ity upadraṣṭāram |
meaning: प्रसृप्य अनुख्यात्रे नमः इत्य् अनुख्यातारम् । उत्तरेण धिष्ण्यान् परिक्रम्य स्वं स्वं धिष्ण्यम् अभिप्रसृप्ताः उपद्रष्ट्रे नमः इत्य् उपद्रष्टारम् ।
text_mt: Having glided in, [they salute] the beholder with: 'Homage to the beholder!' Having walked around north of the dhiṣṇyas, having glided toward each one's own dhiṣṇya, [they salute] the onlooker with: 'Homage to the onlooker!'

sanskrit_iast: upaviśya japanty abhi tvendra iti | stotraṃ yajamānaḥ |
meaning: उपविश्य जपन्त्य् अभि त्वेन्द्र इति । स्तोत्रं यजमानः ।
text_mt: Having sat down, they mutter: 'Toward you, O Indra...' [AV 6.99.1]; the sacrificer [mutters while looking at] the chant.

sanskrit_iast: sadasyo brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇena | stotrānumantraṇāj janat iti manasā |
meaning: सदस्यो ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणेन । स्तोत्रानुमन्त्रणाज् जनत् इति मनसा ।
text_mt: The sadasya [sits] south of the brahman priest; before the consecration of the chant [he recites] mentally: 'janat'.

sanskrit_iast: visaṃsthite yathādhiṣṇyam uttareṇa pūrvayā dvārā niṣkrāmanti | maitrāvaruṇadhiṣṇyam adhiṣṇyavantaḥ |
meaning: विसंस्थिते यथाधिष्ण्यम् उत्तरेण पूर्वया द्वारा निष्क्रामन्ति । मैत्रावरुणधिष्ण्यम् अधिष्ण्यवन्तः ।
text_mt: When the rite is completed, they exit according to their dhiṣṇyas to the north by the eastern door; those without dhiṣṇyas [exit north of] the maitrāvaruṇa's dhiṣṇya.

sanskrit_iast: savanīyapuroḍāśānām aindrān |
meaning: सवनीयपुरोडाशानाम् ऐन्द्रान् ।
text_mt: Of the soma-offering cakes, [he consecrates] those for Indra.

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyānām | aindravāyavasya homau vāyur antarikṣasya indravāyū iti |
meaning: द्विदेवत्यानाम् । ऐन्द्रवायवस्य होमौ वायुर् अन्तरिक्षस्य इन्द्रवायू इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates the oblations] of the dual-deity soma draughts; the two oblations of the cup for Indra and Vāyu with: 'Vāyu, of the intermediate space...' [AV 5.24.8] and 'O Indra and Vāyu...' [AV 3.20.6].

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇasya mitrāvaruṇau vṛṣṭyāḥ iti |
meaning: मैत्रावरुणस्य मित्रावरुणौ वृष्ट्याः इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates that] of the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa with: 'Mitra and Varuṇa, of rain...' [AV 5.24.5].

sanskrit_iast: āśvinasya aśvinā brahmaṇā ity ardharcena |
meaning: आश्विनस्य अश्विना ब्रह्मणा इत्य् अर्धर्चेन ।
text_mt: [He consecrates that] of the cup for the Aśvins with the half-verse: 'O Aśvins, by the sacred formula...' [AV 5.26.12ab].

sanskrit_iast: prasthitaiś cariṣyann adhvaryuḥ saṃpreṣyati hotar yaja praśāstar brāhmaṇācchaṃsin potar neṣṭar agnīt iti |
meaning: प्रस्थितैश् चरिष्यन्न् अध्वर्युः संप्रेष्यति होतर् यज प्रशास्तर् ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिन् पोतर् नेष्टर् अग्नीत् इति ।
text_mt: When about to perform with the set-out soma draughts, the adhvaryu gives the direction: 'Hotṛ, sacrifice! Praśāstṛ, brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, potṛ, neṣṭṛ, agnīdhra [sacrifice]!'

sanskrit_iast: indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī yajati | uttarābhyāṃ potrāgnīdhrau |
meaning: इन्द्र त्वा वृषभं वयम् इति ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी यजति । उत्तराभ्यां पोत्राग्नीध्रौ ।
text_mt: With 'Indra, you the bull we [call upon]' the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin recites the offering verse; with the following two verses the potṛ and the āgnīdhra [respectively].

sanskrit_iast: yājyānām antaḥ plavate |
meaning: याज्यानाम् अन्तः प्लवते ।
text_mt: The end of the offering verses is prolated.

sanskrit_iast: ye yajāmahe vauṣaṭ ityādyantau | ādiplutau |
meaning: ये यजामहे वौषट् इत्याद्यन्तौ । आदिप्लुतौ ।
text_mt: 'Ye3 yajāmahe' and 'vau3ṣaṭ' are the beginning and the end; they are prolated at their beginnings.

sanskrit_iast: anavānaṃ prātaḥsavane | vaṣaṭkṛtya vāg ojaḥ saha ojo mayi prāṇāpānau ity anumantrayate |
meaning: अनवानं प्रातःसवने । वषट्कृत्य वाग् ओजः सह ओजो मयि प्राणापानौ इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: Without pausing for breath during the morning pressing. Having uttered the vaṣaṭ-call, he consecrates [the offering] with: 'Speech, vigor, strength, vigor! In me be the in-breath and out-breath!'

sanskrit_iast: somasyāgne vīhī ity antaplutenānuvaṣaṭkurvanti |
meaning: सोमस्याग्ने वीही इत्य् अन्तप्लुतेनानुवषट्कुर्वन्ति ।
text_mt: They perform the second vaṣaṭ-call with the end prolated: 'Of the soma, O Agni, partake3!'

sanskrit_iast: śukrāmanthicamasahomān aindrān indro divaḥ iti |
meaning: शुक्रामन्थिचमसहोमान् ऐन्द्रान् इन्द्रो दिवः इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the oblations of the śukra and manthin cups, dedicated to Indra, with 'Indra from heaven'.

sanskrit_iast: anuvaṣaṭkārāṇām ā devānām iti | anuhomāṃś ca | maitrāvaruṇam aindraṃ mārutaṃ tvāṣṭram āgneyam |
meaning: अनुवषट्काराणाम् आ देवानाम् इति । अनुहोमांश् च । मैत्रावरुणम् ऐन्द्रं मारुतं त्वाष्ट्रम् आग्नेयम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates the offerings] of the second vaṣaṭ-calls with 'Come to the gods', and the after-oblations: dedicated to Mitra-Varuṇa, Indra, the Maruts, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: agnīdheṣṭe 'dhvaryur āha ayāḍ agnīt iti | ayāṭ ity agnīt |
meaning: अग्नीधेष्टे ऽध्वर्युर् आह अयाड् अग्नीत् इति । अयाट् इत्य् अग्नीत् ।
text_mt: When the offering of the āgnīdhra has been made, the adhvaryu says: 'Has the agnīt sacrificed?' 'He has sacrificed,' says the agnīt.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavad iḍābhakṣaḥ |
meaning: पूर्ववद् इडाभक्षः ।

sanskrit_iast: sadasi somān bhakṣayanty upahūtāḥ |
meaning: सदसि सोमान् भक्षयन्त्य् उपहूताः ।
text_mt: Having been invited, they consume the somas in the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: prāśitravat pratīkṣya pratigṛhya agnihutasyendrapītasyendor indriyāvataḥ | yo bhakṣo gosanir aśvasanir dhanasaniḥ prajāsanir lokasaniḥ | tasya ta upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi gāyatreṇa chandasā tejasā brāhmaṇavarcasena iti |
meaning: प्राशित्रवत् प्रतीक्ष्य प्रतिगृह्य अग्निहुतस्येन्द्रपीतस्येन्दोर् इन्द्रियावतः । यो भक्षो गोसनिर् अश्वसनिर् धनसनिः प्रजासनिर् लोकसनिः । तस्य त उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि गायत्रेण छन्दसा तेजसा ब्राह्मणवर्चसेन इति ।
text_mt: Looking upon it and receiving it as with the prāśitra portion, [he consumes it] with: 'Of the drop, offered in fire, drunk by Indra, possessing virility, which consumption is cattle-gaining, horse-gaining, wealth-gaining, offspring-gaining, world-gaining—invited, I consume that of yours, the invited one, with the gāyatrī metre, with brilliance, with brahmic luster.'

sanskrit_iast: traiṣṭubheneti mādhyāṃdine | jāgateneti tṛtīyasavane | anuṣṭupchandaseti paryāyeṣu | paṅkticchandaseti saṃdhicamaseṣu | aticchandasety aptoryāmṇi |
meaning: त्रैष्टुभेनेति माध्यांदिने । जागतेनेति तृतीयसवने । अनुष्टुप्छन्दसेति पर्यायेषु । पङ्क्तिच्छन्दसेति संधिचमसेषु । अतिच्छन्दसेत्य् अप्तोर्याम्णि ।
text_mt: 'With the triṣṭubh metre' at the midday pressing; 'with the jagatī metre' at the third pressing; 'with the anuṣṭubh metre' during the nocturnal rounds; 'with the paṅkti metre' at the twilight cups; 'with the hyper-metre' at the Aptoryāma.

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣita ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśanti śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indro piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ | sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ || hinvā me gātrā harivo gaṇān me mā vyarīriṣaḥ | śivo me saptarṣīn upatiṣṭha mā me 'vāg nābhir abhi gāḥ iti |
meaning: भक्षित आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशन्ति शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इन्द्रो पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः । सखेव सख्य उरुशंस धीरः प्र ण आयुर् जीवसे सोम तारीः ॥ हिन्वा मे गात्रा हरिवो गणान् मे मा व्यरीरिषः । शिवो मे सप्तर्षीन् उपतिष्ठ मा मे ऽवाग् नाभिर् अभि गाः इति ।
text_mt: When it has been consumed, they touch themselves with: 'Be auspicious to our heart, drunk, O Indra; as a father to his son, O Soma, most gentle, / as a friend to a friend, O wide-praised, wise one, prolong our lifespan so that we may live, O Soma!' 'Invigorate my limbs, O tawny one; do not injure my vital breaths! Auspicious, attend upon my Seven Seers; do not descend below my navel!'

sanskrit_iast: camasān āpyāyayanty ā pyāyasva saṃ te payāṃsi iti |
meaning: चमसान् आप्याययन्त्य् आ प्यायस्व सं ते पयांसि इति ।
text_mt: They swell the cups with: 'Swell up; let your juices gather together.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra ślokaḥ pañcaiva kṛtvaś camasān yajña āpyāyayet kaviḥ | ājye marutvatīye ca prasthitāś cāpi sarvaśaḥ iti |
meaning: तत्र श्लोकः पञ्चैव कृत्वश् चमसान् यज्ञ आप्याययेत् कविः । आज्ये मरुत्वतीये च प्रस्थिताश् चापि सर्वशः इति ।
text_mt: On this there is a verse: 'Only five times should the wise man swell the cups at the sacrifice: at the ājya [sastras], at the marutvatīya, and also completely for the prasthita [draughts].'

sanskrit_iast: acchāvākacamasahomam aindrāgnam |
meaning: अच्छावाकचमसहोमम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the cup oblation of the acchāvāka, dedicated to Indra-Agni.

sanskrit_iast: yady aśnanty āgnīdhrīye |
meaning: यद्य् अश्नन्त्य् आग्नीध्रीये ।
text_mt: If they eat in the āgnīdhra shed.

sanskrit_iast: sadasy upaviṣṭā yathāpraiṣam ṛtūn yajanti |
meaning: सदस्य् उपविष्टा यथाप्रैषम् ऋतून् यजन्ति ।
text_mt: Seated in the sadas, they sacrifice to the seasons according to the praiṣa commands.

sanskrit_iast: marutaḥ potrāt iti prathamottamābhyāṃ potā | dvitīyayāgnīdhraḥ | tṛtīyayā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī |
meaning: मरुतः पोत्रात् इति प्रथमोत्तमाभ्यां पोता । द्वितीययाग्नीध्रः । तृतीयया ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी ।
text_mt: With 'O Maruts, from the potṛ's bowl' the potṛ [sacrifices] with the first and the last verses; the āgnīdhra with the second; the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin with the third.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāno 'tipreṣyati hotar etad yaja iti |
meaning: यजमानो ऽतिप्रेष्यति होतर् एतद् यज इति ।
text_mt: The sacrificer calls past with: 'Hotṛ, sacrifice this!'

sanskrit_iast: nānuvaṣaṭkurvanti |
meaning: नानुवषट्कुर्वन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: tatra ślokaḥ dvidevatyān ṛtuyājān yaś ca pātnīvato grahaḥ | ādityagrahasāvitrau tān sma mānuvaṣaṭkṛthāḥ iti |
meaning: तत्र श्लोकः द्विदेवत्यान् ऋतुयाजान् यश् च पात्नीवतो ग्रहः । आदित्यग्रहसावित्रौ तान् स्म मानुवषट्कृथाः इति ।

sanskrit_iast: ṛtuhomān | aindraṃ mārutaṃ tvāṣṭram āgneyam aindraṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ caturo drāviṇodasān āśvinaṃ gārhapatyam |
meaning: ऋतुहोमान् । ऐन्द्रं मारुतं त्वाष्ट्रम् आग्नेयम् ऐन्द्रं मैत्रावरुणं चतुरो द्राविणोदसान् आश्विनं गार्हपत्यम् ।

sanskrit_iast: ṛtupātre bhakṣayanti limpanti vāvajighranti vā ko 'si yaśo 'si yaśodā asi yaśo mayi dhehi iti |
meaning: ऋतुपात्रे भक्षयन्ति लिम्पन्ति वावजिघ्रन्ति वा को ऽसि यशो ऽसि यशोदा असि यशो मयि धेहि इति ।
text_mt: They consume from the season-vessel, or they smear it, or they smell it with: 'Who are you? Fame are you; fame-giving are you; place fame in me!'

sanskrit_iast: nārāśaṃsāṃs tūṣṇīṃ pratigṛhya bhakṣayanti narāśaṃsapītasya deva soma te nṛbhiḥ ṣṭutasya matividaḥ | ūmaiḥ pitṛbhir bhakṣitasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi iti |
meaning: नाराशंसांस् तूष्णीं प्रतिगृह्य भक्षयन्ति नराशंसपीतस्य देव सोम ते नृभिः ष्टुतस्य मतिविदः । ऊमैः पितृभिर् भक्षितस्योपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि इति ।
text_mt: Receiving the nārāśaṃsa cups silently, they consume them with: 'Drunk by Narāśaṃsa, O divine Soma, praised by men, who know the prayer, consumed by the helping fathers—invited, I consume [the share] of you, the invited one.'

sanskrit_iast: ūrvaiḥ iti mādhyaṃdine | kāvyaiḥ iti tṛtīyasavane |
meaning: ऊर्वैः इति माध्यंदिने । काव्यैः इति तृतीयसवने ।
text_mt: 'By the ūru fathers' at the midday pressing; 'by the kāvya fathers' at the third pressing. They summon the mind with: 'Now we summon the mind.'

sanskrit_iast: mano nv ā hvāmahi iti mana upāhvayante |
meaning: मनो न्व् आ ह्वामहि इति मन उपाह्वयन्ते ।

sanskrit_iast: pañcakṛtvo nārāśaṃsān bhakṣayanti |
meaning: पञ्चकृत्वो नाराशंसान् भक्षयन्ति ।
text_mt: Five times they consume the nārāśaṃsa cups.

sanskrit_iast: tatra ślokaḥ pañcaiva kṛtvaś camasān nārāśaṃseṣu bhakṣayet | hotuḥ pūrveṣu śastreṣu yāni prāg āgnimārutāt iti |
meaning: तत्र श्लोकः पञ्चैव कृत्वश् चमसान् नाराशंसेषु भक्षयेत् । होतुः पूर्वेषु शस्त्रेषु यानि प्राग् आग्निमारुतात् इति ।
text_mt: On this there is a verse: 'Only five times should one consume the cups at the nārāśaṃsa [libations]: during the earlier recitations of the hotṛ, which are before the Āgnimāruta.'

sanskrit_iast: ājyaśastrād aindrāgnam |
meaning: आज्यशस्त्राद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् ।
text_mt: After the recitation of the ājya sastra, [he consecrates the oblation] to Indra-Agni.

sanskrit_iast: hotre praugastotrāya prasauti pretir asi dharmaṇe tvā dharmaṃ jinva | maitrāvaruṇāya anvitir asi dive tvā divaṃ jinva | brāhmaṇācchaṃsine saṃdhir asy antarikṣāya tvāntarikṣaṃ jinva | acchāvākāya pratidhir asi pṛthivyai tvā pṛthivīṃ jinva iti |
meaning: होत्रे प्रौगस्तोत्राय प्रसौति प्रेतिर् असि धर्मणे त्वा धर्मं जिन्व । मैत्रावरुणाय अन्वितिर् असि दिवे त्वा दिवं जिन्व । ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिने संधिर् अस्य् अन्तरिक्षाय त्वान्तरिक्षं जिन्व । अच्छावाकाय प्रतिधिर् असि पृथिव्यै त्वा पृथिवीं जिन्व इति ।
text_mt: He impels the hotṛ for the Prauga stotra with: 'You are the forwarding; for duty [I impel] you, enliven duty!'; the maitrāvaruṇa with: 'You are the pursuing; for heaven [I impel] you, enliven heaven!'; the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin with: 'You are the conjunction; for the mid-air [I impel] you, enliven the mid-air!'; the acchāvāka with: 'You are the crossbar; for the earth [I impel] you, enliven the earth!'

sanskrit_iast: praugaśastrād vaiśvadevam | maitrāvaruṇasya maitrāvaruṇam | brāhmaṇācchaṃsina aindram | acchāvākasyaindrāgnam |
meaning: प्रौगशस्त्राद् वैश्वदेवम् । मैत्रावरुणस्य मैत्रावरुणम् । ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिन ऐन्द्रम् । अच्छावाकस्यैन्द्राग्नम् ।
text_mt: After the recitation of the prauga sastra, [the offering is] dedicated to the All-gods; of the maitrāvaruṇa's [sastra], dedicated to Mitra-Varuṇa; of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's, dedicated to Indra; of the acchāvāka's, dedicated to Indra-Agni.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇācchaṃsy uttamāt pratīhārāt trir hiṅkṛtya śaṃsāvom ity adhvaryum āhvayate |
meaning: ब्राह्मणाच्छंस्य् उत्तमात् प्रतीहारात् त्रिर् हिङ्कृत्य शंसावोम् इत्य् अध्वर्युम् आह्वयते ।
text_mt: Having uttered 'hiṅ' three times after the last pratīhāra, the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin addresses the adhvaryu with: 'Let the two of us recite, om!'

sanskrit_iast: ahiṅkāram anurūpāyokthamukhāya paridhānīyāyai | pragāthāya ca mādhyaṃdine |
meaning: अहिङ्कारम् अनुरूपायोक्थमुखाय परिधानीयायै । प्रगाथाय च माध्यंदिने ।
text_mt: Without the sound 'hiṅ' for the antistrophe, the beginning of the uktha, and the concluding verse; and for the pragātha at the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: yonaya eke |
meaning: योनय एके ।

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo śaṃsāvom iti stotriyāya adhvaryo śaṃśaṃsāvom iti tṛtīyasavane |
meaning: अध्वर्यो शंसावोम् इति स्तोत्रियाय अध्वर्यो शंशंसावोम् इति तृतीयसवने ।
text_mt: With 'Adhvaryu, let the two of us recite, om!' for the strophe verse; with 'Adhvaryu, let the two of us recite, recite, om!' at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: āhāveṣu śaṃsāvo daiva ity adhvaryuḥ pratigṛṇāti |
meaning: आहावेषु शंसावो दैव इत्य् अध्वर्युः प्रतिगृणाति ।
text_mt: At the calls, the adhvaryu responds with: 'Let the two of us recite, divine one!'

sanskrit_iast: othāmo daiva ity avasāne | omothāmo daiva iti praṇave | om iti śastrānte |
meaning: ओथामो दैव इत्य् अवसाने । ओमोथामो दैव इति प्रणवे । ओम् इति शस्त्रान्ते ।
text_mt: With 'May we attain it, divine one!' at a pause; with 'Om, may we attain it, divine one!' at the sacred syllable om; with 'Om' at the end of the recitation.

sanskrit_iast: ukthapratigaram āha | ukthasaṃpatsu om ukthaśā ukthaśā yajokthaśāḥ iti | sāmnā śastram upasaṃtanoti | ardharcaśo mandrayā vācā | balīyasyā mādhyaṃdine | baliṣṭhatamayā tṛtīyasavane | uttariṇyottariṇyotsahed ā samāpanāt |
meaning: उक्थप्रतिगरम् आह । उक्थसंपत्सु ओम् उक्थशा उक्थशा यजोक्थशाः इति । साम्ना शस्त्रम् उपसंतनोति । अर्धर्चशो मन्द्रया वाचा । बलीयस्या माध्यंदिने । बलिष्ठतमया तृतीयसवने । उत्तरिण्योत्तरिण्योत्सहेद् आ समापनात् ।
text_mt: He pronounces the response to the uktha. In the uktha-conjunctions [the response is]: 'om ukthaśā ukthaśā yajokthaśāḥ'. He links the recitation continuously with a melody: by half-verses, in a gentle voice; in a stronger [voice] at the midday [pressing]; in the strongest [voice] at the third pressing. He should proceed from one higher pitch to the next until the end.

sanskrit_iast: ā yāhi suṣumā hi te ā no yāhi sutāvataḥ iti stotriyānurūpau |
meaning: आ याहि सुषुमा हि ते आ नो याहि सुतावतः इति स्तोत्रियानुरूपौ ।
text_mt: 'Come hither, for we have pressed for thee' [and] 'Come to us, having pressed soma' are the strophe and antistrophe verses.

sanskrit_iast: ayam u tvā vicarṣaṇe ity ukthamukham | uddhed abhi śrutām agham iti paryāsaḥ | uttamā paridhānīyā |
meaning: अयम् उ त्वा विचर्षणे इत्य् उक्थमुखम् । उद्धेद् अभि श्रुताम् अघम् इति पर्यासः । उत्तमा परिधानीया ।
text_mt: 'Now this [soma], O far-seeing one' is the opening of the uktha. 'Upward indeed toward the famous evil' is the concluding verse of the uktha. The last [verse] is the concluding verse.

sanskrit_iast: triḥ prathamāṃ trir uttamām anvāha |
meaning: त्रिः प्रथमां त्रिर् उत्तमाम् अन्वाह ।
text_mt: He recites the first [verse] thrice and the last [verse] thrice.

sanskrit_iast: ardharcaśasya ṛgantaṃ praṇavenopasaṃtanoti svarādim apanīya | pacchaḥśasye 'rdharcāntam | śastrāntaṃ makārāntenaiva |
meaning: अर्धर्चशस्य ऋगन्तं प्रणवेनोपसंतनोति स्वरादिम् अपनीय । पच्छःशस्ये ऽर्धर्चान्तम् । शस्त्रान्तं मकारान्तेनैव ।
text_mt: In a recitation by half-verses, he links the end of the verse continuously with the praṇava, having dropped the initial vowel; in a recitation by verse-quarters, the end of the half-verse; [and] the end of the recitation with [a praṇava] ending in the letter m only.

sanskrit_iast: śastvā ukthaṃ vāci ity āha | ukthaṃ vācīndrāya iti mādhyaṃdine | ukthaṃ vācīndrāya devebhyaḥ iti tṛtīyasavane |
meaning: शस्त्वा उक्थं वाचि इत्य् आह । उक्थं वाचीन्द्राय इति माध्यंदिने । उक्थं वाचीन्द्राय देवेभ्यः इति तृतीयसवने ।
text_mt: Having recited, he says: 'The uktha has been spoken.' At the midday [pressing, he says]: 'The uktha has been spoken to Indra.' At the third pressing: 'The uktha has been spoken to Indra [and] the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: ukthyasaṃpadaḥ | paridhānīyottarā yājyā |
meaning: उक्थ्यसंपदः । परिधानीयोत्तरा याज्या ।
text_mt: [These are] the ukthya-conjunctions. The offering verse is the one following the concluding verse.

sanskrit_iast: acchāvākabhakṣād agniḥ prātaḥsavane śyeno 'si yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane iti yathāsavanam ājyaṃ juhoti |
meaning: अच्छावाकभक्षाद् अग्निः प्रातःसवने श्येनो ऽसि यथा सोमः प्रातःसवने इति यथासवनम् आज्यं जुहोति ।
text_mt: Before the consumption by the acchāvāka priest, he offers clarified butter according to the respective pressings with: 'Agni at the morning pressing', 'Thou art a falcon', [and] 'As soma at the morning pressing'.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthitahomān |
meaning: संस्थितहोमान् ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthitesaṃsthite savane vācayati mayi bhargo mayi maho mayi yaśo mayi sarvam iti |
meaning: संस्थितेसंस्थिते सवने वाचयति मयि भर्गो मयि महो मयि यशो मयि सर्वम् इति ।
text_mt: At the conclusion of each pressing, he causes [the sacrificer] to recite: 'In me be splendour, in me greatness, in me renown, in me everything.'

sanskrit_iast: preṣitā mādhyaṃdināyaudumbarīm abhyaparayā dvārā niṣkramyāgnīdhrīyāt sarpanti | yajamānaḥ pūrvayā |
meaning: प्रेषिता माध्यंदिनायौदुम्बरीम् अभ्यपरया द्वारा निष्क्रम्याग्नीध्रीयात् सर्पन्ति । यजमानः पूर्वया ।
text_mt: When summoned for the midday [pressing], they glide from the āgnīdhra's hearth toward the audumbarī post, having exited by the western door; the sacrificer [exits] by the eastern [door].

sanskrit_iast: purastāddhomān |
meaning: पुरस्ताद्धोमान् ।

sanskrit_iast: uktam abhiṣavādi |
meaning: उक्तम् अभिषवादि ।

sanskrit_iast: pavamānāya sadaḥ prasarpanti |
meaning: पवमानाय सदः प्रसर्पन्ति ।
text_mt: They glide forward to the sadas for the pavamāna stotra.

sanskrit_iast: āmantritaḥ prasauti viṣṭambho 'si vṛṣṭyai tvā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva iti |
meaning: आमन्त्रितः प्रसौति विष्टम्भो ऽसि वृष्ट्यै त्वा वृष्टिं जिन्व इति ।
text_mt: When invited, he impels [the chanting] with: 'Thou art the support; for rain thee! Quicken rain!'

sanskrit_iast: viharaṇe dhiṣṇyavān bahiś ced dhiṣṇyam abhyetya pari tvāgne iti japati |
meaning: विहरणे धिष्ण्यवान् बहिश् चेद् धिष्ण्यम् अभ्येत्य परि त्वाग्ने इति जपति ।
text_mt: At the distribution [of fires], if the holder of a dhiṣṇya hearth is outside, he approaches his dhiṣṇya hearth and mutters: 'Around thee, O Agni'.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā ca |
meaning: ब्रह्मा च ।

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣito bahirvedyabhyāśrāvaṇe 'stamaye 'bhyudaye vā agnaya upāhvayadhvam iti |
meaning: दीक्षितो बहिर्वेद्यभ्याश्रावणे ऽस्तमये ऽभ्युदये वा अग्नय उपाह्वयध्वम् इति ।
text_mt: If the consecrated sacrificer is called upon outside the altar, at sunset or at sunrise, [he mutters]: 'O fires, invite [me]!'

sanskrit_iast: śrātaṃ manya iti dadhigharmahomam |
meaning: श्रातं मन्य इति दधिघर्महोमम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the oblation of the curd-gharma with: 'Cooked, I think'.

sanskrit_iast: gharmavadbhakṣo rasaprāśanyā |
meaning: घर्मवद्भक्षो रसप्राशन्या ।
text_mt: The consumption is like that of the gharma, with the verse for tasting the liquid.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśasya |
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: evā pāhi iti prasthitayājyāḥ |
meaning: एवा पाहि इति प्रस्थितयाज्याः ।
text_mt: 'Thus drink' are the offering verses for the set portions.

sanskrit_iast: prasthitahomān aindrān |
meaning: प्रस्थितहोमान् ऐन्द्रान् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the set offerings to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye dākṣiṇahomāv ud u tyaṃ citraṃ devānām iti |
meaning: गार्हपत्ये दाक्षिणहोमाव् उद् उ त्यं चित्रं देवानाम् इति ।
text_mt: The two offerings for the sacrificial gifts [take place] in the gārhapatya fire with: 'Up that [all-knowing god]' [and] 'The bright [face of the gods]'.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyahasto yajamāno bahirvedi dakṣiṇā āyatīḥ ā gāvaḥ iti pratyuttiṣṭhati |
meaning: हिरण्यहस्तो यजमानो बहिर्वेदि दक्षिणा आयतीः आ गावः इति प्रत्युत्तिष्ठति ।
text_mt: With gold in hand, outside the altar, the sacrificer rises to meet the sacrificial fees as they arrive, with: 'Hither, O cows!'.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyam ātreyāya dadāti | āgnīdhrāyopabarhaṇam |
meaning: हिरण्यम् आत्रेयाय ददाति । आग्नीध्रायोपबर्हणम् ।
text_mt: He gives gold to the Ātreya; a cushion to the āgnīdhra priest.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa gārhapatyaṃ jaghanena sado 'ntar āgnīdhrīyaṃ ca sadaś ca cātvālaṃ codīcīr dakṣiṇā utsṛjyamānāḥ saṃ vaḥ sṛjatu iti dvābhyām anumantrayate |
meaning: अग्रेण गार्हपत्यं जघनेन सदो ऽन्तर् आग्नीध्रीयं च सदश् च चात्वालं चोदीचीर् दक्षिणा उत्सृज्यमानाः सं वः सृजतु इति द्वाभ्याम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: As the sacrificial gifts are driven out northward in front of the gārhapatya fire, behind the sadas, and between the āgnīdhra's hearth and the sadas and the cātvāla pit, he consecrates [them] with the two [verses]: 'May [he] unite you'.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāṃ pūrve bhūtakṛtaḥ iti bhāgaliḥ | ihed asātha iti kauśikaḥ |
meaning: यस्यां पूर्वे भूतकृतः इति भागलिः । इहेद् असाथ इति कौशिकः ।
text_mt: According to Bhāgali, [he does so] with: 'In which formerly the creators of beings'; according to Kauśika, with: 'Here may ye be'.

sanskrit_iast: antataḥ pratihartre deyam |
meaning: अन्ततः प्रतिहर्त्रे देयम् ।
text_mt: Finally, a gift is to be given to the pratihartṛ priest.

sanskrit_iast: marutvatīyahomam indro mā marutvān iti |
meaning: मरुत्वतीयहोमम् इन्द्रो मा मरुत्वान् इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the offering to the Marutvants with: 'Indra accompanied by the Maruts [shall protect] me'.

sanskrit_iast: śastrayājyāyāḥ | hotrādibhyaḥ prasauti pravāsy ahne tvāhar jinva | anuvāsi rātryai tvā rātriṃ jinva | uśig asi vasubhyas tvā vasūn jinva | praketo 'si rudrebhyas tvā rudrān jinva iti |
meaning: शस्त्रयाज्यायाः । होत्रादिभ्यः प्रसौति प्रवास्य् अह्ने त्वाहर् जिन्व । अनुवासि रात्र्यै त्वा रात्रिं जिन्व । उशिग् असि वसुभ्यस् त्वा वसून् जिन्व । प्रकेतो ऽसि रुद्रेभ्यस् त्वा रुद्रान् जिन्व इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates the oblation] of the recitation-offering verse. He impels the hotṛ and the other priests with: 'Thou art blowing forth; for the day thee! Quicken the day! Thou art blowing along; for the night thee! Quicken the night! Thou art eager; for the Vasus thee! Quicken the Vasus! Thou art the banner; for the Rudras thee! Quicken the Rudras!'

sanskrit_iast: niṣkevalyasya māhendram |
meaning: निष्केवल्यस्य माहेन्द्रम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the māhendra draught of the niṣkevalya śastra.

sanskrit_iast: praśāstrādīnām aindram |
meaning: प्रशास्त्रादीनाम् ऐन्द्रम् ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the Indra offering of the praśāstṛ and the other [subordinate priests].

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣaham tat tvā yāmi suvīryam iti stotriyānurupau |
meaning: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहम् तत् त्वा यामि सुवीर्यम् इति स्तोत्रियानुरुपौ ।
text_mt: 'Him, your wonder-working, foe-crushing [Indra]' [and] 'For this we ask thee, of goodly heroics' are the strophe and antistrophe verses.

sanskrit_iast: dve tisraḥ karoti punar ādāyam | prathamāṃ śastvā tasyā uttamaṃ pādam abhyasyāvasāyottarasyā ardharcena dvitīyāṃ śastvā tasyā uttamaṃ pādam abhyasyottareṇārdharcena tṛtīyāṃ śaṃsati |
meaning: द्वे तिस्रः करोति पुनर् आदायम् । प्रथमां शस्त्वा तस्या उत्तमं पादम् अभ्यस्यावसायोत्तरस्या अर्धर्चेन द्वितीयां शस्त्वा तस्या उत्तमं पादम् अभ्यस्योत्तरेणार्धर्चेन तृतीयां शंसति ।
text_mt: He turns two [verses] into three by repeating [parts]: having recited the first, repeating its last quarter and pausing, having recited the second with the half-verse of the following [verse], repeating its last quarter, he recites the third with the following half-verse.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ bārhatānāṃ stotriyānurūpāṇāṃ pragrathanam |
meaning: एवं बार्हतानां स्तोत्रियानुरूपाणां प्रग्रथनम् ।
text_mt: Such is the interlacing of the strophe and antistrophe verses in the bṛhatī metre.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamoccaistarayā vācā śaṃstavyau |
meaning: मध्यमोच्चैस्तरया वाचा शंस्तव्यौ ।
text_mt: The two should be recited in a voice of intermediate height.

sanskrit_iast: ud u tye madhumattamāḥ iti sāmapragāthaḥ svaravatyā |
meaning: उद् उ त्ये मधुमत्तमाः इति सामप्रगाथः स्वरवत्या ।
text_mt: 'Up indeed those most sweet' is the sāman-pragātha, [recited] with musical tone.

sanskrit_iast: indraḥ pūrbhid ātirat ity ukthamukhaṃ pacchaḥ prativītatamayā |
meaning: इन्द्रः पूर्भिद् आतिरत् इत्य् उक्थमुखं पच्छः प्रतिवीततमया ।
text_mt: 'Indra, the breaker of fortresses, advanced' is the opening of the uktha, [recited] by verse-quarters, in a most taut [voice].

sanskrit_iast: ud u brahmāṇy airata śravasya iti paryāsaḥ |
meaning: उद् उ ब्रह्माण्य् ऐरत श्रवस्य इति पर्यासः ।
text_mt: 'Up indeed arose the prayers, desiring glory' is the concluding verse of the uktha.

sanskrit_iast: eved indram iti paridadhāti | parayā yajati |
meaning: एवेद् इन्द्रम् इति परिदधाति । परया यजति ।
text_mt: He concludes with: 'Thus indeed [they praise] Indra'. With the following [verse] he offers.

sanskrit_iast: acchāvākabhakṣād ādityagrahahomaṃ yad devā devaheḍanam iti dvābhyām | pavamānasarpaṇāntam |
meaning: अच्छावाकभक्षाद् आदित्यग्रहहोमं यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इति द्वाभ्याम् । पवमानसर्पणान्तम् ।
text_mt: Before the consumption by the acchāvāka priest, [he consecrates] the oblation of the āditya draught with the two [hymns]: 'Whatever god-provoked wrath, O gods', up to the gliding for the pavamāna stotra.

sanskrit_iast: āśiraṃ pūtabhṛtyāsicyamānam āśīrṇa ūrjam ity anumantrayate |
meaning: आशिरं पूतभृत्यासिच्यमानम् आशीर्ण ऊर्जम् इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: He consecrates the milk-mixture being poured into the pūtabhṛt vessel with: 'The milk-mixture [is] our strength'.

sanskrit_iast: pavamānāya prasauti suditir asy ādityebhyas tvādityān jinva iti
meaning: पवमानाय प्रसौति सुदितिर् अस्य् आदित्येभ्यस् त्वादित्यान् जिन्व इति
text_mt: He impels [the chanting] for the pavamāna stotra with: 'Thou art brilliant; for the Ādityas thee! Quicken the Ādityas!' [He consecrates] the offering of the cut-off portions [of the victim] to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: avadānahomam āgneyam |
meaning: अवदानहोमम् आग्नेयम् ।

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnam ukthye | aindraṃ ṣoḍaśini | sārasvatam atirātre |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नम् उक्थ्ये । ऐन्द्रं षोडशिनि । सारस्वतम् अतिरात्रे ।
text_mt: [The offering is] to Indra and Agni in the Ukthya; to Indra in the Ṣoḍaśin; to Sarasvatī in the Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: paśv ekādaśinyām āgneyaṃ sāumyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sārasvataṃ pauṣṇam bārhaspatyaṃ vaiśvadevam aindram aindrāgnaṃ sāvitraṃ vāruṇam |
meaning: पश्व् एकादशिन्याम् आग्नेयं साउम्यं वैष्णवं सारस्वतं पौष्णम् बार्हस्पत्यं वैश्वदेवम् ऐन्द्रम् ऐन्द्राग्नं सावित्रं वारुणम् ।
text_mt: In the set of eleven victims, [the offerings are] to Agni, to Soma, to Viṣṇu, to Sarasvatī, to Pūṣan, to Bṛhaspati, to the Viśve Devas, to Indra, to Indra-Agni, to Savitṛ, [and] to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: savanīyahomādi | indraś ca somaṃ pibataṃ bṛhaspate iti prasthitayājyāḥ | homān aindraṃ maitrāvaruṇam aindrābārhaspatyaṃ mārutaṃ tvāṣṭram aindrāvaiṣṇavam āgneyam |
meaning: सवनीयहोमादि । इन्द्रश् च सोमं पिबतं बृहस्पते इति प्रस्थितयाज्याः । होमान् ऐन्द्रं मैत्रावरुणम् ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्यं मारुतं त्वाष्ट्रम् ऐन्द्रावैष्णवम् आग्नेयम् ।
text_mt: [The brahman priest consecrates] the beginning of the oblations of the soma pressing. The offering verses for the libations already drawn are: "O Indra and Bṛhaspati, drink the soma..." [He consecrates] the oblations: the one to Indra, to Mitra-Varuṇa, to Indra-Bṛhaspati, to the Maruts, to Tvaṣṭṛ, to Indra-Viṣṇu, [and] to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: havirdhāne yathācamasaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ svebhya upāsanebhyas trīṃstrīn puroḍāśasaṃvartān etat te pratatāmaha iti nipṛṇanti |
meaning: हविर्धाने यथाचमसं दक्षिणतः स्वेभ्य उपासनेभ्यस् त्रींस्त्रीन् पुरोडाशसंवर्तान् एतत् ते प्रततामह इति निपृणन्ति ।
text_mt:
In the cart shed (havirdhāna), to the south according to each cup, they scatter three dough-rolls each for their own ancestors with: "This is for you, great-grandfather..."

Having muttered: "Here, O Fathers...", he consecrates [the rite] with: "This portion...", "This, O companions of the seat...", [and] "The falcon, seeing men..."

sanskrit_iast: atra pitaraḥ iti japitvā etaṃ bhāgam etaṃ sadhasthāḥ śyeno nṛcakṣāḥ ity anumantrayate |
meaning: अत्र पितरः इति जपित्वा एतं भागम् एतं सधस्थाः श्येनो नृचक्षाः इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīye havirucchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayanti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रीये हविरुच्छिष्टं भक्षयन्ति ।
text_mt: In the fire of the āgnīdhra (āgnīdhrīya), they consume the remnant of the sacrificial offering.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitragrahahomam |
meaning: सावित्रग्रहहोमम् ।

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevayājyāyāḥ | dhiṣṇyahomāt aibhir agne ity upāṃśu pātnīvatasyāgnīdhro yajati |
meaning: वैश्वदेवयाज्यायाः । धिष्ण्यहोमात् ऐभिर् अग्ने इत्य् उपांशु पात्नीवतस्याग्नीध्रो यजति ।
text_mt: [After the consecration] of the offering verse to the Viśve Devas, [and] from the oblation at the hearth-mounds (dhiṣṇya), the āgnīdhra offers the draught for Agni with the wives (pātnīvata) in a whisper with: "With these, O Agni..."

sanskrit_iast: tasya homam |
meaning: तस्य होमम् ।

sanskrit_iast: neṣṭur upasthe dhiṣṇyānte vāsīno bhakṣayati |
meaning: नेष्टुर् उपस्थे धिष्ण्यान्ते वासीनो भक्षयति ।
text_mt: Sitting on the lap of the neṣṭṛ priest or near the hearth-mound, he consumes [it].

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomasāmne hotre prasauti ojo 'si pitṛbhyas tvā pitṝn jinva iti |
meaning: अग्निष्टोमसाम्ने होत्रे प्रसौति ओजो ऽसि पितृभ्यस् त्वा पितॄन् जिन्व इति ।
text_mt: He impels the hotṛ priest for the Agniṣṭoma chant with: "You are vigour; for the Fathers [I impel] you; gladden the Fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa iti dhruvam avanīyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण इति ध्रुवम् अवनीयमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: With: "Firm with the firm...", he consecrates the dhruva draught as it is poured out.

sanskrit_iast: āgnimārutayājyāhomaṃ prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaram iti saṃpreṣita āgnīdhra ity uktam |
meaning: आग्निमारुतयाज्याहोमं प्रति त्यं चारुम् अध्वरम् इति संप्रेषित आग्नीध्र इत्य् उक्तम् ।
text_mt: It has been said: "The āgnīdhra, when summoned with: 'Towards that beautiful sacrifice...', [performs] the offering verse and oblation to Agni and the Maruts."

sanskrit_iast: hāriyojanahomam ā mandraiḥ iti |
meaning: हारियोजनहोमम् आ मन्द्रैः इति ।
text_mt: [He consecrates] the oblation of the hāriyojana draught with: "With the delightful [horses]..."

sanskrit_iast: tenaiva niṣkrāmanti |
meaning: तेनैव निष्क्रामन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīye sarvaprāyaścittīyān juhoti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रीये सर्वप्रायश्चित्तीयान् जुहोति ।
text_mt: In the āgnīdhrīya fire he pours the all-expiation oblations.

sanskrit_iast: agnau śākalān sarve | devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā | pitṛkṛtasya | manuṣyakṛtasya | ātmakṛtasya | anājñātājñātakṛtasya || yad vo devāś cakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḍanam | arāvā yo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmiṃs tad eno vasavo ni dhattana iti || devaheḍanasya sūktābhyāṃ ca |
meaning: अग्नौ शाकलान् सर्वे । देवकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि स्वाहा । पितृकृतस्य । मनुष्यकृतस्य । आत्मकृतस्य । अनाज्ञाताज्ञातकृतस्य ॥ यद् वो देवाश् चकृम जिह्वया गुरु मनसो वा प्रयुती देवहेडनम् । अरावा यो नो अभि दुच्छुनायते तस्मिंस् तद् एनो वसवो नि धत्तन इति ॥ देवहेडनस्य सूक्ताभ्यां च ।
text_mt: All [pour] the Śākala [oblations] into the fire with: "You are the expiation of sin committed against the gods, svāhā! Of that committed against the fathers! Of that committed against men! Of that committed by oneself! Of that committed unwittingly or wittingly!", with: "Whatever heavy offence against the gods we have committed with the tongue, O gods, or through carelessness of mind, whatever malicious enemy plots mischief against us, upon him, O Vasus, place that sin!", and with the two hymns on offending the gods.

sanskrit_iast: droṇakalaśād dhānā hasta ādāya bhasmānte nivapante |
meaning: द्रोणकलशाद् धाना हस्त आदाय भस्मान्ते निवपन्ते ।
text_mt: Having taken fried grains in hand from the trough (droṇakalaśa), they scatter them at the edge of the ashes.

sanskrit_iast: cātvālād apareṇādhvaryvāsāditān apsusomacamasān vaiṣṇavyarcā ninayanti |
meaning: चात्वालाद् अपरेणाध्वर्य्वासादितान् अप्सुसोमचमसान् वैष्णव्यर्चा निनयन्ति ।
text_mt: West of the pit (cātvāla), they pour out the cups of soma mixed with water that were placed by the adhvaryu, with a verse addressed to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: ubhā kavī yuvānā satyādā dharmaṇas pari | satyasya dharmaṇā vi sakhyāni sṛjāmahe iti sakhyāni visṛjante |
meaning: उभा कवी युवाना सत्यादा धर्मणस् परि । सत्यस्य धर्मणा वि सख्यानि सृजामहे इति सख्यानि विसृजन्ते ।
text_mt: They release their bonds of friendship with: "Both sages, youthful, establishing truth from sacred order, by the law of truth we untie our friendships."

sanskrit_iast: saṃ sakhyāni iti saṃsṛjante 'hargaṇe prāg uttamāt |
meaning: सं सख्यानि इति संसृजन्ते ऽहर्गणे प्राग् उत्तमात् ।
text_mt: In a series of sacrificial days (ahargaṇa), prior to the final day, they unite [them] with: "Together [our] friendships..."

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīye dadhi bhakṣayanti dadhikrāvṇaḥ iti |
meaning: आग्नीध्रीये दधि भक्षयन्ति दधिक्राव्णः इति ।
text_mt: In the āgnīdhrīya fire [shed] they consume curd with: "Of Dadhikrāvā..."

sanskrit_iast: patnīsaṃyājebhyaḥ śālāmukhīyam upaviśati |
meaning: पत्नीसंयाजेभ्यः शालामुखीयम् उपविशति ।
text_mt: For the offerings to the wives of the gods (patnīsaṃyāja), he sits down by the śālāmukhīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāsaṃcareṇāhavanīyam apareṇātivrajya samiṣṭayajurbhyaḥ saṃsthitahomān juhoti |
meaning: दक्षिणासंचरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेणातिव्रज्य समिष्टयजुर्भ्यः संस्थितहोमान् जुहोति ।
text_mt: Crossing over south of the passage, west of the āhavanīya, after the samiṣṭayajus offerings he pours the concluding oblations.

sanskrit_iast: apsv avabhṛtheṣṭyām apsu te iti purastāddhomān | sāvikān saṃsthitahomān | vāruṇaṃ tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ naḥ iti |
meaning: अप्स्व् अवभृथेष्ट्याम् अप्सु ते इति पुरस्ताद्धोमान् । साविकान् संस्थितहोमान् । वारुणं त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नः इति ।
text_mt: In the purificatory bath sacrifice (avabhṛtheṣṭi) in the water, [he pours] the preliminary oblations with: "In the waters is your [seat]..."; the concluding oblations belonging to the savana; [and] the offering to Varuṇa with: "You to us, O Agni..." [and] "Be you to us..."

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntānuyājāntaike |
meaning: इडान्तानुयाजान्तैके ।

sanskrit_iast: somaliptāni dadhnābhijuhoty abhūd devaḥ drapsavatyo yat te grāvā ity etaiḥ |
meaning: सोमलिप्तानि दध्नाभिजुहोत्य् अभूद् देवः द्रप्सवत्यो यत् ते ग्रावा इत्य् एतैः ।
text_mt: He pours curd over the [utensils] smeared with soma, with: "The god has become...", with the drop-verses, [and] with: "What the pressing stone [has dislodged]..."

sanskrit_iast: yat te grāvā bāhucyuto acucyon naro yad vā te hastayor adhukṣan | tat ta āpyāyatāṃ tat te niṣṭyāyatāṃ soma rājan || yat te grāvṇā cicchiduḥ soma rājan priyāṇy aṅgā sukṛtā purūṇi | tat saṃdhatsvājyenota vardhayasvānāgaso yathā sadam it saṃkṣiyema || yāṃ te tvacaṃ bibhidur yāṃ ca yoniṃ yad vā sthānāt pracyuto yadi vāsuto 'si | tvayā soma kḷptam asmākam etad upa no rājan sukṛte hvayasva | saṃ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ sam u cakṣuṣā saṃ śrotreṇa gacchasva soma rājan | yat te viriṣṭaṃ samu tat ta etaj jānītān naḥ saṃgamane pathīnām || ahāḥ śarīraṃ payasā samety anyo anyo bhavati varṇo asya | tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || abhikṣaranti juhvo ghṛtenāṅgā parūṃṣi tava vardhayanti | tasmai te soma nama id vaṣaṭ copa no rājan sukṛte hvayasva |
meaning: यत् ते ग्रावा बाहुच्युतो अचुच्योन् नरो यद् वा ते हस्तयोर् अधुक्षन् । तत् त आप्यायतां तत् ते निष्ट्यायतां सोम राजन् ॥ यत् ते ग्राव्णा चिच्छिदुः सोम राजन् प्रियाण्य् अङ्गा सुकृता पुरूणि । तत् संधत्स्वाज्येनोत वर्धयस्वानागसो यथा सदम् इत् संक्षियेम ॥ यां ते त्वचं बिभिदुर् यां च योनिं यद् वा स्थानात् प्रच्युतो यदि वासुतो ऽसि । त्वया सोम कॢप्तम् अस्माकम् एतद् उप नो राजन् सुकृते ह्वयस्व । सं प्राणापानाभ्यां सम् उ चक्षुषा सं श्रोत्रेण गच्छस्व सोम राजन् । यत् ते विरिष्टं समु तत् त एतज् जानीतान् नः संगमने पथीनाम् ॥ अहाः शरीरं पयसा समेत्य् अन्यो अन्यो भवति वर्णो अस्य । तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥ अभिक्षरन्ति जुह्वो घृतेनाङ्गा परूंषि तव वर्धयन्ति । तस्मै ते सोम नम इद् वषट् चोप नो राजन् सुकृते ह्वयस्व ।
text_mt: "What the pressing stone, shot from the arms, has dislodged of you, or what the men have milked from you in their hands, may that swell for you, may that drip out for you, O King Soma! / What of your dear, well-formed, manifold limbs they have cut off with the pressing stone, O King Soma, unite that with clarified butter and cause it to grow, so that we may dwell together forever without guilt! / What skin of yours they have torn, and what womb, or if you have fallen from your place, or if you have been pressed—all this has been prepared by you, O Soma, for us; summon us, O King, to good deeds! / Unite with the out-breath and the in-breath, unite with the eye, unite with the ear, O King Soma! What of yours has been injured, unite that; know us at the meeting of paths! / You have left behind your body, uniting with milk; one after another his colour becomes; to that [form] of yours, O drop, let us worship with the sacrificial offering; may we be masters of riches! / The offering ladles stream with clarified butter; they nourish your limbs and joints; to that [form] of yours, O Soma, be homage and the vaṣaṭ-call, and summon us, O King, to good deeds!"

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinaṃ nidhāya saṃprokṣati |
meaning: कृष्णाजिनं निधाय संप्रोक्षति ।
text_mt: Having laid down a black antelope skin, he sprinkles it.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ sūktair ityādy upasparśanāntam |
meaning: अपां सूक्तैर् इत्याद्य् उपस्पर्शनान्तम् ।
text_mt: [The rite begins] with the hymns of the waters, ending with the touching of water. They step out with: "Upward we..."

sanskrit_iast: ud vayam ity utkrāmanti |
meaning: उद् वयम् इत्य् उत्क्रामन्ति ।
text_mt: They approach with: "We have drunk the soma..." [and] "We have attained heaven..."

sanskrit_iast: apāma somam aganma svar ity āvrajanti |
meaning: अपाम सोमम् अगन्म स्वर् इत्य् आव्रजन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: apo divyāḥ ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante |
meaning: अपो दिव्याः इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते ।
text_mt: They revere the āhavanīya with: "O divine waters..."

sanskrit_iast: vimuñcāmītyādi mārjanāntam |
meaning: विमुञ्चामीत्यादि मार्जनान्तम् ।
text_mt: [The rite begins] with: "I unloose...", ending with the purification. The concluding offering (udayanīyā) is like the opening offering (prāyaṇīyā); that of Pathyā is fourth.

sanskrit_iast: udayanīyā prāyaṇīyāvat | pathyāyāś caturtham |
meaning: उदयनीया प्रायणीयावत् । पथ्यायाश् चतुर्थम् ।

sanskrit_iast: antasaṃsthā |
meaning: अन्तसंस्था ।

sanskrit_iast: anūbandhyāyām aparājitāyāṃ tiṣṭhantyāṃ sapatnahanam iti kāmaṃ namaskaroti |
meaning: अनूबन्ध्यायाम् अपराजितायां तिष्ठन्त्यां सपत्नहनम् इति कामं नमस्करोति ।
text_mt: At the anūbandhyā cow, while standing unvanquished, he pays homage to desire with: "The slayer of rivals..."

sanskrit_iast: yūpaikādaśinī ced vapāmārjanā tvāṣṭraḥ paśuḥ |
meaning: यूपैकादशिनी चेद् वपामार्जना त्वाष्ट्रः पशुः ।
text_mt: If there is a set of eleven sacrificial posts, the animal for Tvaṣṭṛ is [offered] up to the cleansing of the omentum.

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtasyotsargaḥ |
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतस्योत्सर्गः ।
text_mt: The release takes place after carrying fire around [it].

sanskrit_iast: asyājyāvadānahomam | vaśāpaśupuroḍāśād devikāhavīṃṣi |
meaning: अस्याज्यावदानहोमम् । वशापशुपुरोडाशाद् देविकाहवींषि ।
text_mt: [The brahman consecrates] the oblation of portions of clarified butter for this [rite]. From the animal cake for the barren cow, [he offers] the offerings to the Devikās.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ te yoniḥ ity araṇyor agniṃ samāropyamāṇam anumantrayate | yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayā me hy āroha tayā me hy āviśa | ayaṃ te yoniḥ ity ātman |
meaning: अयं ते योनिः इत्य् अरण्योर् अग्निं समारोप्यमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते । या ते अग्ने यज्ञिया तनूस् तया मे ह्य् आरोह तया मे ह्य् आविश । अयं ते योनिः इत्य् आत्मन् ।
text_mt:
<3.14.14> With 'This is your womb…' he consecrates the fire being mounted into the two kindling sticks; with 'Whatever sacrificial body of yours, O Agni, with that ascend into me, with that enter into me; this is your womb…' [he consecrates it being mounted] into himself.
<3.14.15> With '[The debt] unborrowed, not given…' [he consecrates] the altar being burned over.

sanskrit_iast: apamityam apratīttam iti vedim upoṣyamāṇām |
meaning: अपमित्यम् अप्रतीत्तम् इति वेदिम् उपोष्यमाणाम् ।

sanskrit_iast: saktuhome viśvalopa viśvadāvasya tvāsan juhomi ity āha |
meaning: सक्तुहोमे विश्वलोप विश्वदावस्य त्वासन् जुहोमि इत्य् आह ।
text_mt: <3.14.16> At the oblation of roasted barley meal, he says: 'O Viśvalopa, into the mouth of the all-destroying [fire] I offer you!'

sanskrit_iast: yo agnau iti namaskṛtya tenaiva niṣkrāmanti |
meaning: यो अग्नौ इति नमस्कृत्य तेनैव निष्क्रामन्ति ।
text_mt:
<3.14.17> Having paid homage with 'He who in the fire…', they go out by that same way.

<3.14.18> With 'Descend…' he consecrates [the fire] being churned.

sanskrit_iast: upāvaroha iti mathyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: उपावरोह इति मथ्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।

sanskrit_iast: ity agniṣṭomaḥ |
meaning: इत्य् अग्निष्टोमः ।

sanskrit_iast: alpasva ekagunāpi yajeta yajeta |
meaning: अल्पस्व एकगुनापि यजेत यजेत ।
text_mt: <3.14.20> Even a person of little means may sacrifice with a single cow; he may sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomasāmno hotre ṣoḍaśistotreṇātyagniṣṭome | ukthye maitrāvaruṇādibhyaḥ prasauti tantur asi prajābhyas tvā prajāṃ jinva | revad asy oṣadhībhyas tvauṣaṣīr jinva | pṛtanāṣāḍ asi paśubhyas tvā paśūn jinva iti |
meaning: अग्निष्टोमसाम्नो होत्रे षोडशिस्तोत्रेणात्यग्निष्टोमे । उक्थ्ये मैत्रावरुणादिभ्यः प्रसौति तन्तुर् असि प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा प्रजां जिन्व । रेवद् अस्य् ओषधीभ्यस् त्वौषषीर् जिन्व । पृतनाषाड् असि पशुभ्यस् त्वा पशून् जिन्व इति ।
text_mt: <4.1.1> For the Agniṣṭoma chant, [he impels the hotṛ priest]; for the hotṛ with the Ṣoḍaśi chant in the Atyagniṣṭoma; in the Ukthya, he impels [the hotṛ's assistants] beginning with the Maitrāvaruṇa with: 'You are the web; for offspring [I take] you, enliven offspring! You are wealthy; for the plants [I take] you, enliven the plants! You are the vanquisher of armies; for cattle [I take] you, enliven cattle!'

sanskrit_iast: eteṣāṃ yājyāhomān indrāvaruṇā sutapau bṛhaspatir naḥ ubhā jigyathuḥ iti |
meaning: एतेषां याज्याहोमान् इन्द्रावरुणा सुतपौ बृहस्पतिर् नः उभा जिग्यथुः इति ।
text_mt: <4.1.2> The offering oblations of these [are performed] with 'O Indra and Varuṇa, drinkers of the pressed [soma]…', 'Bṛhaspati, our…', and 'Both of you conquered…'.

sanskrit_iast: vayam u tvām apūrvya yo na idam idaṃ purā iti stotriyānurupau |
meaning: वयम् उ त्वाम् अपूर्व्य यो न इदम् इदं पुरा इति स्तोत्रियानुरुपौ ।
text_mt: <4.1.3> 'We indeed [address] you, O unexcelled one…' and 'He who for us this and that formerly…' are the strophe verse and antistrophe verse.
