sanskrit_iast: āgneyīṣṭiḥ | pauṣṇī ca |
meaning: आग्नेयीष्टिः । पौष्णी च ।

sanskrit_iast: vātaraṃhā bhava ity aśvaṃ niyujyamānam anumantrayate |
meaning: वातरंहा भव इत्य् अश्वं नियुज्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: While the horse is being tethered, he consecrates it with: "Be swift as the wind" [6.9.2].

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā jarimāhita ity unmucyāmānam |
meaning: अभि त्वा जरिमाहित इत्य् उन्मुच्यामानम् ।
text_mt: While it is being untied, with: "Old age, deposited, has approached you" [3.11.8].

sanskrit_iast: āśāpālīyenotsṛṣṭam |
meaning: आशापालीयेनोत्सृष्टम् ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ sāvitryas tisra iṣṭayaḥ |
meaning: संवत्सरं सावित्र्यस् तिस्र इष्टयः ।
text_mt: For a year, there are three offerings to Savitṛ [daily].

sanskrit_iast: pāriplavākhyānāya dakṣiṇena vediṃ hiraṇmayeṣv āsaneṣu upaviśanti |
meaning: पारिप्लवाख्यानाय दक्षिणेन वेदिं हिरण्मयेष्व् आसनेषु उपविशन्ति ।
text_mt: For the revolving legend, they sit down on golden seats to the south of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: kaśipūpabarhaṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ | kūrco yajamānasya |
meaning: कशिपूपबर्हणं ब्रह्मणः । कूर्चो यजमानस्य ।
text_mt: A cushion of woven reeds belongs to the brahman priest; a grass seat to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: ākhyāneṣu yathāvedaṃ vyāhṛtīr vācayati |
meaning: आख्यानेषु यथावेदं व्याहृतीर् वाचयति ।
text_mt: During the legends, he causes [the hotṛ] to pronounce the mystical utterances according to their respective Veda.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarānte dīkṣaṇam | ekaviṃśatir dīkṣāḥ |
meaning: संवत्सरान्ते दीक्षणम् । एकविंशतिर् दीक्षाः ।
text_mt: At the end of the year, the consecration [takes place]; there are twenty-one consecrations.

sanskrit_iast: abhiplavaprathamavat prathamam ahaḥ | pṛṣṭhyacaturthavad dvitīyam |
meaning: अभिप्लवप्रथमवत् प्रथमम् अहः । पृष्ठ्यचतुर्थवद् द्वितीयम् ।
text_mt: The first day is like the first [day] of the Abhiplava; the second is like the fourth [day] of the Pṛṣṭhya.

sanskrit_iast: bahiṣpavamānād aśvaṃ niyujyamānam anumantrayate saṃ tvāṃ gandharvāḥ sam u yuñjantv āpo nadyoḥ sāṃvaidye parivatsarāya | ye tvā rakṣanti sadam apramādaṃ tebhya āyuḥ savitā bodhi gopāya iti |
meaning: बहिष्पवमानाद् अश्वं नियुज्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते सं त्वां गन्धर्वाः सम् उ युञ्जन्त्व् आपो नद्योः सांवैद्ये परिवत्सराय । ये त्वा रक्षन्ति सदम् अप्रमादं तेभ्य आयुः सविता बोधि गोपाय इति ।
text_mt: While the horse is being tethered after the outside pavamāna hymn, he consecrates it with: "May the Gandharvas yoke you, may the waters of the two rivers [yoke] you for knowledge for a full year; may Savitṛ, the guardian, know life for those who protect you always without negligence."

sanskrit_iast: divyo gandharvaḥ ity etayā kauśikaḥ
meaning: दिव्यो गन्धर्वः इत्य् एतया कौशिकः
text_mt: Kauśika [holds that it is] with this [verse]: "The heavenly Gandharva" [2.2.1]. Having caused the chief queen to lie down by [the horse] that has been quieted, they cover them over with an upper garment.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjñaptaṃ mahiṣīm upaveśyādhīvāsasā saṃprorṇuvanti |
meaning: संज्ञप्तं महिषीम् उपवेश्याधीवाससा संप्रोर्णुवन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: tau yajamāno 'bhimethati svargeṇa lokena saṃprorṇuvāthām adhāma sakthyor ava gudaṃ dhehi | arvāñcam añjim ā bhara yat strīṇāṃ jīvabhojanam iti |
meaning: तौ यजमानो ऽभिमेथति स्वर्गेण लोकेन संप्रोर्णुवाथाम् अधाम सक्थ्योर् अव गुदं धेहि । अर्वाञ्चम् अञ्जिम् आ भर यत् स्त्रीणां जीवभोजनम् इति ।
text_mt: The sacrificer abuses the two with: "Cover yourselves with the heavenly world; put down the anus between the thighs; bring forward the penis, which is the living nourishment of women."

sanskrit_iast: hotrabhimethanād evaṃ vāvātāṃ brahmā ūrdhvām enām ucchrayatād girau bhāraṃ harann iva | athāsyai madhyam edhatu śīte vāte punann iva iti |
meaning: होत्रभिमेथनाद् एवं वावातां ब्रह्मा ऊर्ध्वाम् एनाम् उच्छ्रयताद् गिरौ भारं हरन्न् इव । अथास्यै मध्यम् एधतु शीते वाते पुनन्न् इव इति ।
text_mt: After the hotṛ's abuse, the brahman priest likewise [abuses] the favourite wife with: "Raise her upright, like one carrying a load on a mountain; then may her middle swell, like one winnowing in a cool wind."

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam enam ity anucaryo brahmāṇam |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् एनम् इत्य् अनुचर्यो ब्रह्माणम् ।
text_mt: [The female attendants abuse] the brahman priest with: "[Raise] him upright..."

sanskrit_iast: sadasi hotradhvaryvor brahmodyād brahmodgātāraṃ pṛcchati |
meaning: सदसि होत्रध्वर्य्वोर् ब्रह्मोद्याद् ब्रह्मोद्गातारं पृच्छति ।
text_mt: In the sadas, after the theological dispute between the hotṛ and the adhvaryu, the brahman priest asks the udgātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: pṛcchāmi tvā citaye devasakha yadi tvaṃ tatra manasā jagantha | keṣu viṣṇus triṣu padeṣu jiṣṇuḥ keṣv idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam āviveśa iti |
meaning: पृच्छामि त्वा चितये देवसख यदि त्वं तत्र मनसा जगन्थ । केषु विष्णुस् त्रिषु पदेषु जिष्णुः केष्व् इदं विश्वं भुवनम् आविवेश इति ।
text_mt: "I ask you, divine friend, for understanding, if you have gone thither in mind: in which three steps did victorious Viṣṇu, in which did this whole world enter?"

sanskrit_iast: tasya pratipraśnād āha pañcasv antaḥ puruṣa āviveśa tāny antaḥ puruṣa ārpitāni | etat tvātra pratimanvāno asmi na yajñapā bhavasy uttaro mat || na tvaṃ paro 'varo man na pūrvaḥ kim aṅga vā matiman kṣama tena | śikṣeṇyāṃ vadasi vācam enāṃ na mayā tvaṃ saṃsamako bhavāsi iti |
meaning: तस्य प्रतिप्रश्नाद् आह पञ्चस्व् अन्तः पुरुष आविवेश तान्य् अन्तः पुरुष आर्पितानि । एतत् त्वात्र प्रतिमन्वानो अस्मि न यज्ञपा भवस्य् उत्तरो मत् ॥ न त्वं परो ऽवरो मन् न पूर्वः किम् अङ्ग वा मतिमन् क्षम तेन । शिक्षेण्यां वदसि वाचम् एनां न मया त्वं संसमको भवासि इति ।
text_mt: In response to his counter-question, he says: "Into five the Puruṣa entered; those are fixed inside the Puruṣa; this I ponder in reply to you here; you, sacrifice-guardian, are not superior to me. You are neither farther nor nearer than me, nor prior; why then, wise one, endure that? You speak this speech to be learned; you will not be an equal companion to me."

sanskrit_iast: niṣkramya sarve yajamānaṃ pṛcchāmi tvā param antaṃ pṛthivyāḥ iti | iyaṃ vediḥ iti yajamānaḥ |
meaning: निष्क्रम्य सर्वे यजमानं पृच्छामि त्वा परम् अन्तं पृथिव्याः इति । इयं वेदिः इति यजमानः ।
text_mt: Having gone out, all [the priests ask] the sacrificer: "I ask you about the furthest limit of the earth" [9.10.13]. The sacrificer [answers]: "This altar..." [9.10.14].

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīye caturviṃśavad dve savane |
meaning: तृतीये चतुर्विंशवद् द्वे सवने ।
text_mt: On the third [day], the two pressings are like the twenty-four-fold [day].

sanskrit_iast: prākṛtāv ājyastotriyānurūpau |
meaning: प्राकृताव् आज्यस्तोत्रियानुरूपौ ।
text_mt: The strophe and antistrophe verses of the ājya [stotra] are the archetypal ones.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyasavanādy atirātravat |
meaning: तृतीयसवनाद्य् अतिरात्रवत् ।
text_mt: From the third pressing onward, it is like an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsthite pañcapaśur viśākhayūpaḥ |
meaning: संस्थिते पञ्चपशुर् विशाखयूपः ।
text_mt: When it is completed, [there is] a five-animal sacrifice at a forked sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: pratyṛtu ṣaṭ paśava āgneyā aindrā mārutā maitrāvaruṇā aindrāvaruṇā āgnāvaiṣṇavā iti |
meaning: प्रत्यृतु षट् पशव आग्नेया ऐन्द्रा मारुता मैत्रावरुणा ऐन्द्रावरुणा आग्नावैष्णवा इति ।
text_mt: For each season there are six victim animals: dedicated to Agni, to Indra, to the Maruts, to Mitra-Varuṇa, to Indra-Varuṇa, and to Agni-Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: viśākhayūpartupaśavo dviguṇāḥ puruṣamedhe | caturguṇāḥ sarvamedhe |
meaning: विशाखयूपर्तुपशवो द्विगुणाः पुरुषमेधे । चतुर्गुणाः सर्वमेधे ।
text_mt: The animals for the forked sacrificial post and the seasonal animals are doubled in the Human Sacrifice; quadrupled in the Universal Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣamedho 'śvamedhavat |
meaning: पुरुषमेधो ऽश्वमेधवत् ।
text_mt: The Human Sacrifice is like the Horse Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: caitryāḥ purastād varadānānta iṣṭayo 'gnaye kāmāya dātre pathikṛte |
meaning: चैत्र्याः पुरस्ताद् वरदानान्त इष्टयो ऽग्नये कामाय दात्रे पथिकृते ।
text_mt: Before the full moon day of Caitra, concluding with the granting of a boon, there are sacrifices to Agni Kāma, to [Agni] Dātṛ, and to [Agni] Pathikṛt.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānasya vijitaṃ sarvaṃ samaitu iti janapadam uccaiḥ śrāvayati |
meaning: यजमानस्य विजितं सर्वं समैतु इति जनपदम् उच्चैः श्रावयति ।
text_mt: He proclaims aloud to the countryside: "Let all that has been conquered by the sacrificer come together!"

sanskrit_iast: kasmai sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ svaṃ jñātibhyo dadyām | kena samāpnuyām iti yajamānaḥ |
meaning: कस्मै सहस्रं शताश्वं स्वं ज्ञातिभ्यो दद्याम् । केन समाप्नुयाम् इति यजमानः ।
text_mt: The sacrificer [says]: "To whom shall I give a thousand, a hundred horses, and his own [property] to his kinsmen? Through whom shall I attain [my goal]?"

sanskrit_iast: yadi brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā pratipadyeta siddhaṃ karmety ācakṣate |
meaning: यदि ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वा प्रतिपद्येत सिद्धं कर्मेत्य् आचक्षते ।
text_mt: If a brāhmaṇa or a kṣatriya accepts, they say the rite is accomplished.

sanskrit_iast: na cet pratipadyeta nediṣṭhaṃ sapatnaṃ vijitya tena yajeta |
meaning: न चेत् प्रतिपद्येत नेदिष्ठं सपत्नं विजित्य तेन यजेत ।
text_mt: If no one accepts, he shall conquer the nearest rival and sacrifice with him.

sanskrit_iast: tasmai jñātibhyas tad dadyāt |
meaning: तस्मै ज्ञातिभ्यस् तद् दद्यात् ।
text_mt: He shall give that to him [and] to his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast: yasya strī saṃbhāṣeta tasya sarvasvam ādāya tām abrāhmaṇīṃ haniṣya ity uccaiḥ śrāvayet |
meaning: यस्य स्त्री संभाषेत तस्य सर्वस्वम् आदाय ताम् अब्राह्मणीं हनिष्य इत्य् उच्चैः श्रावयेत् ।
text_mt: He shall proclaim aloud: "Whosoever's woman speaks to him, having taken all his property, I shall slay that non-brāhmaṇa woman."

sanskrit_iast: taṃ ha snātam alaṃkṛtam utsṛjyamānam sahasrabāhuḥ puruṣaḥ kena pārṣṇī ity anumantrayate |
meaning: तं ह स्नातम् अलंकृतम् उत्सृज्यमानम् सहस्रबाहुः पुरुषः केन पार्ष्णी इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: While he is bathed, adorned, and released, he consecrates him with the mantras: "The thousand-armed puruṣa..." and "By what [were] the two heels...?"

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaram iṣṭayaḥ pathyāyai svastaye adityā anumataye |
meaning: संवत्सरम् इष्टयः पथ्यायै स्वस्तये अदित्या अनुमतये ।
text_mt: For a year there are sacrifices to Pathyā Svasti, to Aditi, and to Anumati.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarānta aindrāpauṣṇaḥ paśuḥ |
meaning: संवत्सरान्त ऐन्द्रापौष्णः पशुः ।
text_mt: At the end of the year, there is a victim to Indra and Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: mahāvrataṃ tṛtīyam |
meaning: महाव्रतं तृतीयम् ।

sanskrit_iast: udīratām iti tisṛbhir yūpe badhyamānam anumantrayate | utthāpanībhiś ca vimucyamānam |
meaning: उदीरताम् इति तिसृभिर् यूपे बध्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते । उत्थापनीभिश् च विमुच्यमानम् ।
text_mt: With the three verses: "Let them arise...", he consecrates [him] as he is being bound to the sacrificial post, and with the raising verses as he is being untied.

sanskrit_iast: hariṇībhiḥ śāmitraṃ hriyamāṇam |
meaning: हरिणीभिः शामित्रं ह्रियमाणम् ।
text_mt: With the hariṇī verses, as he is being carried to the slaughter-bench;

sanskrit_iast: syonāsmai bhava iti dvābhyāṃ nipātyamānam |
meaning: स्योनास्मै भव इति द्वाभ्यां निपात्यमानम् ।
text_mt: With the two verses: "Be gentle to him...", as he is being laid down;

sanskrit_iast: sahasrabāhuḥ yāmasārasvataiḥ saṃjñaptam |
meaning: सहस्रबाहुः यामसारस्वतैः संज्ञप्तम् ।
text_mt: With "The thousand-armed..." and the yāmasārasvata verses, when he has been quieted.

sanskrit_iast: atha bhaiṣajyāya yajamānam akṣībhyāṃ te muñcāmi tvā uta devāḥ yasyās te apeta etu vāta ā vātu iti | methane brahmā suprapāṇā ca veśantā iti |
meaning: अथ भैषज्याय यजमानम् अक्षीभ्यां ते मुञ्चामि त्वा उत देवाः यस्यास् ते अपेत एतु वात आ वातु इति । मेथने ब्रह्मा सुप्रपाणा च वेशन्ता इति ।
text_mt: Then, for healing, [he consecrates] the sacrificer with: "From your two eyes...", "I release you...", "And the gods...", "Of whom yours...", "Let him depart...", and "May the wind blow..."; during the cohabitation, the brahman priest [recites]: "Having good drinking-pools and pools..."

sanskrit_iast: pūrveṇānucaryaḥ |
meaning: पूर्वेणानुचर्यः ।

sanskrit_iast: ud īrṣva nārī ity uktam |
meaning: उद् ईर्ष्व नारी इत्य् उक्तम् ।

sanskrit_iast: yan na idaṃ pitṛbhiḥ iti sarve |
meaning: यन् न इदं पितृभिः इति सर्वे ।
text_mt: All [recite]: "What is here to us through the Fathers..."

sanskrit_iast: brahmodyāt gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣan tā apaśyaṃ sahagopāś carantīḥ | havā idaryo abhitaḥ samāyan kiyad āsu svapatiś chandayāte ity udgātāram |
meaning: ब्रह्मोद्यात् गावो यवं प्रयुता अर्यो अक्षन् ता अपश्यं सहगोपाश् चरन्तीः । हवा इदर्यो अभितः समायन् कियद् आसु स्वपतिश् छन्दयाते इत्य् उद्गातारम् ।
text_mt: As the theological dialogue, [he addresses] the udgātṛ priest with: "The cows of the stranger, driven apart, have eaten the barley; I saw them wandering with their herdsman. The calls of the stranger came together on all sides; how much will the owner be pleased with them?"

sanskrit_iast: pratipraśne yasyānakṣā duhitā jātvāsa kas tāṃ vidvā;m abhi manyāte andhām | kataro meniṃ prati taṃ muñcāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt iti |
meaning: प्रतिप्रश्ने यस्यानक्षा दुहिता जात्वास कस् तां विद्वा;म् अभि मन्याते अन्धाम् । कतरो मेनिं प्रति तं मुञ्चाते य ईं वहाते य ईं वा वरेयात् इति ।
text_mt: In counter-question [he recites]: "Whose daughter was born eyeless, what wise man would court that blind one? Which of the two will bring wrath upon himself: he who weds her, or he who courts her?"

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyacaturthaṃ caturtham | atirātraḥ pañcamam |
meaning: पृष्ठ्यचतुर्थं चतुर्थम् । अतिरात्रः पञ्चमम् ।
text_mt: The fourth [day] is the fourth [day] of the Pṛṣṭhya [ṣaḍaha]; the fifth is an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamaṃ ced ukthyāgniṣṭomā uttame |
meaning: मध्यमं चेद् उक्थ्याग्निष्टोमा उत्तमे ।
text_mt: If [it is] the middle one, the Ukthya and Agniṣṭoma are the last two.

sanskrit_iast: sāśvamedha ṛtvikpatnīpraiṣakṛto dvayāḥ |
meaning: साश्वमेध ऋत्विक्पत्नीप्रैषकृतो द्वयाः ।
text_mt: Like the Horse Sacrifice, the two sets of summons of the priests and the wives [are performed].

sanskrit_iast: dvyaho 'śvamedhasya tryahaḥ puruṣamedhasya | sarvamedhaḥ puruṣamedhavat |
meaning: द्व्यहो ऽश्वमेधस्य त्र्यहः पुरुषमेधस्य । सर्वमेधः पुरुषमेधवत् ।
text_mt: The Horse Sacrifice lasts two [soma] days; the Human Sacrifice lasts three days. The Universal Sacrifice is like the Human Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ahāny agniṣṭud indrastut sūryastud vaiśvadevastut pauruṣamedhikaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pañcamaṃ vājapeyo 'ptoryāmā |
meaning: अहान्य् अग्निष्टुद् इन्द्रस्तुत् सूर्यस्तुद् वैश्वदेवस्तुत् पौरुषमेधिकं तृतीयं पञ्चमं वाजपेयो ऽप्तोर्यामा ।
text_mt: The days are Agniṣṭut, Indrastut, Sūryastut, and Vaiśvadevastut; the third belongs to the Human Sacrifice; the fifth is the Vājapeya [or] Aptoryāma.

sanskrit_iast: etasmin sarvān medhān ālabhante |
meaning: एतस्मिन् सर्वान् मेधान् आलभन्ते ।
text_mt: In this [sacrifice] they slaughter all sacrificial victims.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyottame viśvajid atirātro daśamam |
meaning: पृष्ठ्योत्तमे विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रो दशमम् ।
text_mt: At the end of the Pṛṣṭhya [ṣaḍaha], the Viśvajit; the tenth is an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarānte gārhapatye 'dharāraṇiṃ prahṛtyāhavanīya uttarāraṇim ayaṃ te yoniḥ ity ātmann agniṃ saṃspṛśyāraṇyāya pravrajet |
meaning: संवत्सरान्ते गार्हपत्ये ऽधरारणिं प्रहृत्याहवनीय उत्तरारणिम् अयं ते योनिः इत्य् आत्मन्न् अग्निं संस्पृश्यारण्याय प्रव्रजेत् ।
text_mt: At the end of a year, having cast the lower fire-drill into the gārhapatya fire and the upper fire-drill into the āhavanīya fire, having touched the fire within himself with: "This is your birthplace...", he should wander forth into the forest.

sanskrit_iast: iti medhāḥ kṣatriyasya kṣatriyasya |
meaning: इति मेधाः क्षत्रियस्य क्षत्रियस्य ।
text_mt: Thus [are] the great sacrifices of a kṣatriya, of a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast: atha stotriyavikārāḥ |
meaning: अथ स्तोत्रियविकाराः ।

sanskrit_iast: ekāheṣu taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi iti |
meaning: एकाहेषु तं ते मदं गृणीमसि इति ।
text_mt: In the one-day rites: "That exhilaration of yours we praise..."

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatisave tad vo gāya sute sacā vayam enam idā hyaḥ iti | savanayor ukthamukhīyatṛcaparyāsau | mādhyandine paryāsādyatṛcavarjam |
meaning: बृहस्पतिसवे तद् वो गाय सुते सचा वयम् एनम् इदा ह्यः इति । सवनयोर् उक्थमुखीयतृचपर्यासौ । माध्यन्दिने पर्यासाद्यतृचवर्जम् ।
text_mt: In the Bṛhaspatisava: "Sing that to them at the pressed [soma] together..." and "We him just now, yesterday..." [are used as] the opening triplet of the uktha and the concluding verse of the uktha at the two pressings, excluding the initial triplet of the concluding verse of the uktha at the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: gosavābhiṣecanīyayoḥ yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam iti |
meaning: गोसवाभिषेचनीययोः युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नम् अरुषम् इति ।
text_mt: In the Gosava and Abhiṣecanīya: "They yoke the ruddy tawny [steed]..."

sanskrit_iast: śyenasaṃdaṃśājiravajreṣu surūpakṛtnum ūtaye ut tvā mandantu stomāḥ tvām id dhi havāmahe iti |
meaning: श्येनसंदंशाजिरवज्रेषु सुरूपकृत्नुम् ऊतये उत् त्वा मन्दन्तु स्तोमाः त्वाम् इद् धि हवामहे इति ।
text_mt: In the Śyena, Saṃdaṃśa, Vajra, and Vajra [rites]: "The doer of fair deeds for assistance...", "Let the chants exhilarate you...", and "Thee indeed we call upon..."

sanskrit_iast: apūrve abhi tvā pūrvapītaye iti |
meaning: अपूर्वे अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये इति ।
text_mt: In the Apūrva: "Unto you for the first drinking..."

sanskrit_iast: vrātyastomeṣu ā tvetā ni ṣīdata adhā hīndra girvaṇaḥ iti |
meaning: व्रात्यस्तोमेषु आ त्वेता नि षीदत अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वणः इति ।
text_mt: In the Vrātyastomas: "Come hither, sit down..." and "So indeed, O Indra, lover of songs..."

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭutsu īlenyo namasyaḥ agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe agnim īliṣvāvase agna ā yāhy agnibhiḥ iti |
meaning: अग्निष्टुत्सु ईलेन्यो नमस्यः अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे अग्निम् ईलिष्वावसे अग्न आ याह्य् अग्निभिः इति ।
text_mt: In the Agniṣṭuts: "Praiseworthy, worthy of reverence...", "We choose Agni as messenger...", "Praise Agni for help...", and "O Agni, come with the fires..."

sanskrit_iast: tīvrasudupaśadopahavyeṣu ayam u te samatasi imā u tvā purūvaso iti | vyuṣṭidvyahe ca |
meaning: तीव्रसुदुपशदोपहव्येषु अयम् उ ते समतसि इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो इति । व्युष्टिद्व्यहे च ।
text_mt: In the Tīvrasut, Upaśad, and Upahavya: "Here indeed you wander..." and "These to you, O rich in treasures...", and in the Vyuṣṭidvyaha.

sanskrit_iast: gosavavivadhavaiśyastomeṣu indraṃ vo viśvatas pari ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ iti |
meaning: गोसवविवधवैश्यस्तोमेषु इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस् परि आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः इति ।
text_mt: In the Gosava, Vivadha, and Vaiśyastomas: "Indra for you from all around..." and "To us in all [battles] Indra is to be invoked..."

sanskrit_iast: pratīcīnastome tvam indra pratūrtiṣu iti |
meaning: प्रतीचीनस्तोमे त्वम् इन्द्र प्रतूर्तिषु इति ।
text_mt: In the Pratīcīnastoma: "You, O Indra, in the encounters..."

sanskrit_iast: rāji yo rājā carṣaṇīnām iti |
meaning: राजि यो राजा चर्षणीनाम् इति ।
text_mt: In the Rāj: "Who is the king of the peoples..."

sanskrit_iast: udbhidbalabhidoḥ yajña indram avardhayat iti |
meaning: उद्भिद्बलभिदोः यज्ञ इन्द्रम् अवर्धयत् इति ।
text_mt: In the Udbhid and Balabhid: "Sacrifice magnified Indra..."

sanskrit_iast: indrastome indra kratuṃ na ā bhara tava tyad indriyaṃ bṛhat iti |
meaning: इन्द्रस्तोमे इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर तव त्यद् इन्द्रियं बृहत् इति ।
text_mt: In the Indrastoma: "O Indra, bring us wisdom..." and "That your mighty indriya-power..."

sanskrit_iast: vighane samasya manyave viśaḥ tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham iti |
meaning: विघने समस्य मन्यवे विशः तद् इद् आस भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठम् इति ।
text_mt: In the Vighana: "Before his wrath the clans [bowed]..." and "That indeed was the eldest among beings..."

sanskrit_iast: sūryastuti ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam citraṃ devānāṃ ketur anīkam iti |
meaning: सूर्यस्तुति उद् उ त्यं जातवेदसम् चित्रं देवानां केतुर् अनीकम् इति ।
text_mt: In the Sūryastut: "Up that Jātavedas..." and "The wondrous banner, the face of the gods..."

sanskrit_iast: vajre punaḥstome tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti |
meaning: वज्रे पुनःस्तोमे त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति ।
text_mt: In the Vajra and Punaḥstoma: "Bring to us, O Indra..."

sanskrit_iast: sarvajity ṛṣabhe marutstome sāhasrāntye tad vo gāya sute sacā vayam enam idā hyaḥ iti |
meaning: सर्वजित्य् ऋषभे मरुत्स्तोमे साहस्रान्त्ये तद् वो गाय सुते सचा वयम् एनम् इदा ह्यः इति ।
text_mt: In the Sarvajit, the Ṛṣabha, the Marutstoma, and the last of the Sāhasra rites, [the strophe and antistrophe are]: 'Sing that for you when the soma is pressed...' and 'Him we today and yesterday...'.

sanskrit_iast: sāhasrādyayoḥ svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ iti |
meaning: साहस्राद्ययोः स्वादोर् इत्था विषूवतः इति ।
text_mt: In the first two of the Sāhasra rites: 'From the sweet, thus, of the solstice...'.

sanskrit_iast: virāji bhūmistome vanaspatisave tviṣyapacityor indrāgnyoḥ stoma indrāgnyoḥ kulāya indrāya madvane sutam yat somam indra viṣṇavi iti |
meaning: विराजि भूमिस्तोमे वनस्पतिसवे त्विष्यपचित्योर् इन्द्राग्न्योः स्तोम इन्द्राग्न्योः कुलाय इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतम् यत् सोमम् इन्द्र विष्णवि इति ।
text_mt: In the Virāj, the Bhūmistoma, the Vanaspatisava, the Tviṣi and Apaciti, the Stoma of Indra and Agni, [and] the Kulāya of Indra and Agni: “For intoxicating Indra the pressed [juice]” [and] “The soma which, O Indra, at Viṣṇu's”.

sanskrit_iast: virāje 'gneḥ stome 'gneḥ kulāye agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe agnim īliṣvāvase iti |
meaning: विराजे ऽग्नेः स्तोमे ऽग्नेः कुलाये अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे अग्निम् ईलिष्वावसे इति ।
text_mt: In the Virāj, the Stoma of Agni, [and] the Kulāya of Agni: “Agni the messenger we choose” [and] “Praise Agni for help”.

sanskrit_iast: vinuttyabhibhūtyo rāśimarāyayoḥ śadopaśadayoḥ samrāṭsvarājoḥ yad adya kac ca vṛtrahan ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca naḥ iti |
meaning: विनुत्त्यभिभूत्यो राशिमराययोः शदोपशदयोः सम्राट्स्वराजोः यद् अद्य कच् च वृत्रहन् उभयं शृणवच् च नः इति ।
text_mt: In the Vinutti and Abhibhūti, the Rāśi and Arāya, the Śada and Upaśada, [and] the Samrāj and Svarāj: “Whatever today, O slayer of Vṛtra” [and] “He shall hear both for us”.

sanskrit_iast: rājasūyeṣu yat somam indra viṣṇavi adhā hīndra girvaṇaḥ abhrātṛvyo anā tvam tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti ca | caturahapañcāhāhīnadaśāhacchandomadaśāheṣu ca |
meaning: राजसूयेषु यत् सोमम् इन्द्र विष्णवि अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वणः अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वम् त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति च । चतुरहपञ्चाहाहीनदशाहच्छन्दोमदशाहेषु च ।
text_mt: In the Rājasūya rites: “The soma which, O Indra, at Viṣṇu's”, “And then indeed, O Indra delighted by praise”, “Without a rival indeed art thou”, and “Bring to us, O Indra”; and also in the four-day, five-day, ahīna, ten-day, and chandoma-ten-day rites.

sanskrit_iast: tīvrasuccatuḥparyāyayoḥ sāhasrāntyayor daśapeye vibhraṃśayajñe śrāyanta iva sūryam iti |
meaning: तीव्रसुच्चतुःपर्याययोः साहस्रान्त्ययोर् दशपेये विभ्रंशयज्ञे श्रायन्त इव सूर्यम् इति ।
text_mt: In the Tīvrasut, the two Catuḥparyāyas, the two final days of the Sahasra, the Daśapeya, [and] the Vibhraṃśayajña: “Like those taking refuge in the sun”.

sanskrit_iast: sādyaḥkreṣu śyenavarjam aham id dhi pituṣ pari iti ca |
meaning: साद्यःक्रेषु श्येनवर्जम् अहम् इद् धि पितुष् परि इति च ।
text_mt: In the Sādyaḥkras, except the Śyena: and “From the father indeed I”.

sanskrit_iast: atirātrāṇāṃ sarvastomayor mā bhūma niṣṭyā iva vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe iti |
meaning: अतिरात्राणां सर्वस्तोमयोर् मा भूम निष्ट्या इव विधुं दद्राणं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे इति ।
text_mt: Among the Atirātras, in the two Sarvastomas: “May we not be like strangers” [and] “The moon running on the surface of the waters”.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtpañcadaśasaptadaśaikaviṃśatriṇavatrayastriṃśanavasaptadaśeṣu ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca naḥ vayam enam idā hyaḥ pibā somam indra mandatu tvā iti |
meaning: त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशसप्तदशैकविंशत्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिंशनवसप्तदशेषु उभयं शृणवच् च नः वयम् एनम् इदा ह्यः पिबा सोमम् इन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा इति ।
text_mt: In the Trivṛt, Pañcadaśa, Saptadaśa, Ekaviṃśa, Triṇava, Trayastriṃśa, and Navasaptadaśa [stomas]: “He shall hear both for us”, “Him we today, yesterday”, [and] “Drink the soma, O Indra; let it exhilarate thee”.

sanskrit_iast: abhijiti abhi pra gopatiṃ girā iti ca |
meaning: अभिजिति अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरा इति च ।
text_mt: In the Abhijit: and “Forth to the lord of herds with song”.

sanskrit_iast: anatirātre abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute iti |
meaning: अनतिरात्रे अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते इति ।
text_mt: In the non-Atirātra: “Towards thee, O bull, at the pressing”.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśe indrā yāhi citrabhāno mā cid anyad vi śaṃsata iti |
meaning: चतुर्विंशे इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो मा चिद् अन्यद् वि शंसत इति ।
text_mt: In the twenty-four-day rite: “Come, O Indra of wondrous splendour” [and] “Praise nothing else”.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajiti ya eka id vidayate iti |
meaning: विश्वजिति य एक इद् विदयते इति ।
text_mt: In the Viśvajit: “He who alone distributes”.

sanskrit_iast: viṣuvati indra kratuṃ na ā bhara iti |
meaning: विषुवति इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर इति ।
text_mt: In the Viṣuvant: “Bring us, O Indra, wisdom”.

sanskrit_iast: svarasāmābhiplavagavāyuṣi śeṣeṣu | pṛṣṭhasyaikaviṃśe indro dadhīco asthabhiḥ viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram evā hyasi vīrayuḥ iti |
meaning: स्वरसामाभिप्लवगवायुषि शेषेषु । पृष्ठस्यैकविंशे इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिः विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरम् एवा ह्यसि वीरयुः इति ।
text_mt: In the Svarasāmans, the Abhiplava, [and] the Go and Āyus, in the remaining [days]; on the twenty-first [day] of the Pṛṣṭha: “Indra with the bones of Dadhīca”, “The man overcoming all hostile armies”, [and] “For thus art thou desirous of heroes”.

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣṭyāṅgirasakāpivanacaitrarathadvyahānām taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi iti | dvitīyeṣu viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram iti |
meaning: व्युष्ट्याङ्गिरसकापिवनचैत्ररथद्व्यहानाम् तं ते मदं गृणीमसि इति । द्वितीयेषु विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरम् इति ।
text_mt: In the two-day rites of the Vyuṣṭi, the Āṅgirasa, the Kāpivana, [and] the Caitraratha: “That exhilaration of thine we celebrate”; on the second days: “The man overcoming all hostile armies”.

sanskrit_iast: cāturmāsyavaiśvadevagargabaidacchandomavatparākāntarvasvaśvamedhatryahāṇāṃ śagdhy ū ṣu śacīpate iti |
meaning: चातुर्मास्यवैश्वदेवगर्गबैदच्छन्दोमवत्पराकान्तर्वस्वश्वमेधत्र्यहाणां शग्ध्य् ऊ षु शचीपते इति ।
text_mt: In the three-day rites of the Cāturmāsya, the Vaiśvadeva, the Garga, the Baida, the Chandomavat, the Parāka, the Antarvasu, [and] the Aśvamedha: “Be capable, O lord of power”.

sanskrit_iast: sākamedhasya indram id devatātaye iti |
meaning: साकमेधस्य इन्द्रम् इद् देवतातये इति ।
text_mt: In that of the Sākamedha: “Indra indeed for the worship of the gods”.

sanskrit_iast: baidasvarasāmnoḥ tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti |
meaning: बैदस्वरसाम्नोः त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति ।
text_mt: In the Baida and the Svarasāman: “Bring to us, O Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyeṣu tam indraṃ vājayāmasi astāvi manma pūrvyam taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi iti |
meaning: द्वितीयेषु तम् इन्द्रं वाजयामसि अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यम् तं ते मदं गृणीमसि इति ।
text_mt: On the second days: “We urge that Indra to battle”, “The ancient thought has been praised”, [and] “That exhilaration of thine we celebrate”.

sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhasya vācam aṣṭāpadīm aham svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ iti |
meaning: अश्वमेधस्य वाचम् अष्टापदीम् अहम् स्वादोर् इत्था विषूवतः इति ।
text_mt: In that of the Horse Sacrifice: “An eight-footed speech I”, [and] “The sweet [draught] thus of the Viṣūvant”.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyatryahasya evā hy asi vīrayuḥ ity ukthe |
meaning: पृष्ठ्यत्र्यहस्य एवा ह्य् असि वीरयुः इत्य् उक्थे ।
text_mt: In the Pṛṣṭhya three-day rite, in the uktha: “For thus art thou desirous of heroes”.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyeṣu mahā;m indro ya ojasā abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam evā hy asi vīrayuḥ iti |
meaning: तृतीयेषु महा;म् इन्द्रो य ओजसा अभि प्र वः सुराधसम् एवा ह्य् असि वीरयुः इति ।
text_mt: On the third days: “Great is Indra who through might”, “Forth to your bountiful one”, [and] “For thus art thou desirous of heroes”.

sanskrit_iast: sākamedhasya tam indraṃ vājayāmasi śrāyanta iva sūryam iti |
meaning: साकमेधस्य तम् इन्द्रं वाजयामसि श्रायन्त इव सूर्यम् इति ।
text_mt: In that of the Sākamedha: “We urge that Indra to battle” [and] “Like those taking refuge in the sun”.

sanskrit_iast: caturahāṇāṃ śrāyanta iva sūryam tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti |
meaning: चतुरहाणां श्रायन्त इव सूर्यम् त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति ।
text_mt: In the four-day rites: “Like those taking refuge in the sun” [and] “Bring to us, O Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: caturtheṣu mahā;m indro ya ojasā ya eka id vidayate iti |
meaning: चतुर्थेषु महा;म् इन्द्रो य ओजसा य एक इद् विदयते इति ।
text_mt: On the fourth days: “Great is Indra who through might” [and] “He who alone distributes”.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu mā bhūma niṣṭyā iva vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe iti |
meaning: सर्वेषु मा भूम निष्ट्या इव विधुं दद्राणं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे इति ।
text_mt: In all of them: “May we not be like strangers” [and] “The moon running on the surface of the waters”.

sanskrit_iast: saṃsarpacaturvīrayoḥ ayam u te samatasi imā u tvā purūvaso iti |
meaning: संसर्पचतुर्वीरयोः अयम् उ ते समतसि इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो इति ।
text_mt: In the Saṃsarpa and Caturvīra: “And this roaming of thine” [and] “These unto thee, O lord of much wealth”.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāheṣu trivṛdādivat |
meaning: पञ्चाहेषु त्रिवृदादिवत् ।
text_mt: In the five-day rites: as in the Trivṛt and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyapañcaśāradīyayor dvitīye tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti |
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यपञ्चशारदीययोर् द्वितीये त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति ।
text_mt: On the second [day] of the Abhyāsaṅgya and the Pañcaśāradīya: “Bring to us, O Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyapañcāhasya evā hy asi vīrayuḥ iti |
meaning: पृष्ठ्यपञ्चाहस्य एवा ह्य् असि वीरयुः इति ।
text_mt: In the Pṛṣṭhya five-day rite: “For thus art thou desirous of heroes”.

sanskrit_iast: pañcame uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha indro madāya vāvṛdhe indrāya sāma gāyata iti |
meaning: पञ्चमे उत्तिष्ठन्न् ओजसा सह इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे इन्द्राय साम गायत इति ।
text_mt: On the fifth: “Arising together with might”, “Indra has grown for exhilaration”, [and] “Sing a sāman to Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: abhiplavapañcāhasya ya eka id vidayate iti |
meaning: अभिप्लवपञ्चाहस्य य एक इद् विदयते इति ।
text_mt: In the Abhiplava five-day rite: “He who alone distributes”.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyapañcaśāradīyayoḥ śrāyanta iva sūryam iti |
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यपञ्चशारदीययोः श्रायन्त इव सूर्यम् इति ।
text_mt: In the Abhyāsaṅgya and the Pañcaśāradīya: “Like those taking refuge in the sun”.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍahasya gavi abhrātṛvyo anā tvam iti | āyuṣi tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti |
meaning: षडहस्य गवि अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वम् इति । आयुषि त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति ।
text_mt: In the Go day of the six-day rite: “Without a rival indeed art thou”; in the Āyus day: “Bring to us, O Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: pañcame endra no gadhi priyaḥ iti |
meaning: पञ्चमे एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः इति ।
text_mt: On the fifth: “Come to us, dear one”.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭham ukthyaṃ cet ya eka id vidayate yat somam indra viṣṇavi iti |
meaning: षष्ठम् उक्थ्यं चेत् य एक इद् विदयते यत् सोमम् इन्द्र विष्णवि इति ।
text_mt: If the sixth is an ukthya: “He who alone distributes” [and] “The soma which, O Indra, at Viṣṇu's”.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhasya dvitīye evā hy asi vīrayuḥ iti |
meaning: पृष्ठस्य द्वितीये एवा ह्य् असि वीरयुः इति ।
text_mt: On the second [day] of the Pṛṣṭha: “For thus art thou desirous of heroes”.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīye indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ tvaṃ na indrā bhara iti |
meaning: तृतीये इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्तः त्वं न इन्द्रा भर इति ।
text_mt: On the third: “For thou art seen together with Indra”, “We indeed who have pressed the soma for thee”, [and] “Bring to us, O Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: daśāhasyāṣṭame yad indra prāg apāg udak iti |
meaning: दशाहस्याष्टमे यद् इन्द्र प्राग् अपाग् उदक् इति ।
text_mt: On the eighth [day] of the ten-day rite: “If, O Indra, east, west, north”.

sanskrit_iast: navame eto nv indraṃ stavāma iti |
meaning: नवमे एतो न्व् इन्द्रं स्तवाम इति ।
text_mt: On the ninth: “Come now, let us praise Indra”.

sanskrit_iast: trikakuddaśāhasya navasu śagdhy ū ṣu śacīpate abhi pra gopatiṃ girā taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣaham vayam enam idā hyaḥ indram id gāthino bṛhat śrāyanta iva sūryam ka īṃ veda sute sacā viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram yad indra prāg apāg udak iti |
meaning: त्रिककुद्दशाहस्य नवसु शग्ध्य् ऊ षु शचीपते अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरा तं वो दस्मम् ऋतीषहम् वयम् एनम् इदा ह्यः इन्द्रम् इद् गाथिनो बृहत् श्रायन्त इव सूर्यम् क ईं वेद सुते सचा विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरम् यद् इन्द्र प्राग् अपाग् उदक् इति ।
text_mt: For the nine [days] of the Trikakud Daśāha, [the verses are]: "Help well, O lord of power", "Sing forth to the lord of the cow with verse", "To that accomplished one of yours, who overcomes attacks", "We [invoke] him now, yesterday", "Singers [magnify] Indra greatly", "As if clinging to the sun", "Who knows him when the soma is pressed?", "The man who overcomes all armies", [and] "Whether, O Indra, from the east, west, or north".

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭame mahā;m indro ya ojasā iti |
meaning: अष्टमे महा;म् इन्द्रो य ओजसा इति ।
text_mt: On the eighth [day]: "Indra is great, who by his might".

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhasya chandomaprathamāntyayoḥ tvaṃ na indrā bhara ya eka id vidayate iti |
meaning: द्वादशाहस्य छन्दोमप्रथमान्त्ययोः त्वं न इन्द्रा भर य एक इद् विदयते इति ।
text_mt: On the first and last of the Chandoma [days] of the Twelve-Day Rite: "Bring to us, O Indra", [and] "He who alone distributes".

sanskrit_iast: svarasāmasu saṃ codaya citram arvāk praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā iti paryāyeṇa | abhiplave ca |
meaning: स्वरसामसु सं चोदय चित्रम् अर्वाक् प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा इति पर्यायेण । अभिप्लवे च ।
text_mt: At the Svarasāman [days]: "Impel hither the wondrous [wealth]", [and] "To the guide towards better things" alternately; and also at the Abhiplava.

sanskrit_iast: tanūpṛṣṭhe abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ tvām id dhi havāmahe yad dyāva indra te śatam pibā somam indra mandatu tvā kayā naś citra ā bhuvat revatīr naḥ sadhamāde iti |
meaning: तनूपृष्ठे अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमः त्वाम् इद् धि हवामहे यद् द्याव इन्द्र ते शतम् पिबा सोमम् इन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा कया नश् चित्र आ भुवत् रेवतीर् नः सधमादे इति ।
text_mt: In the case of Tanūpṛṣṭha: "Unto thee, hero, we shout", "Thee indeed we call upon", "If, O Indra, a hundred heavens were thine", "Drink soma, O Indra; let it intoxicate thee", "By what wondrous [aid] will he be present to us?", [and] "Rich ones, with us in festive gathering".

sanskrit_iast: eteṣām anantaro 'nurūpaḥ saṃbhave | stotriyaniyamaś chandasā |
meaning: एतेषाम् अनन्तरो ऽनुरूपः संभवे । स्तोत्रियनियमश् छन्दसा ।
text_mt: The antistrophe verse immediately follows these, when possible; the rule for the strophe verse is according to the meter.

sanskrit_iast: gavāmayanena sāṃvatsarikāṇi vyākhyātāni |
meaning: गवामयनेन सांवत्सरिकाणि व्याख्यातानि ।
text_mt: By the Gavāmayana, the year-long [sacrifices] are explained.

sanskrit_iast: etasmād evāhīnā rātrisattrāṇi | ekāhā api kecit |
meaning: एतस्माद् एवाहीना रात्रिसत्त्राणि । एकाहा अपि केचित् ।
text_mt: From this very [model] come the ahīna sacrifices, the night sessions, and also certain one-day rites.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra kāmakḷptī sāmavedāt |
meaning: सर्वत्र कामकॢप्ती सामवेदात् ।
text_mt: Everywhere the arrangement of wishes is according to the Sāmaveda.

sanskrit_iast: dvyahaprabhṛtayo 'hīnā ā dvādaśāhāt | anyatarato 'tirātrāt |
meaning: द्व्यहप्रभृतयो ऽहीना आ द्वादशाहात् । अन्यतरतो ऽतिरात्रात् ।
text_mt: Ahīna sacrifices range from two-day rites up to the twelve-day rite, [characterized] by an Atirātra at either end.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhaprabhṛtīni rātrisattrāṇy arvāñci saṃvatsarāt |
meaning: द्वादशाहप्रभृतीनि रात्रिसत्त्राण्य् अर्वाञ्चि संवत्सरात् ।
text_mt: Night sessions range from twelve days up to short of a year.

sanskrit_iast: daśarātra ubhayatotirātraḥ |
meaning: दशरात्र उभयतोतिरात्रः ।
text_mt: The ten-night rite has an Atirātra at both ends.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhaḥ purastādagniṣṭomo 'hīnaḥ |
meaning: द्वादशाहः पुरस्तादग्निष्टोमो ऽहीनः ।
text_mt: The twelve-day rite with an Agniṣṭoma first is an ahīna sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sahasrasaṃvatsaraparyantāny ayanāni | viśvajitā sahasrasaṃvatsarapratimena yajeta |
meaning: सहस्रसंवत्सरपर्यन्तान्य् अयनानि । विश्वजिता सहस्रसंवत्सरप्रतिमेन यजेत ।
text_mt: Sacrificial courses extend up to a thousand years; one should sacrifice with a Viśvajit as an equivalent to a thousand-year sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheyaṃ vasante brāhmaṇasya brahmavarcasakāmasya | grīṣme rājanyasya tejaskāmasya | varṣāsu vaiśyasya puṣṭikāmasya | śaradi sarveṣāṃ gadāpanuttaye |
meaning: अग्न्याधेयं वसन्ते ब्राह्मणस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य । ग्रीष्मे राजन्यस्य तेजस्कामस्य । वर्षासु वैश्यस्य पुष्टिकामस्य । शरदि सर्वेषां गदापनुत्तये ।
text_mt: The setting up of the sacred fires [is performed] in spring for a brāhmaṇa desiring spiritual lustre, in summer for a kṣatriya desiring vigor, in the rainy season for a vaiśya desiring prosperity, [and] in autumn for all to ward off disease.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇāhutyantam ity eke |
meaning: पूर्णाहुत्यन्तम् इत्य् एके ।
text_mt: According to some, it concludes with the full-spoon offering.

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrāyaṇinām iti yuvā kauśikaḥ |
meaning: अग्निहोत्रायणिनाम् इति युवा कौशिकः ।
text_mt: For those who perform the Agnihotra, [it extends to that point], according to the young Kauśika.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām āgrayaṇe navasya |
meaning: तेषाम् आग्रयणे नवस्य ।
text_mt: For them, at the first-fruits offering, [an offering] of new grain [is made].

sanskrit_iast: sthālīpākenāgnihotraṃ yavāgvā vā |
meaning: स्थालीपाकेनाग्निहोत्रं यवाग्वा वा ।
text_mt: The Agnihotra [is performed] with a boiled rice offering or with barley gruel.

sanskrit_iast: abhāve gavīḍāṃ navaghāsam āśayitvā tasyāḥ payasā |
meaning: अभावे गवीडां नवघासम् आशयित्वा तस्याः पयसा ।
text_mt: In the absence [of these], having fed the cow fresh grass, with her milk.

sanskrit_iast: śrīkāmasya nityam agnīnāṃ jāgaraṇam |
meaning: श्रीकामस्य नित्यम् अग्नीनां जागरणम् ।
text_mt: For one desiring prosperity, there is constant keeping awake of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: agnihotraṃ svargakāmasya |
meaning: अग्निहोत्रं स्वर्गकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Agnihotra is for one desiring heaven.

sanskrit_iast: payasā sarvakāmasya |
meaning: पयसा सर्वकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: dadhnendriyakāmasya |
meaning: दध्नेन्द्रियकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: ājyena tejaskāmasya |
meaning: आज्येन तेजस्कामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: tailena śrīkāmasya |
meaning: तैलेन श्रीकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: odanena prajākāmasya |
meaning: ओदनेन प्रजाकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: yavāgvā grāmakāmasya |
meaning: यवाग्वा ग्रामकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: taṇḍulair balakāmasya |
meaning: तण्डुलैर् बलकामस्य ।
text_mt: With rice grains, for one desiring strength.

sanskrit_iast: somena brahmavarcasakāmasya |
meaning: सोमेन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य ।
text_mt: With soma, for one desiring spiritual lustre.

sanskrit_iast: māṃsena puṣṭikāmasya |
meaning: मांसेन पुष्टिकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: udakenāyuṣkāmasya |
meaning: उदकेनायुष्कामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsau sarvakāmasya |
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासौ सर्वकामस्य ।
text_mt: The New and Full Moon sacrifices are for one desiring all wishes.

sanskrit_iast: dākṣāyaṇayajñaḥ prajākāmasya |
meaning: दाक्षायणयज्ञः प्रजाकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice is for one desiring offspring.

sanskrit_iast: sākaṃprasthāyyayajñaḥ paśukāmasya |
meaning: साकंप्रस्थाय्ययज्ञः पशुकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Sākaṃprasthāyya sacrifice is for one desiring cattle.

sanskrit_iast: saṃkramayajñaḥ sarvakāmasya |
meaning: संक्रमयज्ञः सर्वकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Saṃkrama sacrifice is for one desiring all wishes.

sanskrit_iast: iḍādadhaḥ paśukāmasya |
meaning: इडादधः पशुकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Iḍādadha is for one desiring cattle.

sanskrit_iast: sārvasenayajñaḥ prajākāmasya |
meaning: सार्वसेनयज्ञः प्रजाकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Sārvasena sacrifice is for one desiring offspring.

sanskrit_iast: śaunakayajño 'bhicārakāmasya |
meaning: शौनकयज्ञो ऽभिचारकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Śaunaka sacrifice is for one desiring a malevolent rite.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhayajñaḥ prajākāmasya |
meaning: वसिष्ठयज्ञः प्रजाकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Vasiṣṭha sacrifice is for one desiring offspring.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivyor ayanaṃ pratiṣṭhākāmasya |
meaning: द्यावापृथिव्योर् अयनं प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य ।
text_mt: The course of Heaven and Earth is for one desiring firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: etāni darśapūrṇamāsāyanāni |
meaning: एतानि दर्शपूर्णमासायनानि ।
text_mt: These are the sacrificial courses of the New and Full Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: āgrayaṇam annakāmasya |
meaning: आग्रयणम् अन्नकामस्य ।
text_mt: The first-fruits offering is for one desiring food.

sanskrit_iast: cāturmāsyāni sarvakāmasya |
meaning: चातुर्मास्यानि सर्वकामस्य ।
text_mt: The four-month sacrifices are for one desiring all wishes.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnaḥ paśur āyuṣprajāpaśukāmasya |
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नः पशुर् आयुष्प्रजापशुकामस्य ।
text_mt: The animal [sacrifice] to Indra and Agni is for one desiring life, offspring, and cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yāmaḥ śukahariḥ śuṇṭho vānāmayakāmasya pitṛlokakāmasya ca |
meaning: यामः शुकहरिः शुण्ठो वानामयकामस्य पितृलोककामस्य च ।
text_mt: A white-yellowish or gelded animal sacred to Yama is for one desiring freedom from disease and for one desiring the realm of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: tvāṣṭro vaḍavaḥ prajākāmasya |
meaning: त्वाष्ट्रो वडवः प्रजाकामस्य ।
text_mt: A mare sacred to Tvaṣṭṛ is for one desiring offspring.

sanskrit_iast: kāmyāv etau |
meaning: काम्याव् एतौ ।

sanskrit_iast: sutyāḥ sarvakāmasya |
meaning: सुत्याः सर्वकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: ukthyaḥ paśukāmasya |
meaning: उक्थ्यः पशुकामस्य ।

sanskrit_iast: vājapeyaḥ svārājayakāmasya |
meaning: वाजपेयः स्वाराजयकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Vājapeya is for one desiring sovereign rule.

sanskrit_iast: atirātra ṛddhikāmasya |
meaning: अतिरात्र ऋद्धिकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Atirātra is for one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: gavāmayanaṃ dvādaśāhaś ca |
meaning: गवामयनं द्वादशाहश् च ।
text_mt: The Gavāmayana and the twelve-day rite [are likewise].

sanskrit_iast: rājasūyaḥ svārājyakāmasya |
meaning: राजसूयः स्वाराज्यकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Rājasūya is for one desiring sovereign rule.

sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhapuruṣamedhau sarvakāmasya |
meaning: अश्वमेधपुरुषमेधौ सर्वकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Horse Sacrifice and Human Sacrifice are for one desiring all wishes.

sanskrit_iast: sarvamedhaḥ śraiṣṭhyakāmasya |
meaning: सर्वमेधः श्रैष्ठ्यकामस्य ।
text_mt: The Universal Sacrifice is for one desiring preeminence.

sanskrit_iast: kāmānantyād aparimitā yajñāḥ |
meaning: कामानन्त्याद् अपरिमिता यज्ञाः ।
text_mt: Because desires are endless, sacrifices are limitless.

sanskrit_iast: te prakṛtibhir vyākhyātāḥ |
meaning: ते प्रकृतिभिर् व्याख्याताः ।
text_mt: They are explained by their archetype sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: yajñakramo brāhmaṇāt | viriṣṭasaṃdhānaṃ ca |
meaning: यज्ञक्रमो ब्राह्मणात् । विरिष्टसंधानं च ।
text_mt: The order of sacrifice is [known] from the Brāhmaṇa, as is the repairing of defects.

sanskrit_iast: ya imau kalpāv adhīte ya u caivaṃ veda tena sarvaiḥ kratubhir iṣṭaṃ bhavati sarvāṃś ca kāmān āpnoti |
meaning: य इमौ कल्पाव् अधीते य उ चैवं वेद तेन सर्वैः क्रतुभिर् इष्टं भवति सर्वांश् च कामान् आप्नोति ।
text_mt: Whoever studies these two ritual procedures and whoever knows thus—by him sacrifice has been made with all sacrifices, and he attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti yathā yaṣṭus tathādhyetur eṣā brāhmī pratiśrutir eṣā brāhmī pratiśrutir iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति यथा यष्टुस् तथाध्येतुर् एषा ब्राह्मी प्रतिश्रुतिर् एषा ब्राह्मी प्रतिश्रुतिर् इति ।
text_mt: Now also they quote: “As for the sacrificer, so for the reciter; this is the echo of the brahman, this is the echo of the brahman.”
